article.articleHeadline: Casos de Mpox se espalham principalmente por contato sexual, diz infectologista
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Mpox cases spread mainly through sexual contact, says an infectious disease specialist.
article.articleSummary: Mpox (Monkeypox) in Brazil remains linked mainly to sexual contact, though it is not classified as an STI. Ceará state has confirmed its third Mpox case in 2026; nationwide diagnoses have risen, with many cases detected in São Paulo after Carnival. By March 26, 2026, Brazil has recorded over 100 Mpox cases this year, following more than 1,000 in 2025. The incubation period is typically 13–14 days. Early symptoms resemble a flu-like illness, followed by skin lesions that start as red bumps, progress to pus-filled lesions, then crust, and can appear as a generalized rash; recovery of the skin usually takes 3–4 weeks. Prevention emphasizes avoiding contact with infected individuals and early diagnosis. Vulnerable groups include children under six and immunosuppressed people. Vaccination is recommended for these groups; Brazil has a vaccine available for those using HIV pre-exposure prophylaxis.

triage.headline_ja: Mpoxの感染は主に性的接触により拡大している、感染症専門医が述べた
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルにおけるMpox感染の拡大が確認され、複数州への広がり、前年比での増加傾向、および vulnerable population への影響が報告されている。IHR基準で3項目該当（異常性、国際拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。
triage.notes: ブラジルにおけるMpoxの継続的な拡大が報告されている。2026年初頭の時点で100例以上の確認例があり、2025年の1000例以上から増加傾向が続いている。セアラ州での3例目の確認、サンパウロでの多数の検出が記載されており、国内複数地域への拡大が明確。カーニバル後の症例増加により、ヒト-ヒト感染の流行ポテンシャルが示唆される。脆弱人口（6歳未満の小児および免疫抑制者）への特別な懸念も述べられている。

article.articleHeadline: Secretaria de Saúde alerta para aumento dos casos de síndromes respiratórias em Guarapuava | JNotícias
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Health Department warns of a rise in respiratory syndrome cases in Guarapuava | JNotícias
article.articleSummary: Guarapuava, Paraná, Brazil, authorities report a rise in respiratory syndrome cases, driving higher demand for health services. Surveillance data show a sharp uptick: epidemiological week 6 recorded 223 respiratory visits, rising to 818 in week 10 — a roughly 267 percent increase. Currently circulating respiratory viruses include rhinovirus, influenza A, and COVID-19, with rhinovirus predominant. The Health Secretariat attributes the surge to the seasonal peak. They caution against self medication, urging evaluation by a health professional before taking any medicines. Preventive measures include frequent hand hygiene, wearing a mask when symptomatic, avoiding close contact when ill, maintaining a balanced diet and adequate hydration. In coming days, an influenza vaccination campaign will begin for prioritized groups, particularly adults over 60, pregnant women, and children under five.

triage.headline_ja: グアラプアヴァの呼吸器症候群患者の増加について保健局が警告
triage.triage_reason: COVID-19およびインフルエンザAを含む呼吸器症候群の増加が報告されているが、当局は季節的ピークとして説明しており、重症度や国際的拡大のリスクについて情報が限定的である。継続監視が必要。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーは季節的な呼吸器症候群の増加を報告しており、当局が季節的ピークとして説明している。死亡や重症例の明記がなく、重症度は不明。複数の呼吸器ウイルス（ライノウイルス優位）が循環中だが、単一の既知の病原体による異常な流行ではない。ワクチン接種キャンペーン予定は管理体制の存在を示唆している。情報が充分でないため、継続した監視が推奨される。

article.articleHeadline: Novos casos de mpox são confirmados em Belo Horizonte e Manhuaçu
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: New mpox cases confirmed in Belo Horizonte and Manhuaçu.
article.articleSummary: Two new mpox cases were registered in Belo Horizonte and Manhuaçu in Minas Gerais, Brazil, raising the state’s total to 17. The infections were confirmed by the State Health Secretariat (SES-MG) on March 25, after being detected on March 18 in both Belo Horizonte and the Zona da Mata region. All patients are male, aged 25–56, with recovery reported and no deaths. Mpox transmission occurs mainly via direct contact with skin lesions, close conversation, and contact with contaminated objects such as bedding and towels. Incubation ranges from 3 to 21 days. Early signs include fever followed by skin lesions that progress from macules to vesicles, pustules, and crusts. Preventive measures emphasize avoiding close contact with affected individuals, not sharing personal items, vaccination for priority groups, and prompt medical care for diagnosis and treatment.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジルのベロオリゾンテとマンフアスで新たなMpox（サル痘）感染が確認
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルにおけるMpox散発症例の確認であり、異常性と継続的曝露のポテンシャルは認められるが、死亡例がなく症例数が限定的。さらなる流行拡大の兆候に関する情報が不足している。
triage.notes: Mpoxは国際的に重要な病原体であり、ブラジルでの継続的な症例確認は監視の対象。ただし現時点では症例数が限定的（州計17例）で死亡例なし。ヒト間感染の可能性と長期曝露リスクが存在するため、今後の発生動向に注視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Deteksi Dini TBC di Sulawesi Barat Menguat: Mengapa Kenaikan Angka Kasus Adalah Kabar Baik?
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Early TB Detection in West Sulawesi Gains Momentum: Why the Rise in Case Numbers Is Good News?
article.articleSummary: West Sulawesi's Health Office (Dinkes P2KB Sulbar) reports a rise in early TB detections in early 2026, indicating sharper surveillance rather than worsened burden. As of February 2026, TB case identifications rose 8% vs. the same period in 2025, with an estimated 4,357 cases for 2026 and 595 cases (13.7%) already identified. Majene recorded the highest increase (44%), Mamuju surpassed the national target by identifying 21.4% of expected cases, and Polewali Mandar rose 13%. Mamasa, Mamuju Tengah, and Pasangkayu showed decreases, prompting stronger Active Case Finding (ACF). The 2026 strategy prioritizes rapid molecular testing (Tes Cepat Molekuler, TCM) and mass screening, with intensified district support and integration into the national Program Hasil Terbaik Cepat (PHTC) to accelerate TB elimination. Transparent data and complete treatment underpin a healthier next generation.

triage.headline_ja: 西スラウェシ州における結核の早期発見が加速：症例数の増加が良いニュースである理由
triage.triage_reason: 結核の症例数増加は実は早期発見能力の向上を反映しており、疾病負担の悪化ではない。国家目標の達成、能動的ケースファインディングの強化という公衆衛生的な肯定的発展を報告しており、IHR基準およびWPRO基準のいずれにも該当しない。
triage.notes: 記事は西スラウェシ州における結核の早期検出能力の向上と監視強化を報告している。症例数増加（8%）は負の指標ではなく、むしろ検出感度の向上を示す肯定的な開発である。国家プログラムへの統合と分子診断検査の拡大など、対応力も整備されている。結核は風土病であり、この地域での段階的改善は周期的な報告の範疇である。

article.articleHeadline: Health officials warn of higher dengue risk
article.articleSummary: Health Bureau officials warn of an elevated dengue fever and chikungunya transmission risk in 2026 as warmer weather coincides with rising mosquito breeding. Breeding levels climbed in February and March, with the ovitrap index reaching 2.2%, up from 0.7% and 1.2% a year earlier. The increase was more pronounced in older districts such as Fai Chi Kei and Barra, where aging buildings and standing water are common risk factors. Authorities have stepped up mosquito control campaigns and urged residents to eliminate stagnant water and install screens to reduce indoor exposure. The findings indicate a heightened local transmission potential despite ongoing control measures, underscoring the need for vigilance in both public spaces and households as temperatures continue to rise in 2026.

triage.headline_ja: 衛生当局がデング熱リスク上昇を警告
triage.triage_reason: マカオ（中国の特別行政区）においてデング熱とチクングニア熱の局所伝播リスク上昇が報告されており、WPROスクリーニング基準（異常性・重症度・流行しやすさ）を複数満たす。政府機関による明示的な警告があり、社会的・政治的関心が認められるため、フルRRA対象。
triage.notes: 記事はマカオ（中国特別行政区）における衛生当局の公式警告を報じており、デング熱とチクングニア熱の蚊媒介感染症として季節的上昇リスクが明記されている。古い建物と停滞水が危険要因とされ、蚊の繁殖指数（オビトラップ指数）が前年比で大幅に上昇している。政府による対策強化と住民への呼びかけが行われており、政治的関心が認められる。ブラジルはBluedot APIが誤付与した地域で、記事本文には関連性なし。

article.articleHeadline: Prefeitura de Diamantino realiza mutirão "Diamantino Limpo, Dengue Zero" em Deciolândia
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: City Hall of Diamantino carries out a mass cleanup drive 'Diamantino Clean, Dengue Zero' in Deciolândia.
article.articleSummary: Diamantino’s City Hall launched the next phase of the mass cleanup campaign Diamantino Limpo, Dengue Zero in the Deciolândia neighborhood, aiming to eliminate Aedes aegypti breeding sites and curb dengue risk. On day one, 30 dumpsters were filled with trash, wood, branches, and debris; throughout the week, road maintenance will include grading, graveling, and pothole repair. The initiative, organized by the Infrastructure and Works Department with the Health Department, is part of an ongoing municipal effort to improve urban conditions and prevent mosquito proliferation. Mayor Chico Mendes said services will reach distant areas; after Deciolândia, the next phase will be at Posto Gil. Secretary Leonildo Costa noted the work follows a defined schedule to maintain roads and local areas. Residents praised the effort, urging others to clean yards and leave debris curbside for collection.

triage.headline_ja: ジアマンティーノ市庁舎、デシオランディアで「ジアマンティーノ・クリーン、デング・ゼロ」一斉清掃キャンペーンを実施
triage.triage_reason: デング熱の予防的な清掃キャンペーン報道であり、アウトブレイク情報ではない。患者発生や疫学的異常性の言及がなく、IHR基準およびWPRO基準の該当なし。
triage.notes: 本記事はジアマンティーノ市（ブラジル、マットグロッソ州）における定期的な蚊対策キャンペーンの実施報告である。デング熱患者の発生状況、発症数、重症度、異常な流行パターンなどの疫学情報は記載されていない。感染症シグナルとしてのピックアップ対象ではない。

article.articleHeadline: Paraná em atenção: Américas somam mais de mil casos de sarampo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Paraná on alert: The Americas tally more than 1,000 measles cases.
article.articleSummary: According to the Pan American Health Organization, over 1,000 measles cases were recorded in the Americas in the first weeks of 2026, a surge from early 2025. Paraná, Brazil, is on alert, though no cases have been confirmed. Vaccination remains the main protection; national second-dose coverage for the measles-mumps-rubella (MMR) vaccine is about 75%, well below the 95% target, with uneven distribution among states. Paraná's coverage is above the national average but its second dose is still short of the ideal goal. Brazil was certified measles-free in 2024, but immunity gaps persist. Adults should review vaccination status, especially before travel; two doses are recommended up to age 29, and at least one dose for ages 30–59. The childhood schedule uses 12 and 15 months. In addition, maintain hygiene and seek care for fever, rash, cough, or runny nose.

triage.headline_ja: パラナ州が警戒態勢：アメリカ大陸ではしか患者が1,000例以上
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル（パラナ州）ではしかを含む3つの予防接種対象疾患の流行リスク警戒が発令されており、予防接種率が目標（95%）に達していない（75%）というワクチンギャップが確認されている。IHR基準で異常性と国際的拡大リスクが該当し、WPROスクリーニングでも流行しやすさと長期曝露の可能性が認められるため、フルRRA実施の価値あり。
triage.notes: 記事はブラジル（パラノー州）のはしかアラート を主題としており、スペイン（カナリア諸島）はBluedot APIが付与しているが、サマリーの主題はブラジルのワクチンギャップと流行リスクである。したがってverified_locationsはBrazilのみとした。2024年のはしか排除認定から免疫ギャップが再び生じている点が重要。

article.articleHeadline: H1N1 está entre vírus furtados na Unicamp, diz site
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: H1N1 influenza virus is among the stolen viruses at Unicamp, site says.
article.articleSummary: H1N1 and H3N2 influenza A viruses were among biological materials stolen from Unicamp's Virology Laboratory in Campinas, Brazil. A former professor, Soledad Palameta Miller, and her husband Michael Edward Miller are under investigation; the Federal Police say there was no external contamination and that all samples were recovered, remaining on campus. The theft also involved other human and swine samples, with materials kept secret by the Ministério da Agricultura e Pecuária. The laboratory is a biosafety level 3 facility; Brazil is building a level 4 facility in Campinas expected in 2027. The recovered samples were found about 350 meters from the original lab at the Faculdade de Engenharia de Alimentos, and also at the Tropical Diseases Laboratory and the Cell Culture Laboratory (Institute of Biology). Influenza A H1N1 and H3N2 routinely cause seasonal flu; a local expert notes these are biosafety level 2 agents, implying moderate risk to people and environment.

triage.headline_ja: ユニキャンプで盗まれたウイルスの中にH1N1がある、とサイトが報じている
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルの研究機関からのバイオセーフティレベル2-3の病原体盗難という異常事象が報告されていますが、これは感染症の自然発生ではなく施設管理問題です。回収されたとの報告があり、実際の公開感染リスクは現時点で低く評価されます。ただし、病原体流出の可能性と高度研究施設からの盗難という社会政治的関心の高まりから、継続監視が必要です。
triage.notes: このイベントは自然発生の感染症アウトブレイクではなく、バイオセーフティレベル3研究施設からの病原体盗難・管理破綻事象です。盗難対象は季節性インフルエンザ病原体（H1N1、H3N2）で、記事によれば回収済みと報告されており、直接的な公衆衛生上の脅威は限定的と考えられます。ただし、高度研究施設からの病原体流出のリスク、捜査状況、ブラジルでの新しいレベル4施設建設計画などを考慮し、経過観察対象として扱うことが適切です。

article.articleHeadline: Relatório de Monitoramento de Ovitrampas revela áreas de risco em Brasilândia
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ovitrap Monitoring Report Reveals Risk Areas in Brasilândia.
article.articleSummary: As of March 26, 2026, Brasilândia’s Municipal Health Secretariat, Endemias Coordination, released Week 9 ovitrap monitoring results, highlighting Aedes aegypti egg-density hotspots—the mosquito that transmits dengue, chikungunya and Zika. Traps are located in Assentamento Almanara (1), Reassentamento Novo Porto João André (5), Aldeia Ofaié (1), Distrito Debrasa (3), Condomínio Beleza do Rio Verde (2), and Brasilândia (about 40 traps). The map uses colors: blue 0 eggs, green 1–20, yellow 21–50, orange 51–100, red 101+ eggs; red/orange areas signal need for intensified surveillance and vector control. Ovitraps consist of a dark water-filled pot with a wooden paddle to attract ovipositing females; eggs are collected weekly, lab-analyzed, and discarded to interrupt reproduction. Coordinator Carlos Rodrigues notes ovitraps complement, not replace, elimination of standing water, serving as an entomological surveillance tool to trigger targeted mutirões, home visits, and ongoing monitoring.

triage.headline_ja: 卵トラップ監視報告書がブラジランディアのリスク地域を明らかに
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルにおけるAedes aegyptiの卵密度ホットスポットに関する監視報告で、デング熱・チクングニア・ジカウイルスの媒介蚊の活動を示す異常な現象が報告されている。ただし、現段階では死亡者や深刻な患者数についての記載がなく、国際的な拡大リスクについても明記されていないため、情報不足の状態である。
triage.notes: 本記事は媒介蚊の卵密度監視結果に関する技術的報告であり、実際の症例報告や患者数については言及されていない。ブラジルの地方保健当局による積極的な監視活動が確認されている。継続的な情報収集が推奨される。

article.articleHeadline: Balai Veteriner Lampung minta peternak kendalikan PMK dari kandang
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Lampung Veterinary Office asks farmers to curb Foot-and-Mouth Disease from the barn
article.articleSummary: Foot-and-Mouth Disease (FMD) action in Lampung Province, Indonesia: veterinarians urge farmers in Lampung Timur to implement in-barn controls, report cases promptly, isolate sick cattle, and restrict livestock movements. Bandarlampung's Balai Veteriner Lampung reinforces disciplined biosecurity, epidemiological investigations (case tracing, interviews, sampling of sick animals and carcasses) to speed diagnosis and containment. Provincial authorities through Dinas Peternakan Lampung coordinate field support, bolstering biosecurity, accelerating disinfection, and farmer education, with vaccination promoted to boost herd immunity and curb spread. Emphasis on laboratory confirmation and surveillance; no specific case counts are provided. The response targets Lampung Province and its districts, aiming to prevent wider outbreak while safeguarding cattle health.

triage.headline_ja: ランプン獣医局、農家に家畜舎からの口蹄疫の抑制を要請
triage.triage_reason: インドネシア（ランプン州）における口蹄疫の感染事例が報告されており、家畜衛生上の懸念が存在するが、人間への感染リスクや国際的な拡大可能性について情報が不足している。詳細な症例数や死亡情報がないため、フルRRAの前に追加情報の収集が必要。
triage.notes: 口蹄疫は家畜感染症であり、人間への直接的な公衆衛生脅威は限定的。記事は獣医当局による管理対応を強調しており、農家への生物防御措置の実施が進行中。症例数、致死率、感染拡大状況の具体的数値が記載されていないため、継続的な情報監視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Antibiotic resistance behind 87% of typhoid economic burden: Lancet
article.articleSummary: In 2023, antibiotic-resistant typhoid infections accounted for at least 87% of India’s typhoid-related economic burden, totaling Rs 12,300 crore. Children under 10 incurred the highest burden, contributing over half of costs. Maharashtra, Uttar Pradesh, Andhra Pradesh, Telangana, Tamil Nadu and West Bengal together account for about 51% of national costs. Households borne 91% of expenses, with around 70,000 families facing catastrophic health expenditure. Typhoid fever is transmitted via contaminated food or water and presents with high fever, fatigue, headache and stomach pain. The study, by London School of Hygiene and Tropical Medicine and Christian Medical College, Vellore, published in The Lancet Regional Health Southeast Asia, provides evidence to support introducing the typhoid conjugate vaccine into India’s national immunisation schedule and to guide antibiotic resistance control and health-financing policy decisions.

triage.headline_ja: 抗生物質耐性がインドのチフス経済負担の87%を占める：ランセット
triage.triage_reason: チフスの抗生物質耐性に関する疫学研究報告で、インド国内の経済的影響は大きいが、新規発生事例の詳細が不明であり、現在の流行状況の深刻度判定に情報不足がある。
triage.notes: 記事は2023年のチフス経済負担に関する研究論文の公表であり、現在進行中の流行事例ではなく過去データ分析報告である。抗生物質耐性という公衆衛生課題の重要性は認識されるが、新規病例の発生数、重症度、感染拡大速度などの詳細が不明。ワクチン導入推奨という予防政策との関連は注目される。

article.articleHeadline: Stop Rabies Empowers Communities Toward a Rabies-Free Philippines - Manila Standard
article.articleSummary: Rabies remains a major public health threat in the Philippines, causing 300–400 deaths and about 4 million animal bite cases annually. In the first two months of 2026, 17 human rabies cases were reported, with 13 linked to bites from unvaccinated stray animals. Boehringer Ingelheim’s Stop Rabies program, in collaboration with GARC, expands vaccination, education, and surveillance to communities including Puerto Galera, Marinduque, Laguna (Los Baños, Calauan), and Bacolod City, with Victorias planned. The initiative delivers school-based education on responsible pet ownership, post-exposure treatment, and free vaccination and neutering for dogs and cats. In 2025, the program vaccinated 4,837 animals, neutered 294, and educated 588 students across four schools; in March 2026, Los Baños reached over 8,000 students across 11 schools via UP Los Baños Veterinary Teaching Hospital. Stop Rabies pursues Zero by 30 under SD4G, expanding IEC campaigns and donor support for a rabies-free Philippines.

triage.headline_ja: ストップレイビス、フィリピンを狂犬病のない国へ向けて地域社会を支援 - マニラ・スタンダード
triage.triage_reason: 狂犬病の継続的な脅威と既知の感染事例が報告されているが、本記事の焦点は予防イニシアティブの実施例であり、新規のアウトブレイク判断や急速な蔓延リスクの兆候が明確でない。情報が不足しており続報の注視が必要。
triage.notes: 狂犬病は既知の地風土病であり、2026年第1・2四半期の17例報告は継続的な流行を示すが、新規アウトブレイク状況ではない。記事は予防プログラムの進捗報告が主題であるため、シグナルトリアージではWATCHとした。狂犬病の発生動向と制御状況の継続監視が推奨される。

article.articleHeadline: Bệnh tay chân miệng gia tăng, nhiều trẻ nhập viện trong tình trạng nặng tại TP.HCM
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Hand, Foot, and Mouth Disease on the Rise, Many Children Hospitalized in Serious Condition in Ho Chi Minh City
article.articleSummary: Ho Chi Minh City faces a rebound in Hand, Foot, and Mouth Disease (HFMD) with more severe cases. At the city’s pediatric hospitals, about 30 inpatients are treated daily at the Children's Hospital No. 1 Infectious–Neurology ward, with roughly one‑third at severity 2B or higher; outpatient HFMD cases total around 70. A 10‑month‑old from Tay Ninh was admitted after high fever and widespread vesicles. EV71 infections are common in this surge, a strain linked to neurological and cardiovascular complications and rapid progression. The Ho Chi Minh City Hospital for Pediatrics No. 2 reports 81 inpatients, including 10 at level 2B. The Ho Chi Minh City Center for Disease Control (HCDC) logged 837 HFMD cases in the past week, up 97.1% from the four‑week average, with 2 deaths this week (year‑to‑date total 3). 79 new outbreaks (30 in schools, 49 in the community); year‑to‑date 286 outbreaks, 75 ongoing. Preschools have intensified hygiene, handwashing, dedicated supplies, and staff/parent awareness campaigns.

triage.headline_ja: 手足口病の増加、ホーチミン市で多くの子どもが重症で入院
triage.triage_reason: ベトナムのホーチミン市で手足口病（特にEV71株）の急速な増加が報告されており、IHR基準（異常性・重症度）とWPRO基準（重症度・流行可能性・管理性）の複数に該当する。死亡例があり、公衆衛生上の懸念が明確である。
triage.notes: EV71は神経学的・心血管合併症と急速な進行に関連する危険な株。ホーチミン市の複数の小児科病院で重症患者（2B以上）が増加。過去1週間で837例、前の4週平均から97.1%増加。年初から3例の死亡。学校（30箇所）と地域社会（49箇所）での新規アウトブレイク。管理可能性への質問は「国/地域が外部支援を必要とするか」であり、現在のところサマリーに国際支援要請は明記されていないため「Yes」と判定したが、これは潜在的リスク評価。

article.articleHeadline: She couldn't conceive despite IVF and good test results: How doctors found a silent and overlooked TB
article.articleSummary: Genital tuberculosis diagnosed in Mumbai, India. Kavita Seth, 27, infertile for four years; a tubal patency test showed blocked fallopian tubes, and laparoscopy revealed severe tubal damage with tubercular nodules; biopsy confirmed genital TB. After six months of anti-tubercular therapy (ATT), she was cured but irreversible tubal damage left IVF as the only option, which produced a child. A second Mumbai case from Sion showed multiple uterine lesions during repeated IVF failures; she required nine months of ATT after prior TB treatment. Genital TB stems from airborne TB bacteria, typically from a prior pulmonary infection, and can affect female reproductive organs (fallopian tubes, uterus) and male organs (testes). Symptoms may be mild or absent, delaying diagnosis. Standard TB treatment is six months: two months intensive four-drug phase (isoniazid, rifampicin, pyrazinamide, ethambutol) followed by four months of isoniazid and rifampicin; drug-resistant cases need longer regimens (9–20 months).

triage.headline_ja: IVFと良好な検査結果にもかかわらず妊娠できず：医師が発見した静かで見落とされた結核
triage.triage_reason: 稀な臨床表現型（生殖器結核）の症例報告であり、異常性・診断困難性は認められるが、公衆衛生への深刻な影響、国際的拡大リスク、行動制限の必要性は記事から明確でない。情報不足のため経過観察が適切。
triage.notes: 本記事は生殖器結核の稀な臨床症例（インドにおける不妊患者での診断遅延）に関する症例報告型の医療ニュースである。集団発生や流行の兆候、公衆衛生学的な新規のリスク要因は記載されていない。結核の既知の合併症に関する個別症例の報道であり、シグナルレベルの異常ではなく、医学的知見の共有と考えられる。

article.articleHeadline: Nipah Virus Outbreak 2026 LIVE Updates: Will there be another lockdown? Kerala issues high alert from April to September 2026 based on previous NiV outbreak patterns
article.articleSummary: Nipah virus (NiV) outbreak alert in Kerala, India, with a high alert activated for April–September 2026 based on past NiV patterns. NiV is a high-risk zoonotic pathogen, with case fatality historically ranging 40–75%. Authorities warn of seasonal risks linked to fruit bats and call for heightened surveillance, early detection, and strict infection control measures. Kerala has experienced Nipah outbreaks since 2018, often presenting with severe respiratory illness and fatal encephalitis; there is no approved vaccine or specific antiviral treatment. Transmission is primarily associated with fruit bats, with potential human-to-human transmission in certain settings. The article emphasizes ongoing public health measures and monitoring and does not specify current case counts. The emphasis remains on a high-alert posture for 2026 rather than any confirmed lockdowns.

triage.headline_ja: ニパールウイルス感染症の流行2026年ライブアップデート：ロックダウンはあるのか？ケララ州は過去のニパール流行パターンに基づき2026年4月～9月に高度警戒を発令

triage.notes: 記事は2026年4月～9月の季節的警戒活性化を発表するもので、現在の確定症例報告はない。ニパールウイルスは過去ケララ州で複数回流行（2018年以降）しており、致死率40-75%と高い。フルーツバットとの関連が強調されており、ヒト-ヒト感染のリスク指摘あり。現段階では予防的警戒であるため、実際の患者発生報告が入ったら速やかにPICKUPに昇格すべき。

article.articleHeadline: 식약처, 식용얼음 검사...공차 매장 2곳 적발 '세균수 초과'·매머드익스프레스 1곳 '대장균 양성' - 굿모닝경제
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: MFDS Inspects Edible Ice... Two Gong Cha Stores Cited for Exceeding Bacterial Counts; One Mammoth Express Store Positive for E. coli - Good Morning Economy.
article.articleSummary: South Korea’s Ministry of Food and Drug Safety (MFDS) inspected 418 edible-ice samples from coffee shops and fast-food outlets from Feb 23 to Mar 6, aiming to bolster hygiene as spring demand rises. Tests targeted Salmonella, Escherichia coli, and overall bacterial counts. Seven samples were noncompliant: six exceeded total bacterial counts and one exceeded E. coli. Seven eateries temporarily stopped using their ice machines and conducted thorough cleanings, disinfection, and filter replacement to ensure hygienic ice production. Noncompliant outlets included Gong Cha branches in Dongjak District (Seoul) and Hwaseong Bongdam; Between the Clouds in Nam District, Gwangju; Mammoth Express in Yangcheon District Office Istaville branch (Seoul) with E. coli detected; I Got Everything at Sejong Government Convention Center; Atti in Boeun County, Chungbuk; Twenty Percent Coffee at Hwajeong Hills State, Gwangju. MFDS distributed an ice-maker sanitation guide and pledged ongoing preventive sampling during peak periods.

triage.headline_ja: 食薬処、食用氷検査...ゴンチャ売場2か所「菌数超過」検出・マンモスエクスプレス1か所「大腸菌陽性」

triage.notes: 記事は韓国の食品衛生当局による定期的な衛生検査結果の報告であり、実際の感染症患者の発生を示唆するイベントではない。発生地域にはベトナムが含まれているが、記事サマリーに基づくとイベントは韓国内の商業施設の検査が主題であり、ベトナムでの実際のイベント発生は記述されていない。対象国リストに韓国は含まれないため、verified_locationsは空とすべきだが、ベトナムが発生地域に明示されているため検証上の注記として記載。実質的には公衆衛生上の危機的シグナルではない。

article.articleHeadline: Con đường chính lây truyền bệnh lậu
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The primary route of transmission of gonorrhea.
article.articleSummary: Gonorrhea, caused by Neisseria gonorrhoeae, is primarily transmitted through sexual contact. The bacterium infects moist mucosal surfaces including the urethra, cervix, uterus, vagina, penis, rectum, eyes, and throat. Unsafe vaginal, anal, and oral sex are the main routes; mother-to-child transmission at birth can cause neonatal conjunctivitis. Oral sex can spread infection to the pharynx, often with mild symptoms that are easy to confuse with common throat infections. Untreated infection can cause infertility in both men and women, pelvic inflammatory disease, ectopic pregnancy, epididymitis, and urethral strictures; in newborns it can cause conjunctivitis leading to blindness. Disseminated gonococcal infection may occur with fever and multi-system involvement (skin, joints, heart, meninges). Antibiotic resistance is rising; no vaccine exists, though the meningococcal B vaccine (4CMenB) shows potential cross-protection. Prevention focuses on correct, consistent condom use and notifying partners.

triage.headline_ja: 淋病の主な伝播経路
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は淋病の伝播経路および臨床特性に関する教育的・啓発的内容であり、新たな感染症イベント（発生・流行）の報告ではない。IHR基準およびWPROスクリーニング基準に該当しない。
triage.notes: 記事は淋病の病態、伝播経路、合併症、耐性菌の出現、予防策についての一般的な医学情報であり、特定の発生事例やアウトブレイク報告ではない。教育コンテンツと判断される。

article.articleHeadline: Vi rút độc lực cao đe dọa bùng phát dịch tay chân miệng ở TPHCM
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Highly virulent virus threatens to trigger an outbreak of hand, foot and mouth disease in Ho Chi Minh City.
article.articleSummary: Hand, foot, and mouth disease (HFMD) is resurging in Ho Chi Minh City with atypical presentations. Highly virulent Enterovirus 71 (EV71) detected in about 25% of tested samples. As of week 11, 2026, Ho Chi Minh City reported 7,294 HFMD cases, up 241% year-on-year, including 98 severe cases (grade 2b or higher), up 4.6x. Week 11 saw 837 cases. Since year start, 288 outbreaks have been identified—162 in schools and 126 in the community. Clinicians warn lesions may appear in hidden areas (buttocks, around the anus, or edges of fingers/toes) with symptoms like mouth sores, poor appetite, and drooling; some children lack obvious rashes. Authorities have enacted containment measures: enhanced surveillance, rapid isolation and treatment, improved school hygiene including handwashing facilities, and prompt sample testing for severe cases. Parents should perform comprehensive checks and seek urgent care for danger signs such as fever >39°C, seizures, difficulty breathing, or prolonged crying.

triage.headline_ja: 強い病原性を持つウイルスがホーチミン市での手足口病の流行を脅かす
triage.triage_reason: Enterovirus 71による手足口病がホーチミン市で急増（前年比241%）し、重症例が4.6倍に増加。高い病原性、異常な臨床像、学校での集団発生が報告されており、IHR基準3項目、WPROスクリーニング基準5項目すべてに該当。
triage.notes: Enterovirus 71は致命的な脳炎を引き起こす可能性がある高リスク病原体。検出率25%、重症例の急速な増加（4.6倍）、学校での集団発生（162件）が報告されている。当該地域では既に公式な対策が実施されており、WHO/WPRO への通知が妥当。

article.articleHeadline: 2 wild bats found in Escondido test positive for rabies
article.articleSummary: Rabies detected in two wild bats found in Escondido, San Diego County. The first bat was discovered Saturday around 4 p.m. near the White Oak Villas condo complex and collected by the San Diego Humane Society. The second bat was found Sunday just after 10 a.m. at the San Diego Zoo Safari Park, on a rock wall outside the Okavango Restaurant; it was not a park bat and was safely collected by staff. These are the fourth and fifth rabid bats identified in the county this year, with the County Public Health Laboratory confirming infection. Residents with potential contact should call County Public Health Services at 619-692-8499; if exposure occurs, wash the area thoroughly and seek medical advice immediately. Rabies is preventable; without prompt post-exposure treatment, it is almost always fatal. The last local human rabies case was in 2001 (dog bite in the Philippines).

triage.headline_ja: エスコンディドで発見された野生コウモリ2頭が狂犬病陽性反応

article.articleHeadline: 健康服务零距离 结核防控入人心
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Zero-Distance Health Services: TB Prevention and Control Reaches People's Hearts.
article.articleSummary: On 24 March 2026, in Shangli County’s Changping Township Health Center, with the Changping Township Epidemic Prevention and Health Care Station, a World Tuberculosis Day outreach event was held in the outpatient hall. The theme, All-out Action, Full Commitment, Widespread Participation, End TB, aimed to strengthen grassroots TB prevention and health literacy. The setup included LED banners and science posters as staff explained TB transmission, typical symptoms, standard treatment workflows, and China’s national policy of free TB treatment, stressing early detection and treatment and dispelling misconceptions. The event also offered free blood pressure checks and health counseling, along with guidance on ventilation, personal protection, and healthy living during the spring respiratory illness peak. Over 200 TB prevention materials were distributed, and more than 70 on-site consultations were provided, bringing health services directly to residents.

triage.headline_ja: ゼロディスタンス健康サービス：結核予防と管理が人々の心に届く
triage.triage_reason: 本イベントは結核予防啓発キャンペーンであり、疾患の新規発生、アウトブレイク、または異常な感染症危機を示していない。IHR基準およびWPRO基準のいずれにも該当しない。
triage.notes: 本記事は2026年3月24日の世界結核デー啓発イベントであり、既知疾患の予防・教育キャンペーンに過ぎない。感染症危機管理の対象となるシグナル（新規発生、流行、重症患者集積など）は含まれていない。

article.articleHeadline: O que é o vírus Oropouche? Doença já infectou mais de 5 milhões no Brasil
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: What is the Oropouche virus? The disease has already infected more than 5 million people in Brazil.
article.articleSummary: Oropouche virus has re-emerged in Brazil after the 2023 outbreak with more than 30,000 confirmed cases and the country’s first death. Since then, the virus has spread from the Amazon to all states, expanding regional risk. Brazilian estimates reach about 5.5 million infections, possibly up to 9.4 million across Latin America and the Caribbean. Many cases go unregistered due to mild symptoms or diagnostic gaps; in Manaus, about 300,000 infections were estimated in 2023–2024, far above official counts. The arbovirus causes dengue-like illness—fever, headache, malaise—with a small fraction progressing to severe disease (≈1 in 1,000). A newly identified lineage from genetic recombination may boost transmissibility. Unlike dengue, Zika, and chikungunya, the vector is Culicoides paraensis (maruim), breeding in humid, organic-rich habitats; fumigation is largely ineffective. WHO calls for accelerated prevention and control as the virus has circulated for decades but is rising recently.

triage.headline_ja: オロポウシウイルスとは何か？この病気はすでにブラジルで500万人以上に感染している
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3項目該当（深刻な影響、異常/予想外、国際的拡大リスク）。WPRO基準でも4項目該当。既に大規模な感染（推定550万人以上）と死亡例が報告され、従来の媒介蚊対策が無効な新型系統の出現により、国際支援が必要な段階にある。
triage.notes: オロポウシウイルスは2023年のアウトブレイク以降、ブラジル全州に拡大。推定感染者数550万人以上（ラテンアメリカ・カリブ海地域で最大940万人）。初の死亡例が確認された。新しい遺伝子型の出現により感染性が増加している可能性がある。媒介蚊（Culicoides paraensis）の防除が従来の方法では困難であり、WHOが予防・対策の加速を要請。

article.articleHeadline: UK's GSK Allies With Shanghai Pharma to Bring Hepatitis B Jab Back to China
article.articleSummary: UK's GlaxoSmithKline (GSK) teams with Shanghai Pharmaceutical to reintroduce Engerix B hepatitis B vaccine to China, via SPH Kyuan Trade, leveraging cold chain logistics and market reach. Engerix B was approved in China in 1994; supply ended in 2022 amid market and strategy changes. Hepatitis B can transmit from mother to child, via blood and sexual contact; vaccination is the best prevention. China began vaccination in 1992; newborn vaccination has been free since 2005, helping drop prevalence from 9.8% in 1992 to 5.9% in 2020. Newborn coverage is 99.6%, but adults born before 2002 have only 14.7–33.6%; those over 30 account for 92% of infections. China is shifting to lifelong vaccination coverage; improving adult vaccination willingness and convenience remains a challenge. GSK was the largest hepatitis B vaccine maker as of 2024; in China, North China Pharmaceutical and Kangtai Biological Products are competitors, ranked 3rd and 6th per QYResearch.

article.articleHeadline: Rosalia cancels concert midstream for first time over food poisoning
article.articleSummary: Rosalia, 33, canceled her Unipol Forum, Milan concert midstream due to a serious case of food poisoning, marking the first mid-performance abort in her career. Onstage she said she’d been sick since the start, vomiting and in extreme pain, and despite attempts to continue she ultimately walked off and canceled the show. The Milan incident occurs during the Lux tour, which began in Lyon and included Paris and Zurich prior to Milan. If she recovers, she is slated to perform Monday in Madrid at Movistar Arena, then European dates in Lisbon, Barcelona, Amsterdam, Antwerp, Cologne, and two London shows (May 5–6), followed by a US/Canada leg including Miami, New York, Boston, Toronto, Chicago, and Los Angeles, and later Latin America (Bogotá, Santiago, Buenos Aires, Rio de Janeiro) with Mexico City, Monterrey, Tlajomulco de Zuniga, and San Juan on Sept 3.

article.articleHeadline: Pune Rabies Vaccine Dog Bite: श्वान चावल्यानंतर २४ तासांत लस घ्या; पुण्यात मोफत रेबीज उपचार उपलब्ध
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Pune Rabies Vaccine Dog Bite: Get the vaccine within 24 hours of a dog bite; Free rabies treatment available in Pune.
article.articleSummary: Rabies vaccines for humans and dogs work with inactivated rabies virus to stimulate immunity without causing disease. In humans, post-exposure prophylaxis (PEP) after a dog bite, if given promptly, can provide complete protection against rabies. The vaccine prompts production of antibodies that neutralize the virus before it reaches the brain. In dogs, the vaccine activates the immune system to produce protective antibodies; regular primary doses and booster shots maintain protection and curb transmission. The article notes free rabies treatment in Pune and advises vaccination within 24 hours of a dog bite.

triage.headline_ja: プネのイヌ咬傷後狂犬病ワクチン：イヌ咬傷後24時間以内にワクチン接種を受けてください；プネで無料狂犬病治療が利用可能

triage.notes: 記事は狂犬病ワクチンと治療に関する情報啓発記事で、イヌ咬傷後の予防接種の重要性と地域で利用可能な無料治療を強調。特定の流行クラスター、死亡数の増加、または異常なイベント報告はなし。インドでは狂犬病が継続的な公衆衛生上の懸念であり、イヌを介した長期的な曝露リスクがあるため、スクリーニング基準2項目に該当。ただし記事自体は予防啓発キャンペーン的性質のため、IHR基準には該当せず、トリアージは「WATCH」と判定。

article.articleHeadline: World Health Day 2026: From Nipah alert in India, to New COVID variant Cicada spreading rapidly - Top headlines of the day
article.articleSummary: Nipah alerts activated in Kerala, India, with a seasonal Nipah virus infection alert running April-September, urging early surveillance, rapid response, and public awareness for a virus with 40-75% fatality and potential severe respiratory symptoms. In parallel, a new COVID-19 variant, BA.3.2, nicknamed 'Cicada', is spreading rapidly in the United States and internationally. The World Health Organization notes BA.3.2 has been detected in more than 20 countries and accounts for up to 30% of cases in some regions, though there has not been a major outbreak comparable to delta or omicron variants. Together, these headlines mark World Health Day 2026 as authorities monitor ongoing transmission risks and emphasize surveillance, testing, and public health readiness worldwide.

article.articleHeadline: Vacationers beware - CDC issues travel warning as 'life-threatening' disease sees rising number of cases
article.articleSummary: CDC warns travelers returning to the US from Cuba, Vietnam and Samoa about rising dengue fever cases. As of 2026, 496 US cases have been reported. Dengue is transmitted by Aedes mosquitoes in tropical/subtropical regions and is not spread person-to-person. About 25% of infections cause symptoms: fever, nausea, vomiting, rash, muscle and joint pains, and minor bleeding; severe dengue (dengue hemorrhagic fever) can cause abdominal pain, internal bleeding, rapid breathing, persistent vomiting, shock, and death. Authorities note higher-than-expected cases among travelers from Afghanistan, Bangladesh, Bolivia, Colombia, Cook Islands, Cuba, Guyana, Maldives, Mali, Mauritania, New Caledonia, Pakistan, Samoa, Sudan, Timor-Leste and Vietnam. Prevention includes EPA-registered repellents, long sleeves/pants, and air-conditioned or screened rooms; avoid peak mosquito activity after sunrise and before sunset. After recovery, immunity is serotype-specific; a dengue vaccine exists for certain US children 9–16 with prior infection in endemic areas, requiring three doses over a year.

triage.headline_ja: 旅行者注意 - CDCが生命を脅かす病気の症例増加に関する渡航警告を発表
triage.triage_reason: デング熱の多国間での症例増加、米国への輸入症例496例報告、CDCによる公式な渡航警告発出という異常事象。IHR基準3つ以上該当（公衆衛生影響・異常性・国際的拡大・渡航制限リスク）。
triage.notes: 記事は複数国でのデング熱増加を報告しているが、対象国リスト内で検証可能な発生国はベトナムのみ。キューバ、サモア、アフガニスタン、バングラデシュなどは記事で言及されているが対象国外。米国への輸入症例報告が主軸であり、複数の発生地からの多国間的な症例増加パターンが強調されている。CDCの公式警告発出により政府関心・社会的関心も高い。

article.articleHeadline: 3 ca tử vong do tay chân miệng: Bác sĩ Bệnh viện Nhi đồng 1 ra cảnh báo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Three deaths due to hand-foot-mouth disease: a doctor from Children's Hospital 1 issues a warning.
article.articleSummary: Ho Chi Minh City, March 9–15, 2026, recorded 837 new hand-foot-mouth disease (HFMD) cases, up 97% from the 4-week average of 424; two additional pediatric deaths bring the year-to-date toll to 3. Hospitals are treating 138 patients from other provinces, many severely ill. Children’s Hospital 1 issued an urgent warning. HFMD is an acute enterovirus infection with vesicular lesions in the mouth and on hands, feet, buttocks, or knees, mainly affecting children under 5; peaks occur March–May and September–December. Dr. Dư Tuấn Quy, head of Infectious Diseases–Neurology at Nhi Đồng 1, reports 30 hospitalized children, 7 severe; some cases lack classic rash and may appear on hidden areas or only at nail margins. Parents should conduct thorough body checks during bathing, monitor fever, mouth pain, drooling, and appetite, and seek prompt care. If diagnosed, children should stay home to prevent spread. Urgent-care signs include fever >39°C with neurological or respiratory symptoms or seizures. Home measures: isolate, at least 7 days off school, masks, hand hygiene, surface cleaning, daily baths, and easily digestible foods.

triage.headline_ja: 手足口病による3人の死亡：小児病院1の医師が警告を発令
triage.triage_reason: ベトナムのホーチミン市で手足口病（HFMD）の急速な増加（97%上昇）と3人の死亡（年間累計）が報告されており、IHR基準の「異常性」「重症度」および「WPROスクリーニング基準の複数項目」に該当。医療機関からの正式な警告が発令されており、社会的・政治的関心が存在する。
triage.notes: 手足口病（HFMD）はエンテロウイルス感染症であり、主に5歳未満の児童に影響。ホーチミン市での過去1週間の新規症例数は837件で、4週間平均424件から97%の大幅増加。死亡例3件、入院患者138名（他省からも）。小児病院1からの正式な警告により、医療機関レベルでの重大性が確認されている。季節性感染症ではあるが、報告された死亡率と症例数の急増はリスク上昇の指標。

article.articleHeadline: Số ca tay chân miệng tăng mạnh tại TP HCM, xuất hiện chủng EV71 nguy hiểm
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Hand, foot and mouth disease cases surge in Ho Chi Minh City, with the emergence of the dangerous EV71 strain.
article.articleSummary: HFMD cases surge in Ho Chi Minh City with emergence of the virulent Enterovirus 71 (EV71) strain. By week 11 of 2026, the city reports 7,294 HFMD cases, up 241.3% from 2025, including 98 severe (level 2b+), 1.3% of cases (4.6-fold higher than last year). Week 11 alone added 837 new cases, up 97.1% from the four-week average. Since January 2026, 288 outbreaks have been detected: 162 in schools and 126 in the community. EV71 was found in 6 of 24 samples (25%), a strain linked to higher virulence and risk of complications, especially in children under 5. At Children's Hospital 1, 30 HFMD patients are treated, including 7 severe; several cases show atypical lesions on buttocks, perianal area, or sparse rash at finger/toe edges. Authorities urge vigilance, handwashing, school notifications, systematic sampling for severity 2b+, and enhanced hospital training to curb spread.

triage.headline_ja: ホーチミン市での手足口病患者数が急増、危険なEV71株が出現
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3項目該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）し、WPROスクリーニング基準でも重症度・流行しやすさ・長期曝露が該当。EV71の毒性株出現と急速な症例増加により、フルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: EV71は過去のアウトブレイク（2011年）で高い死亡率を示した株。今週の症例数が前週比97.1%増、前年比241.3%増の急速な上昇傾向。小児5歳未満での合併症リスク高い。学校・コミュニティでの広がりと重症患者の増加が確認されている。

article.articleHeadline: 梅毒在中国的60年： 从"基本消灭"到年增64万例_手机网易网
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Sixty Years of Syphilis in China: From 'Basically Eliminated' to an Annual Increase of 640,000 Cases.
article.articleSummary: Syphilis is resurging globally. In China, new cases surpassed 640,000 in 2025, the second-highest Class B infectious-disease burden after hepatitis, up 100,000 from 2023. Globally, WHO (2022) estimates 8 million new infections in 15–49-year-olds, 700,000 congenital syphilis cases, and 390,000 adverse pregnancy outcomes; HIV new infections around 1.3 million. The United States reached the highest syphilis level in over a decade in 2022 (≈203,500 cases); the UK and Japan also report rising rates by 2024–2026. China’s historical elimination in the 1960s gave way to growth: 1999 80,406 cases; 2009 327,433; 2019 535,819. Key drivers include urban migrant and sex-work networks after ending mandatory premarital screening in 2003. By 2020, latent infection accounted for 84.7% of new cases; congenital syphilis fell to 6.3 per 100,000 births in 2023, while those aged 55+ now represent ~40% of new infections. No vaccine exists; stigma and behavior changes hinder control.

triage.headline_ja: 中国における60年の梅毒：「基本的に消滅」から年間640,000例の増加へ
triage.triage_reason: 梅毒が中国で年間640,000例を超える大規模な再興を示しており、IHR基準（深刻な公衆衛生影響・異常性）を満たし、複数国での急速な増加傾向が国際的懸念を示唆している。
triage.notes: 記事はグローバルなトレンド（米国、英国、日本における梅毒増加）に言及しているが、焦点は中国における過去60年の歴史的軌跡と現在の大規模な再興にある。中国は対象国リストに含まれるため verified_locations に含める。また HIV、肝炎、先天性梅毒の複数の感染症が言及されており、公衆衛生上の複合的な課題を示唆している。ワクチン非存在、スティグマ、行動変化の困難性が管理可能性に懸念を示す。

article.articleHeadline: Jun Ji Hyun Kembali Lewat Film Colony, Terjebak Wabah Misterius yang Mencekam
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Jun Ji-hyun Returns Through the Film Colony, Trapped in a Chilling, Mysterious Outbreak.
article.articleSummary: Korean thriller film Colony unfolds in a quarantined building after a mysterious virus outbreak, causing deaths and transforming victims into unpredictable, dangerous beings. Jun Ji-hyun stars as Kwon Se Jung, a biotech expert and leader of the survivors, who navigates the crisis alongside former husband Han Gyu Sung (Go Soo). Directed by Yeon Sang-ho, renowned for Train to Busan and Peninsula, Colony follows Se Jung as she analyzes the virus’s behavior and evolution to save the trapped group. The outbreak centers inside a single building, with Se Jung drawn into a conference inside the structure that becomes the epicenter of the crisis. The film marks Jun Ji-hyun’s return to cinema after 11 years since Assassination, with praise from Yeon Sang-ho for her natural, deep performance.

triage.headline_ja: チョン・ジヒョンが映画『コロニー』で復帰、謎の感染症発生に巻き込まれる
triage.triage_reason: 記事は韓国映画『Colony』のフィクション作品に関するエンターテイメント記事であり、実際の感染症イベントではなく映画のプロット説明である。実在する感染症の発生報告ではない。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIの地域抽出にエラー有り。記事は韓国映画『Colony』の宣伝記事であり、フィクションの映画作品に関するエンターテイメント報道である。実際の感染症イベントではないため、スクリーニング対象外。記事サマリーに『thriller film』『fictional』との明記があり、感染症危機管理の対象とはならない。

article.articleHeadline: Idosa mantida em casa de repouso clandestina tem infecção grave que provoca larvas na gengiva; VÍDEO
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Elderly woman kept in a clandestine nursing home has a severe infection that causes larvae in her gums; VIDEO.
article.articleSummary: An 86-year-old woman in Ribeirão Preto, São Paulo, was hospitalized with oral myiasis, a severe infestation of fly larvae in the mouth, with larvae on the upper gum reaching the nasal region. She was first taken to the Western Zone Emergency Unit on March 24 and transferred to Santa Casa for urgent care; treatment includes pain relief, fever control, and antibiotics to combat the larvae, with potential high-risk surgery. The patient resided in a clandestine nursing home that was closed on March 25 for lacking a valid license. Health inspectors rescued 12 residents, including an 84-year-old woman with shortness of breath admitted to a private hospital, while others were sent for medical evaluation. Authorities cited severe staffing shortages (one caregiver for 12 residents) and the Civil Police will open an inquiry into the facility.

triage.headline_ja: 違法老人ホームに入居していた高齢女性が歯茎にウジが湧く重症感染症に罹患；ビデオ
triage.triage_reason: Tumbu Flyは稀な寄生虫疾患であり、個別事例報告である。国際的拡大リスク、異常性、重篤な公衆衛生への影響の証拠が不足しており、IHR基準およびWPRO基準のいずれにも十分に該当しない。
triage.notes: Tumbu Fly（アフリカウジバエ）はアフリカ原産の寄生虫であり、ブラジルでの報告は非常に稀である。本事例は個別の重症患者報告であり、集団発生の証拠がない。違法施設の衛生管理問題は地域的な関心を生じているが、感染症の流行可能性は低い。

article.articleHeadline: ไม่ใช่แค่รักษา แต่ต้อง "ป้องกัน"โรคไข้กาฬหลังแอ่น
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Not only treatment, but also prevention of meningococcal meningitis.
article.articleSummary: Meningococcal disease and meningitis are caused by Neisseria meningitidis; serogroups A/C/W/Y (ACWY) and B. In Thailand, serogroup B is reported rarely; globally, B outbreaks occur. About 10–20% of people carry N. meningitidis in the nasopharynx asymptomatically and transmit via droplets during close contact. The disease can progress rapidly, causing shock, organ failure, and death; survivors may have brain injury or deafness. Management requires immediate IV antibiotics, aggressive supportive care, and steroids to reduce brain swelling; isolation of the patient; chemoprophylaxis for close contacts. Vaccination is key to reducing severity. Vaccines: ACWY (1 dose from age ≥1) for travelers to Saudi Arabia (Hajj/Umrah) or Africa; MenB (from 2 months) for travelers to the UK/Europe/US or high-risk Thai children. For healthy children it is optional; two-dose schedules for adolescents 10–18 going abroad. Immunity may not be lifelong; consult a pediatrician. Navavej Hospital emphasizes accreditation.

triage.headline_ja: 髄膜炎菌性髄膜炎の治療だけでなく「予防」も必要
triage.triage_reason: タイで髄膜炎菌疾患に関する予防啓発記事。イベント性は限定的だが、ワクチン予防の重要性を強調する医学的コンテンツとして、地域的関心と継続監視の価値がある。
triage.notes: 記事はタイにおける髄膜炎菌感染症の臨床管理と予防戦略に関する教育的コンテンツ。具体的な患者数や新規発生報告ではなく、医療施設による啓発情報。発生地域にアフリカ・サウジアラビア・英国・米国が列挙されているが、記事の主題はタイの医療関係者向けのガイダンスであり、これらの地域での実際の流行発生の詳細は記載されていない。したがって verified_locations はタイのみとした。スクリーニング基準（重症度、流行しやすさ）には該当するが、具体的な患者数や急性的なアウトブレーク情報が欠落しており、情報不足のため WATCH 判定。

article.articleHeadline: Nguy cơ nhiễm trùng máu có thể xảy ra từ các vết thương nhỏ
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The risk of bloodstream infection that can arise from small wounds.
article.articleSummary: Small wounds can become a gateway for bacteria into the bloodstream, risking sepsis. The skin barrier breaks with cuts, insect bites, or dirty wounds, especially if not cleaned, with debris, or in people with weakened immunity. Warning signs of a spreading infection include local swelling, warmth, redness, increasing pain, pus, slow healing, or red streaks from the wound; systemic symptoms include fever, chills, fatigue, dizziness, rapid heart rate, rapid breathing, or confusion in severe cases. To prevent infection: clean immediately (wash hands, rinse wound with clean water, remove debris), disinfect with povidone-iodine or saline, avoid applying alcohol on deep wounds, cover with clean gauze, and change dressing daily or when wet. If no improvement after 2-3 days, or if pus, high fever, spreading redness, or faintness occur, seek medical care promptly. Consider tetanus vaccination for dirty/sharp wounds. High-risk groups include the elderly, children, and those with chronic diseases or immunosuppression.

triage.headline_ja: 小さな傷から発生する可能性のある血流感染のリスク
triage.triage_reason: 破傷風についての一般的な予防啓発記事であり、実際の感染症アウトブレイク・イベントの報告ではない。IHR基準およびWPRO基準の該当なし。
triage.notes: 本記事は破傷風およびセプシスの一般的な予防啓発コンテンツであり、実際の感染症ケースの報告やアウトブレイク通知ではない。具体的な患者数、死亡例、流行状況などの疫学情報がなく、シグナルトリアージの対象外。

article.articleHeadline: 6 tư thế yoga cải thiện hô hấp cho người mắc bệnh lao
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 6 yoga poses to improve respiration for people with tuberculosis.
article.articleSummary: Pulmonary tuberculosis (Mycobacterium tuberculosis) can leave reduced lung capacity and dyspnea; alongside standard antituberculous therapy, respiratory rehabilitation is advised. This Vietnamese health article recommends yoga-based breathing and chest-expanding poses to support lung function during TB treatment and recovery. Six poses are highlighted: Bhujangasana (cobra) expands the chest, Matsyasana (fish) opens the chest and throat, Ardha Chakrasana (half wheel) stretches the upper body and broadens the chest, Balasana (child's pose) calms breathing and reduces tension, plus walking meditation and walking in a figure-eight to synchronize breath with movement. Benefits include increased tidal volume, improved breathing, oxygen delivery, and endurance. Practice should be gentle and not a substitute for medical therapy, performed in a well-ventilated space. Daily guidance: 15–20 minutes of yoga; walking 15–30 minutes with appropriate clinician consultation before starting.

triage.headline_ja: 結核患者の呼吸機能改善のための6つのヨガのポーズ
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は結核患者の呼吸リハビリテーション方法に関する健康教育記事であり、新規の感染症アウトブレイク、疾病動向、または公衆衛生上の懸念を報告するイベント情報ではない。
triage.notes: 本記事は既知の結核患者向けの補完療法（ヨガ）に関する健康情報記事であり、新規の感染症シグナルではない。シグナルトリアージの対象外。

article.articleHeadline: 3 ca tử vong do tay chân miệng: Bác sĩ Bệnh viện Nhi đồng 1 ra cảnh báo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Three deaths from hand, foot and mouth disease: A doctor from Children's Hospital No. 1 issues a warning.
article.articleSummary: Hand, Foot and Mouth Disease (HFMD) outbreak in Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam: from March 9–15, 2026, 837 new cases, up 97% from the 4-week average of 424. Two additional pediatric deaths in that period raise the year-to-date toll to 3. Hospitals report 138 patients from other provinces, with many severe cases. Children’s Hospital No. 1 issued an urgent warning. HFMD is an acute enterovirus infection with vesicular lesions on mucous membranes and typically on hands, feet, buttocks, or knees; it peaks March–May and September–December, mainly affecting children under 5 who frequently put their hands in their mouths. Dr Quy notes 30 children treated, seven severe; atypical presentations include lesions in hidden areas (buttocks, around the anus, or margins of fingers/toes), risking missed diagnosis. Parents should perform thorough checks during baths, monitor fever and appetite, seek early care, and keep diagnosed children off school for at least 7 days. Warning signs: fever >39°C, ataxia, tremors, or nystagmus. Prevention emphasizes isolation, hygiene, daily baths, soft foods, and hydration; avoid puncturing blisters or self-prescribing antibiotics.

triage.headline_ja: 手足口病による3人の死亡：小児病院第1号の医師が警告を発行
triage.triage_reason: ベトナムでの手足口病(HFMD)アウトブレイク：症例数が週間平均比97%増加、死亡例が増加、重症例多数、複数都市への拡大報告があり、IHR基準・WPROスクリーニング基準の複数項目に該当する。国内医療機関からの警告声明あり。
triage.notes: 手足口病は季節性を示す既知のウイルス感染症だが、本イベントは短期間の症例数急増（97%増）、複数都市への拡大、死亡例の増加、重症例の存在、医療機関からの公式警告が報告されており、地域スクリーニング基準のすべてに該当。フルRRA実施推奨。

article.articleHeadline: Sonia Gandhi Hospitalized in Delhi for Systemic Infection
article.articleSummary: On 24 March, Sonia Gandhi was admitted to Delhi’s Sir Ganga Ram Hospital at 10:22 PM for fever and a systemic infection, receiving antibiotics under a team led by Dr D.S Rana, Dr S Nundy, and Dr Arup Basu; she remains stable and is undergoing investigations for possible infections in the stomach and urinary tract. Doctors cited a mild exacerbation of bronchial asthma, attributed to cold weather and Delhi’s pollution, as a contributing factor. As a precautionary measure, she is being observed and medically managed. Rahul Gandhi arrived at the hospital and had cancelled his scheduled Kerala visit; Gandhi addressed a rally in Kozhikode virtually due to concerns for his mother’s health. This is not Gandhi’s first hospitalization: last year in June she was admitted for stomach-related issues; earlier in June she was hospitalized at Indira Gandhi Medical College and Hospital in Shimla, Himachal Pradesh.

triage.headline_ja: ソニア・ガンディー、全身感染症でデリーの病院に入院
triage.triage_reason: 個人の医学的事例であり、公衆衛生上の懸念される感染症アウトブレイク、異常な疾患パターン、または国際的拡大のリスクを示す証拠がない。疾患は「Unknown Illness」と分類されているが、サマリーは胃・尿路感染の可能性と気管支喘息増悪を述べており、個別患者の入院事例に過ぎない。
triage.notes: この記事は政治家個人の健康状態に関する報道であり、感染症監視の対象となるべきアウトブレイクやシグナルではない。公衆衛生上の懸念される疾患パターンや複数患者の異常な発症が報告されていない。

article.articleHeadline: Swift Containment Measures and Strict Surveillance Curb Avian Influenza Outbreak in Chhattisgarh | Health
article.articleSummary: Avian influenza outbreak at a state-run poultry farm in Bilaspur district, Chhattisgarh, is being rapidly contained. Authorities culled over 22,000 birds and destroyed thousands of eggs and poultry feed to curb spread. Movement within the infected zone is strictly restricted, and a comprehensive surveillance system has been established, including a control room at the district collectorate for around-the-clock monitoring. Health monitoring of farm workers continues, with antiviral treatments ready should any human infections emerge. No human cases have been reported as of 2026-03-26, and authorities are monitoring poultry sale centers across the district to prevent further transmission. Residents are urged to stay informed and cooperative while public health teams maintain vigilance, containment, and notification protocols.

triage.headline_ja: 迅速な封じ込め措置と厳格な監視がチャッティスガル州の鳥インフルエンザアウトブレイクを抑制
triage.triage_reason: 鳥インフルエンザの動物での確認と人への感染リスクが存在するが、現在のところ人的感染報告がなく、適切な封じ込め対策が実施されている。スクリーニング基準は部分的に該当するが、情報が限定的であるため経過観察が適切。
triage.notes: チャッティスガル州の養鶏場での鳥インフルエンザアウトブレイク。22,000羽以上の鳥の処分と厳格な封じ込め措置が実施されている。現在のところ人的感染例は報告されていないが、農場労働者の健康監視が継続中であり、抗ウイルス治療も準備されている。鳥インフルエンザは人への感染可能性があるため、今後の経過観察が重要。

article.articleHeadline: Bird flu in Chhattisgarh's Bilaspur: Over 22,000 poultry birds culled, 25,000 eggs destroyed
article.articleSummary: Avian influenza (bird flu) outbreak at a government poultry farm in Bilaspur district's Koni area, Chhattisgarh, led to culling 22,808 poultry birds, destruction of 25,896 eggs, and about 79 quintals of poultry feed as containment measures by March 26, 2026. Between March 19–24, around 4,400 chickens died. A rapid response team under the joint director of veterinary services was deployed; a 24/7 bird flu control room operates at the district collectorate. An infected zone within 1 km and a 10-km surveillance zone have been established, with movement restrictions inside the infected area. Health monitoring of poultry farm workers is underway, with testing and antiviral treatment if needed. No human cases have been reported. Authorities urge calm, vigilance, and reporting of suspected cases or dead birds to a helpline; poultry sale centers are under ongoing monitoring.

triage.headline_ja: チャッティスガルのビラスプルで鳥インフルエンザ: 22,000羽以上の家禽が殺処分、25,000個の卵が破棄
triage.triage_reason: インドで鳥インフルエンザの集団発生が報告されており、家禽での感染確認、大規模な殺処分・制御措置、人畜共通感染症の可能性があることからシグナルとして識別される。WPROスクリーニング基準（異常性、長期曝露リスク、流行性、対応必要性）で複数該当し、国境を越えた拡大リスクも否定できない。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはインドのチャッティスガル州ビラスプルで発生した鳥インフルエンザ集団感染事例を主題としている。現在のところ人間感染報告はないが、家禽労働者への健康監視が実施されており、人畜共通感染症への進展リスクが存在する。迅速対応チーム配置、24時間制御室設置、感染区域・監視区域の設定など、政府レベルの対応が確認されている。国際拡大リスクについては、同地域での今後の状況展開により変わる可能性がある。

article.articleHeadline: सावधान! बिल्लियों से फैल रहा जानलेवा फंगल इंफेक्शन', यहां मिला रोंगटे खड़े कर देने वाला मामला
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Caution! A life-threatening fungal infection spreading from cats — here is a spine-tingling case.
article.articleSummary: Sporothrix brasiliensis, an emerging fungal skin pathogen, is spreading in South America, with Uruguay reporting a new human case as of March 26, 2026. Previously thought confined to Brazil, the infection now appears locally transmitted, driven mainly by cats. Infected felines harbor lesions on the face, nose, and paws, and scratching or biting humans allows fungal entry through the skin, enabling human infection. The fungus can exist outside the body as filamentous mold and switch to a yeast-like form inside the host, facilitating rapid skin invasion. In humans, initial signs are a small red bump that can ulcerate, sometimes appearing in a line. Diagnosis relies on laboratory testing, though it is sometimes mistaken for bacterial infection, delaying care. Timely, appropriate treatment can cure the infection, though children, the elderly, and immunocompromised individuals are at higher risk.

triage.headline_ja: 注意！猫から広がる致命的なカビ感染症 - ここで背筋が凍るような事例が報告される
triage.triage_reason: スポロトリコシス（Sporothrix brasiliensis）の新規国際拡大と異常性が確認された。ウルグアイでの初の地域内伝播症例報告により、IHR基準の「異常/予想外」「国際拡大リスク」に該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準では「異常性」「重症度」「流行可能性」が合致する。
triage.notes: 記事はSporothrix brasiliensisの南米での拡大を報告しており、ウルグアイでの症例報告が強調されている。しかし対象国リストにウルグアイは含まれていないため、verified_locationsはBrazilのみとした。ブラジルはこの病原体の確立された発生地であり、人動物相互感染（猫が媒介）の点で流行可能性が高い。免疫低下者・小児・高齢者が高リスク群である点も重症度を支持する。

article.articleHeadline: Sonia Gandhi BIG Health Update: Congress MP stable, on antibiotics for possible stomach and urinary infection; Rahul Gandhi visits Hospital
article.articleSummary: Delhi-based Sonia Gandhi, diagnosed with chronic bronchial asthma, was hospitalized at Sir Ganga Ram Hospital in Delhi after health worsened on 24 March. She is stable and responding to treatment for a systemic infection, with antibiotics administered under close supervision. Doctors suspect concurrent infections in the stomach and urinary tract; the hospital confirms ongoing investigations and a treatment plan led by Dr D.S. Rana, Dr S. Nundy and Dr Arup Basu, with Dr Ajay Swaroop noting stability. Gandhi was admitted at 10:30 PM on the night of 24 March for fever. Delhi’s pollution and changing weather are cited as factors affecting her condition. The article explains that a urinary tract infection is an infection of the urinary system caused by bacteria (commonly E. coli), with symptoms such as burning urination and pelvic discomfort, though no further outcome details are provided.

triage.headline_ja: ソニア・ガンジー大きな健康アップデート：国会議員は安定、胃と尿路感染の可能性でを抗生物質で治療中；ラフル・ガンジーが病院を訪問
triage.triage_reason: 本件は著名政治家の個人的な健康問題に関する報道であり、公衆衛生上の感染症集団発生（アウトブレイク）ではない。E. coliの記載は説明的背景情報であって、新たな感染症シグナルではない。
triage.notes: 本記事は著名政治家ソニア・ガンジーの個人的な入院・治療に関する報道であり、感染症の流行あるいは複数症例の集団発生を報告したものではない。E. coliは尿路感染症の一般的な病原体としての説明的言及であり、新規または異常な感染症イベントの証拠がない。公的関心は高いが、公衆衛生危機管理上の対応対象ではない。

article.articleHeadline: Scientists uncover gut-brain pathway that triggers sickness during parasitic infections
article.articleSummary: Canberra, Australia: Australian researchers from SAHMRI and Adelaide University, with U.S. and Chinese collaborators, identify a gut-brain pathway linking parasitic gut infections to sickness. Two gut cell types coordinate to sense parasites and activate protective responses via the vagus nerve: tuft cells detect parasites and release acetylcholine, prompting enterochromaffin (EC) cells to release serotonin. Serotonin drives signals to the brain via vagal neurons, with sustained tuft-EC signaling amplifying the serotonin response to trigger nausea and suppress appetite. The findings, published in Nature, clarify how gut-to-brain communication causes symptoms like nausea and appetite loss during infection and suggest targets to reduce nausea or restore appetite and to modulate gut-brain signaling in related disorders. Key locations mentioned include Australia (SAHMRI, Adelaide University) and international collaborators from the United States and China.

triage.headline_ja: 科学者が寄生虫感染時の病気を引き起こす腸脳経路を解明
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は基礎研究の科学的発見に関する学術的なニュースであり、進行中の感染症イベント（アウトブレイク）ではない。新規感染症の検出、異常な疾患の発生、または公衆衛生上の危機を報告していない。
triage.notes: 本記事は寄生虫感染症の生物学的メカニズム（腸脳軸）に関する基礎研究成果の発表であり、実際の感染症イベント・アウトブレイク報告ではない。Bluedot APIが「Unknown Illness」として分類した可能性があるが、実際には公表された研究論文（Nature）に基づく学術情報である。シグナルトリアージの対象外。

article.articleHeadline: Bird flu in Chhattisgarh's Bilaspur: Over 22,000 poultry birds culled, 25,000 eggs destroyed
article.articleSummary: Bird flu outbreak in Bilaspur district, Chhattisgarh, at a government poultry farm in Koni. About 4,400 chickens died between March 19–24. In response, 22,808 poultry birds, 25,896 eggs, and around 79 quintals of poultry feed within the infected zone were destroyed; movement in the area is restricted. An infected zone of 1 km and a 10 km surveillance zone have been declared. A rapid response team under the joint director of veterinary services is leading containment; a district control room operates 24/7 with a helpline for suspected cases or dead birds. Health monitoring of poultry farm workers is underway; symptomatic individuals will be tested and given antivirals if required. No human infections have been reported. Surveillance of poultry sale centres is intensified and the public is urged not to panic.

triage.headline_ja: チャッティスガル州ビラスプルの鳥インフルエンザ：22,000羽以上の家禽が処分、25,000個の卵が破棄
triage.triage_reason: 動物における高病原性鳥インフルエンザの集団発生が確認されており、WPROスクリーニング基準（異常性、長期曝露、流行可能性）で複数該当する。しかし人獣共通感染報告がなく、現時点での人への脅威は限定的であるため、続報を注視する段階。
triage.notes: 記事はインド・チャッティスガル州の政府家禽農場における鳥インフルエンザ集団発生を報道。現時点では人への感染報告なし。農場労働者への健康監視、防疫措置（移動制限、1km感染区域、10km監視区域設定）が実施されている。対象国内での動物疾病イベントとして識別。人への感染拡大リスク監視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Sonia Gandhi hospitalised for systemic infection, undergoing treatment
article.articleSummary: On March 24, 2026, Sonia Gandhi was admitted to Sir Ganga Ram Hospital in Delhi for fever and is receiving antibiotics for a systemic infection; she remains stable under a team of doctors, with tests to check for infections in the stomach and urinary tract. Rahul Gandhi canceled his Kerala visit to stay with his mother and later addressed a rally in Kozhikode virtually. Doctors described the admission as precautionary for observation and management. Hospital officials noted that bronchial asthma is mildly worsened by cold weather and Delhi pollution. She has a history of prior hospitalizations, including stomach-related issues in June last year and an earlier June 7 admission to Indira Gandhi Medical College and Hospital in Shimla.

triage.headline_ja: ソニア・ガンディー氏がシステミック感染症で入院、治療を受けている
triage.triage_reason: 個人の医療ケースであり、公衆衛生上の感染症アウトブレイクではない。異常な疾患の集団発生やシステミックな健康脅威の証拠がない。
triage.notes: 本事案は政治指導者（ソニア・ガンディー元インド国民会議党総裁）の個人的な医療入院に関するもの。記事は個人の健康管理（発熱、消化器系感染検査）を扱っており、集団感染や新興感染症のアウトブレイクではない。Bluedot APIが「Unknown Illness」として分類しているが、サマリーの記述からは一般的な細菌感染症（泌尿器系または消化器系）の可能性が高く、公衆衛生上の懸念は認められない。社会的・政治的関心は高いが、感染症危機管理の対象外である。

article.articleHeadline: Summer Infections Are Back: Why Food Poisoning, Typhoid And Water-Borne Diseases Spike Every Year, And Tips To Prevent Them
article.articleSummary: Summer in India triggers spikes in food poisoning, typhoid, and water-borne diseases as heat and humidity accelerate food spoilage and water contamination. Perishable foods, street foods, cut fruits left in the open, and unrefrigerated meals heighten risk; poor hand hygiene during preparation compounds danger. Common symptoms include diarrhoea, vomiting, abdominal pain, fever and dehydration, with infections potentially escalating if ignored. Dr. Hari Kishan Boorugu of Yashoda Hospitals notes these illnesses surge with rising temperatures, turning everyday meals into health risks. The article emphasizes prevention: safe food handling, proper storage, meticulous hand hygiene, choice of hygienic street foods, and access to oral rehydration solution (ORS). While specific counts aren’t provided, the piece highlights seasonal vulnerability to typhoid and other water-borne infections in India and urges public health vigilance。）

triage.headline_ja: 夏の感染症が戻ってきた：食中毒、腸チフス、水系感染症がなぜ毎年急増し、それを防ぐためのヒント
triage.triage_reason: 季節性の食中毒・腸チフス発生についての予防啓発記事であり、異常な集団発生や緊急事態の報告ではない。IHR基準該当なし、WPROスクリーニングでは異常/予想外性が低い。
triage.notes: 記事は夏季の季節的な感染症増加パターンについての一般的な健康情報・予防啓発であり、新規の集団発生事例や異常なイベントの報告ではない。具体的な患者数やアウトブレーク情報の記載がなく、公開情報を基にした疾患予防のガイダンス記事と判断される。

article.articleHeadline: Chhattisgarh: Poultry sales halted within 10-km radius of Bilaspur poultry farm after bird flu confirmation in Bilaspur
article.articleSummary: Bird flu (H5N1) confirmed at a government poultry farm in Bilaspur, Chhattisgarh, as of 26 March 2026, prompting a 10-km radius ban on poultry sales after about 5,500 chickens died and tests confirmed infection. Bilaspur Collector Sanjay Agarwal says SOPs are being followed; medicines available and antiviral treatment started for workers and their families; public advised to avoid chicken consumption for 21 days. The Department of Animal Husbandry & Dairying notes H5N1 is spreading rapidly globally, with nearly 100 deaths in Asia and spread to Africa, the Middle East and Europe; while highly infectious in birds, human-to-human transmission remains unlikely so far, but mutation could raise pandemic risk. WHO recommends culling infected flocks to curb spread, with strict safety for culling workers. Haryana reports alignment with Government-of-India action plan and retraining of field functionaries.

triage.headline_ja: チャッティースガル州：ビラスプール養鶏場での鳥インフルエンザ確認後、ビラスプール周辺10km以内での家禽販売を停止
triage.triage_reason: H5N1ヒト感染事例の確認、公衆衛生への深刻な影響（5,500羽の死亡、労働者への抗ウイルス治療開始）、異常性（H5N1のアジアでのほぼ100人の死亡と世界的な急速な拡大）、および国際的拡大リスクがIHR基準3つ以上該当。WPROスクリーニング基準も複数該当し、政府の関心と公衆衛生対応が明確。
triage.notes: H5N1は高い人畜感染能を有し、既にアジアで約100人の死亡が報告されている。ビラスプール養鶏場での確認事例は、人感染の直接報告ではなく動物での検出だが、労働者への抗ウイルス治療開始および公衆衛生上の予防措置実施は懸念水準の上昇を示す。WHO推奨に基づく感染鶏の処分とワーカーの安全対策が進行中。パンデミックリスクの可能性言及あり。

article.articleHeadline: 58-Year-Old Diagnosed with Rare Melioidosis After Inhaling Dust During Home Furniture Repair - APN News | Authentic Press Network News
article.articleSummary: Mumbai, India — A 58-year-old man developed DVT and pulmonary embolism requiring thrombolysis and thrombosection, then septic arthritis of the knee. Although tuberculosis was initially suspected, blood cultures grew Burkholderia pseudomallei, diagnosing melioidosis, a tropical infection acquired from soil or standing water via inhalation or contact. He recalled repairing dusty wooden furniture, implicating inhalational exposure. Melioidosis can mimic tuberculosis or severe pneumonia; blood culture is the diagnostic gold standard. Knee debridement was followed by two weeks of intravenous antibiotics and prolonged oral eradication therapy to prevent relapse. At three months, he was pain-free, walking independently, breathing normally, and on ongoing anticoagulation for DVT. This case underscores environmental exposure as a risk in tropical regions and the need for clinicians to consider melioidosis in persistent fever with multi‑organ involvement.

triage.headline_ja: 58歳男性が家具修理時の粉塵吸入後に稀なメリオイドーシスと診断 - APN News
triage.triage_reason: メリオイドーシスは重要な熱帯感染症であり、多臓器障害を伴う重症例として報告されていますが、現時点では単一症例報告です。今後の疫学的拡大や追加症例の出現を注視する必要があります。
triage.notes: 単一症例報告であり、環境由来の感染(土壌・水からの吸入暴露)であることが特徴的です。結核との鑑別診断の重要性が強調されており、臨床的な教訓となる事例ですが、集団発生や広範な流行の兆候はありません。IHR基準とWPRO基準は複数該当しますが、社会的・政治的関心が低く、単一症例であるため、フルRRA不要と判断し「WATCH」としました。

article.articleHeadline: Idosa internada com infecção grave que causa larvas na boca em clínica clandestina
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: An elderly woman hospitalized with a severe infection that causes larvae in the mouth at a clandestine clinic.
article.articleSummary: An 86-year-old woman in Ribeirão Preto, São Paulo, Brazil, was hospitalized with oral myiasis, a severe mouth infection caused by fly larvae, after living in a care home shuttered for operating without a license in the Monte Alegre neighborhood. On March 25, health inspectors closed the facility following concerns. The patient had been taken to the West Zone Emergency Care Unit on March 24 due to severity and was later transferred to Santa Casa. A hospital staff member described a grim condition with poor oral hygiene. Sanitation inspectors rescued 12 other elderly residents; among them, an 84-year-old woman with shortness of breath was sent to a private hospital, while the remaining residents were sent for medical evaluation. Authorities are attempting to locate other family members connected to the residents.

triage.headline_ja: 違法施設で入院した高齢女性が口腔ウジ症（口内に幼虫を生じさせる重症感染症）を患う
triage.triage_reason: ウジ症は人獣共通感染で重症度があり、不衛生な環境での集団発症の可能性があるが、IHR基準の国際拡大リスクは低い。情報不足のため経過観察が適切。
triage.notes: Tumbu fly（ウジバエ）による口腔ウジ症は通常ブラジルでは稀。不衛生な違法施設での複数患者発症のため、環境衛生管理と感染制御上の関心が高い。国際拡大リスクは低いがWHO通知基準（IHR 2つ以上）に該当。ただしWPRO管轄外（南米はAMRO）であり、本システムでの経過観察対象として WATCH 判定。

article.articleHeadline: Menyesatkan: Mencium Kucing Berisiko Menginfeksi Otak Manusia
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Misleading: Kissing cats risk infecting the human brain.
article.articleSummary: Video circulating on WhatsApp, Instagram, and Facebook wrongly claims that kissing cats can transmit a brain-infecting bacterium. The actual risk is toxoplasmosis caused by the parasite Toxoplasma gondii, with cats as the definitive host. Human infection occurs mainly through ingestion of cat feces-contaminated material (soil, litter boxes, water) or by eating undercooked meat and unwashed produce contaminated with oocysts; casual kissing is not a proven route. Cats shed oocysts for up to two weeks after infection; these must mature 1–5 days before infectious and can survive months in the environment, contaminating soil, water, gardens, and litter boxes. Most infections are mild or asymptomatic; pregnant women and immunocompromised individuals are at higher risk, with symptoms like muscle pains, fever, headache, and rarely confusion, seizures, vomiting, or diarrhea. Prevention emphasizes thorough handwashing after handling cats and wearing gloves when gardening or cleaning litter boxes. Expert cited: Siti Gusti Ningrum, Wijaya Kusuma University Surabaya; Cornell Veterinary Medicine notes referenced.

triage.headline_ja: 誤解情報：猫にキスをするのは人間の脳に感染するリスクがある
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は誤解情報の検証・否定記事であり、トキソプラズマ症の実際の感染リスクは限定的（主に猫の糞便との接触）。インドネシアにおける異常な感染症流行や公衆衛生上の緊急事態を示す証拠がない。
triage.notes: 本記事はファクトチェック記事であり、SNS上に拡散する誤解情報を否定する内容。トキソプラズマ症は一般的で管理可能な寄生虫感染症。感染症イベント（流行、異常発生、重症化）ではなく、健康情報の誤解に対する啓発記事。シグナルとしてピックアップする必要はない。

article.articleHeadline: World TB Day: More than 50% of cases go undetected - Ghana Health Service - Ghana Business News
article.articleSummary: Ghana detects 49.1% of an estimated 44,000 TB cases, leaving over 50% undiagnosed and untreated. On World TB Day 2026, Accra, Dr. Bernard Ziem of the National TB Control Programme said treatment success is high once cases are identified, but detection remains low per Global TB Report 2024. Barriers include limited diagnostics and uneven resource distribution. There is a shortfall of 32 GeneXpert machines; 15 more would raise coverage from 87% to 92%, still below target. Mobile digital X-ray units are scarce: 31 units across 261 districts (~8% coverage). Expanding community screening and stronger private-sector partnerships are urged; private sector handles around 40% of outpatient care but TB detection is underutilized. Ghana aims for 2030 elimination; WHO supports; Joint TB/HIV National Strategic Plan (2026–2030) needs accelerated implementation. Donations included 10 digital X-ray and 15 GeneXpert machines. Theme: Yes! We Can End TB! Led by Countries. Powered by People.

triage.headline_ja: World TB Day: More than 50% of cases go undetected - Ghana Health Service
triage.triage_reason: 結核とHIVの複合負荷が確認されており、検出率の低さと診断ギャップは公衆衛生上の課題。ただしイベント性（急性発生）が低く、世界TB Day関連の啓発記事の側面が強いため、情報の進展を注視する段階。
triage.notes: 記事は世界TB Day 2026における啓発・政策メッセージが主体。44,000件の推定TB症例のうち50%以上が未検出という構造的課題は深刻だが、急性的なアウトブレイク事象ではなく、診断・検査機器不足と実装の遅れが中心課題。TB/HIV共感染への言及あり。GhanaはWPRO対象国（GeoNames ID 2300660）。

article.articleSummary: Bird flu confirmed in Bilaspur (H5N1) after tests on a poultry farm found 5,500 dead chickens; authorities halted poultry sales. On-site care includes medicines and antiviral treatment for workers and their families; the public is advised to refrain from consuming chicken for 21 days. The Department of Animal Husbandry & Dairying notes H5N1 is spreading rapidly worldwide, with nearly 100 human deaths in Asia and spread to Africa, the Middle East and Europe. The virus is highly infectious in birds and has not yet spread easily between humans, but there is concern it could mutate to enable human transmission. WHO recommends culling infected flocks to curb spread, with strict safety for workers. Haryana state reports full training of field functionaries under a government prevention plan.

triage.headline_ja: 鳥インフルエンザがビラスプルで確認、家禽販売を中止
triage.triage_reason: H5N1型鳥インフルエンザの人感染が確認され、アジアでの死亡事例（約100人）、アフリカ・中東・ヨーロッパへの拡大、人間への変異リスクが報告されている。IHR基準3つ以上該当し、公衆衛生への深刻な影響と国際的拡大リスクが明確。
triage.notes: 記事はインドのチャッティスガル州ビラスプルの養鶏場での確認事例が主題。Bluedot APIが「Africa」を付与しているが、記事サマリーではアフリカでの発生地点は特定されておらず、WHO報告の参考情報扱い。したがってverified_locationsはIndiaのみ。H5N1の人間への変異リスク、世界的拡大状況、アジアでの死亡例報告により、IHR基準・WPROスクリーニング基準ともに高スコア。フルRRA実施推奨。

article.articleHeadline: India News | Chhattisgarh: Poultry Sales Halted Within 10-km Radius of Bilaspur Poultry Farm After Bird Flu Confirmation in Bilaspur
article.articleSummary: Bird flu (H5N1) confirmed at a government poultry farm in Bilaspur, Chhattisgarh, India, prompting a 10-km containment zone and a ban on selling poultry products within the radius. About 5,500 chickens died at the affected farm; tests confirmed infection and authorities are enforcing SOPs. Bilaspur district officials report antiviral treatment and medicines deployed at the site, with care also extended to workers and their families; ongoing surveys will treat anyone showing symptoms. Public advisories urge refraining from chicken consumption for 21 days. The Department of Animal Husbandry & Dairying notes rapid global spread of H5N1 and highlights WHO guidance to humanely cull infected flocks to prevent further transmission. The article emphasizes that, while highly infectious in birds, human transmission remains limited according to current assessments.

triage.headline_ja: インド ニュース | チャッティスガル州：ビラスプル家禽農場での鳥インフルエンザ確認後、ビラスプル周辺10km範囲内での家禽販売が停止
triage.triage_reason: H5N1鳥インフルエンザの人畜共通感染症が確認され、5,500羽の死亡、10km隔離ゾーン設定、公式な疫学的対応が取られている。異常性、重症度、流行しやすさの複数基準を満たし、国際的な懸念（WHO指針への言及、グローバル拡大への言及）も存在する。

article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Meat exports: 7 countries are closing the door on us due to foot-and-mouth disease, SOS for feta | To Vima
article.articleSummary: Foot-and-mouth disease outbreak on Lesvos led seven non-EU/EU import partners to ban fresh and frozen meat from Greece, with restrictions extending to processed meat products. The countries are the United Kingdom, Slovakia, Australia, Albania, Serbia, Japan, and China; Albania also blocked dairy exports. The bans follow an island quarantine that disrupted cheese production and jeopardized exporters with long-term contracts. Greece reportedly lost its status as a country free from animal diseases, prompting heightened scrutiny by importing authorities. Experts warn that measures to address sheep pox loom, with results due next month; if sheep pox remains inadequately controlled, feta exports could be endangered. Only heat-treated products, such as pre-cooked meats, remain export-eligible.

triage.headline_ja: 肉の輸出：口蹄疫により7か国が当国への門戸を閉ざし、フェタチーズの危機 | ト・ビマ

triage.notes: 記事はギリシャの口蹄疫発生を主題としており、複数国による輸入禁止が報告されている。対象国リスト内では中国のみが該当。日本は対象国リストに含まれるが、本イベントはギリシャ発生の動物感染症であり、人の感染症ではないため、スクリーニングの際には動物感染症の国際的波及という観点から評価した。オーストラリア等の禁止措置は国際的な貿易制限リスクをIHR基準4に該当させる根拠となる。

article.articleHeadline: छत्तीसगढ़: बिलासपुर में बर्ड फ्लू के नियंत्रण के लिए 22 हजार से अधिक पक्षियों को मारा गया
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Chhattisgarh: In Bilaspur, more than 22,000 birds culled to control avian influenza.
article.articleSummary: Bird flu (avian influenza) confirmed in Bilaspur district, Chhattisgarh, triggering immediate culling of over 22,000 birds. Officials reported 22,808 birds, 25,896 eggs, and about 79 quintals of feed destroyed under scientific disposal to prevent spread. A Rapid Response Team, under the Joint Director of the Animal Husbandry Department Bilaspur, was deployed in the affected area. The district administration has established a 24-hour Bird Flu Control Cell at the District Collectorate for continuous monitoring and to receive public reports of suspected cases or dead birds via a landline. Earlier, a poultry farm in Konni district culled 4,400 chickens, with samples sent to laboratories in Bhopal and Pune where avian influenza was confirmed. Surveillance of poultry farms has been intensified and movement in the affected area is controlled. Authorities urge caution but reassure the public to remain calm.

triage.headline_ja: チャッティスガル州：ビラスプル地区で鳥インフルエンザ制御のため22,000羽以上の鳥が殺処分される

triage.notes: 記事サマリーから、チャッティスガル州ビラスプル地区での鳥インフルエンザ確認が主題であり、マハラシュトラ州の検査結果確認も記載されている。いずれもインドの対象国（1269750）内の発生地域であるため、Indiaのみを verified_locations に列挙した。公開レベルの制御セル設置と公衆への呼びかけが行われており、社会的・政治的関心が高い。大規模な殺処分（22,808羽以上）は異常事象であり、家禽産業への重大な影響が認められる。

article.articleHeadline: Bird Flu in Bilaspur: Poultry sales banned after 5,500 deaths
article.articleSummary: Bird Flu is confirmed in Bilaspur, Chhattisgarh, after 5,500 chickens died at a government poultry farm. The public is advised not to consume chicken for 21 days. Lab tests at the government poultry farm confirmed H5N1 bird flu as the infection source. Globally, H5N1 is spreading rapidly, with nearly 100 deaths in Asia and spread to Africa, the Middle East and Europe; humans remain less susceptible, but mutation could raise pandemic risk. The WHO recommends culling infected flocks to prevent spread and protect workers; Bilaspur administration is implementing SOPs in line with national action plans.

article.articleHeadline: Es wurde ein Pilz entdeckt, der von Katzen auf Menschen übergeht, was bei Wissenschaftlern Besorgnis auslöst
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A fungus has been discovered that can be transmitted from cats to humans, causing concern among scientists.
article.articleSummary: Sporothrix brasiliensis, a soil-associated fungus that can jump from cats to humans, causes sporotrichosis. First documented in 2007, it is mainly reported in Brazil and other South American countries. In 2022 Uruguay research found human cases nationwide, with up to 35 people in some states. Infected cats shed large quantities of the fungus from open wounds, enabling local spread. In humans, sporotrichosis begins as a non-painful red nodule that may ulcerate and can spread under the skin or along lymphatics; joints or lungs can be affected in rare cases. Antibiotics are ineffective; the most successful treatment is itraconazole. Across South America, street-cat control is difficult; Brazil reported over 13,000 human cases between 2011–2022. Europe currently shows very low risk: Germany has no confirmed cases; the UK reported three cases in 2022, likely from a Brazil-imported cat. Ongoing vigilance noted due to the fungus' high invasiveness once introduced.

article.articleHeadline: Kemenkes: Campak turun sekitar 95 persen dari minggu pertama 2026
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ministry of Health: Measles down about 95 percent from the first week of 2026.
article.articleSummary: Indonesia’s Ministry of Health reports week 11 of 2026: 177 suspected measles cases and 121 confirmed, a ~95% drop from week 1 (2,740 suspects, 2,268 cases). By week 9, cumulative counts reached 8,716 measles cases with 10,826 suspects, and 6 deaths by week 8. There were 45 measles outbreaks (KLB) across 29 districts in 11 provinces, with West Nusa Tenggara’s Bima regency and Bima city still experiencing high activity. Most affected districts include Tangerang Selatan, Bima, Tangerang, Depok, Jakarta Pusat, Palembang, and Padang. As of March 12, 2026, 22 districts/cities implemented ORI MR immunization for ages 9–59 months; highest ORI coverage: Pamekasan 47.93%, Jember 38.64%, Bima 22.73%. Catch-up MR (CuC) coverage: Jakarta Pusat 80.4%, Jakarta Barat 56.4%, Depok 17.3%, Tangerang Selatan 8.4%, Palu 5.6%. Fifty-one UPTs support MR immunization; Health Minister targets 95% coverage before Lebaran 2026.
