article.articleHeadline: 聚势谋远促合作 科普惠民护安康 -- -- 娄底市人民政府与广州实验室结核病防控战略合作暨"科普引领・终结结核"科普巡讲启动会圆满举行！
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Pooling Momentum for the Long Term and Advancing Cooperation; Science Popularization Benefits the People and Safeguards Health — The Loudi Municipal People's Government and Guangzhou Laboratory's Strategic Cooperation on Tuberculosis Prevention and Control and the Launch Ceremony of the "Science Popularization Leading to Ending Tuberculosis" Lecture Tour Were Successfully Held!
article.articleSummary: On 2026-03-23, the 31st World Tuberculosis Day, Loudi City Government and Guangzhou Laboratory launched a strategic cooperation on tuberculosis prevention and control and inaugurated the 'Science Popularization Leading to Ending Tuberculosis' public lecture tour in Loudi, Hunan. Co-hosted by the Loudi Health Commission and co-organized with Loudi Central Hospital, Guangzhou First Affiliated Hospital of Guangzhou Medical University Loudi Hospital, Loudi CDC, and TiBiKang Biotech (Guangdong), the event creates a cross-regional TB control platform and marks a new phase for Loudi’s outreach. City leaders Li Guoqing and Yu Min joined provincial and hospital representatives to outline goals, with Guangdong and national partners emphasizing practical pathways. Experts discussed diagnostic standardization, clinical management, molecular diagnostics, AI-enabled care, and science popularization methods; a detailed outreach plan and TB backbone training program were announced. The cooperation aims to deepen medical-public health integration and bolster TB prevention and public health capacity for Healthy Loudi and Healthy China.

triage.headline_ja: 娄底市人民政府与广州实验室结核病防控战略合作暨「科普引领・终结结核」科普巡讲启动会圆满举行（娄底市政府と広州実験室の結核予防・コントロール戦略協力、および「科学普及による結核終結」科学講演会の立ち上げ式が成功裏に開催）

triage.notes: 本記事は結核の新規発生または流行のシグナルではなく、中国における結核防予防の多地域的協力枠組みの構築と科学啓発活動についての報道である。地域検証では中国（Loudi, Hunan、Guangzhou, Guangdong）での政策イベントが記述されており、China (1814991) のみ verified_locations に含める。

article.articleHeadline: First serogroup Y meningitis outbreak in Hubei Province Central China linked to adolescent immunization gaps - Scientific Reports
article.articleSummary: First laboratory-confirmed serogroup Y Neisseria meningitidis meningitis outbreak in Hubei Province, central China. On May 27, 2024, a 14-year-old student from L County, E City, developed meningococcal meningitis; the index case had completed national vaccination for serogroups A/C but not serogroup Y. Investigation identified 1 confirmed case and 13 carriers among 199 close contacts, including 5 serogroup Y carriers (2.5%). The five serogroup Y isolates belonged to ST-1655 (ST-23 clonal complex) and were phylogenetically close to strains from other provinces. Nucleic acid testing was positive in 13/199 contacts; culture confirmed serogroup Y. All isolates were susceptible to Penicillin, Ampicillin, Ciprofloxacin, Ceftriaxone, Azithromycin, and Rifampicin. Emergency ACYW135 vaccination achieved 57.5% coverage in the affected school; no secondary cases were observed. Adolescent immunity gaps to serogroup Y were the primary driver. Recommendations: add serogroup Y to routine adolescent vaccination, strengthen serogroup-specific surveillance, and enhance local laboratory capacity.

triage.headline_ja: 中国湖北省における初のセログループY髄膜炎アウトブレイク：思春期予防接種ギャップに関連（Scientific Reports誌）

article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 15:40 National CDC: Imported cases of vector-borne infectious diseases from abroad increase the risk of domestic outbreaks.
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-03-26, China’s National Center for Disease Control and Prevention (China CDC) reported rising temperatures and more active vectors are shaping ongoing infectious disease trends. Imported cases of vector-borne diseases from abroad are increasing domestic outbreak risk. Dengue fever, chikungunya fever, and malaria are highlighted as vector-borne diseases with overseas inputs driving local transmission risk. Febrile illness with thrombocytopenia syndrome (SFTS) is entering its peak season. Norovirus infections remain in their diarrheal season, and hand, foot, and mouth disease is approaching spring–summer season. Respiratory infectious diseases are at relatively low overall levels. The briefing emphasizes continued risk from imported cases and the need for vigilant surveillance and public health measures to mitigate domestic outbreaks.

triage.notes: 中国当局（国家疾控局）による公式発表であり、政府レベルでの関心は確認されている。複数の病媒介在性感染症と季節性疾患が複合的に言及されている点は注視が必要。ただし、具体的な患者数、死亡者数、感染確認地域が記事に明示されていないため、情報不足のため WATCH 判定とした。フルRRA前に詳細情報の集約が望まれる。

article.articleHeadline: Chińskie laboratorium odkryte w USA. W środku próbki z Ebolą, HIV i COVID-19
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A Chinese laboratory uncovered in the United States. Inside were samples of Ebola, HIV and COVID-19.
article.articleSummary: On 2026-03-26, prosecutors describe a Chinese-linked operation in Reedley, California, where a raid uncovered vials and liquids labeled with diseases such as HIV, malaria, and COVID-19, plus a refrigerator described as containing Ebola virus; some samples were only coded. Investigators linked the activity to importing COVID-19 tests from China and selling them as domestically produced in the United States, with multi‑million‑dollar transfers to entities in China. The primary suspect, Jia Bei Zhu, had been arrested in 2023 for medical‑device fraud and deceiving U.S. authorities. A subsequent search of a Las Vegas estate tied to Zhu found weapons and numerous samples of unknown substances, now under federal analysis, with results not yet disclosed. The LA Times highlights weak oversight of private bio-labs in the U.S., raising concerns about unreported tests and possible more extensive illicit activities beyond this case.

article.articleHeadlineTranslated: National Measles Cases Drop Drastically by Up to 95 Percent - Harianjogja.com
article.articleSummary: Measles cases in Indonesia plunged about 94–95% by week 11, 2026, from the week-1 peak. Health ministry data show 177 suspected and 121 confirmed cases in week 11, down from 2,740 suspected and 2,268 confirmed in week 1, attributed to intensified immunization and PHBS education. Despite the national drop, 45 Extraordinary Measles Events (KLB) have occurred across 29 districts/cities in 11 provinces: North Sumatra, West Sumatra, South Sumatra, Banten, West Java, Central Java, Yogyakarta, East Java, West Nusa Tenggara, South Sulawesi, and Central Sulawesi. Ongoing high activity includes NTB’s Bima region. The top burden districts include Tangerang Selatan, Bima, Tangerang, Depok, Central Jakarta, Palembang, and Padang. Outbreak Response Immunization (ORI MR) covered 9–59 months in 22 districts/cities, with Pamekasan 47.93%, Jember 38.64%, Bima 22.73%. Catch-up immunization: Central Jakarta 80.4%, West Jakarta 56.4%, Depok 17.3%, South Tangerang 8.4%, Palu 5.6%.

triage.headline_ja: 国内麻疹患者が95%激減 - ハリアン・ジョグジャ
triage.triage_reason: インドネシア全土で麻疹の多地域での異常事象（KLB）が報告されており、11州29地区で45件の流行が発生。感染症イベントとしての重要性は認められるが、患者数は劇的に減少傾向であり、重症度や国際的拡大リスクの情報が不足しているため、続報を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 記事は麻疹患者数の減少を主要なニュースとしているが、同時に複数地域での異常事象（KLB）の継続的な発生が報告されている。北スマトラ、西スマトラ、南スマトラ、バンテン、西ジャワ、中央ジャワ、ヨグヤカルタ、東ジャワ、西ヌサテンガラ、南スラウェシ、中央スラウェシの11州での流行が確認されている。予防接種キャンペーン（ORI MR）が実施されており、政府の対応がなされている。死亡や重症度に関する具体的データが提供されていないため、より詳細な情報が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Sonia Gandhi hospitalised with infection, condition stable and improving
article.articleSummary: Sonia Gandhi was admitted to a Delhi hospital late on March 24, 2026, at around 10:22 PM with fever-related symptoms. She is diagnosed with an infection and is being treated with antibiotics under close medical supervision; condition stable and responding positively. Preliminary assessments suggest the infection may be related to the stomach or urinary tract, though confirmation awaits ongoing investigations. A senior team of doctors—Dr. Ajay Swaroop, Dr. D.S. Rana, Dr. S. Nundy, and Dr. Arup Basu—are monitoring her status. Doctors noted a mild aggravation of bronchial asthma, possibly triggered by cold weather and prevailing air pollution in the national capital. She was admitted as a precautionary measure for continuous monitoring and timely intervention. Rahul Gandhi visited New Delhi hospital, canceled his Kerala trip, and addressed a public rally in Kozhikode virtually, expressing concern for his mother’s health. Further updates will follow after medical tests.

triage.headline_ja: ソニア・ガンディー感染症で入院、状態は安定し改善中
triage.triage_reason: 個人の医療事例であり、公衆衛生的な集団発生事象ではない。「Unknown Illness」の単一事例であり、IHR基準およびWPRO基準のいずれにも該当しない。
triage.notes: 本イベントは個人の医療事例（著名人の入院）であり、感染症の集団発生やアウトブレイクではない。疾患名が「Unknown Illness」となっているが、記事サマリーの記述から胃腸/尿路感染の可能性が示唆されており、単一患者の医療事例と判断される。感染症危機管理の観点からのシグナルとしては該当しない。

article.articleHeadline: Vírus Oropouche se espalhou por todos os estados brasileiros e já infectou 5,5 milhões, estima estudo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Oropouche virus has spread to all Brazilian states and has already infected 5.5 million people, according to a study.
article.articleSummary: Nature Medicine, published March 24, 2026, estimates the Oropouche virus has spread to all Brazilian states, infecting about 5.5 million people; infections in Latin America and the Caribbean total roughly 9.4 million from 1960–2025. In Manaus, Amazonas, seroprevalence rose from 11.4% in 2023 to 25.7% in 2024, indicating extensive exposure. Endemic to the North, Oropouche fever is transmitted mainly by the biting midge Culicoides paraensis (maruim); sylvatic and urban transmission cycles exist, with Culex quinquefasciatus also implicated in the urban cycle. Manaus is highlighted as a transmission hub during the 2023–2024 reemergence due to population density and airport connectivity. Drivers include deforestation and land-use change along with widespread vector distribution; a likely new variant could be more adaptable/virulent and evade antibodies. Underreporting is expected; autochthonous transmission has been documented in Bolivia, Colombia, Cuba, Ecuador, Peru, and Venezuela (2024–2025), with travel-associated cases in Canada, the United States, Italy, Spain, and Germany.

triage.headline_ja: オロポウシェウイルスがブラジルの全州に広がり、550万人が感染したと推定される
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響：550万人感染、異常性：急速な地理的拡大と新規変異の可能性、国際的拡大リスク：複数国での自動感染と渡航関連症例）。WPROスクリーニング基準5つすべて該当。フルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIが多数の国を列挙していますが、サマリー上で確認される対象国リストに該当するのはブラジルのみ。ボリビア、コロンビア、キューバ、エクアドル、ペルー、ベネズエラでの自動感染が記載されているが、対象国リストに含まれていないため除外。カナダ、米国、イタリア、スペイン、ドイツは渡航関連症例のみで、発症地ではないため除外。Nature Medicineの査読論文（2026年3月24日発表）に基づく大規模流行の記述。新規変異の可能性、マナウスの空港ハブ特性、低報告率の指摘があり、リスク再評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Bird flu outbreak in Bilaspur: Here's how to safely consume chicken, eggs - CNBC TV18
article.articleSummary: Bird flu outbreak in Bilaspur district, Chhattisgarh, has killed about 5,500 chickens at a state-run poultry farm. Lab tests confirmed avian influenza (influenza A, mainly H5 and H7); authorities say SOPs are being followed and a 10-km radius ban on sale/transport of chicken and eggs is in place around the farm. In response, 22,808 hatchlings and other birds were buried, along with 80 quintals of feedstock and plastics; sanitation of steel/iron materials is underway. Avian Influenza is a bird infection, with no evidence of human illness from eating properly cooked poultry, though handling or consuming raw/undercooked products can pose risks. Guidance: avoid poultry from outbreak areas; cook chicken and eggs to 165°F/74°C; prevent cross-contamination; do not wash raw poultry; ensure fully cooked eggs; pasteurised milk is safest.

triage.headline_ja: ビラスプールでの鳥インフルエンザ流行：鶏と卵を安全に摂取する方法
triage.triage_reason: チャッティスガル州ビラスプール地区での鳥インフルエンザによる家禽死亡事例（5,500羽）で、WPROスクリーニング基準の「異常/予想外」「重症度」に該当。ただし人への感染例はなく、対策が実施されているため、現段階ではWATCHとして経過観察が適切。
triage.notes: 記事はインド（特にチャッティスガル州ビラスプール）での家禽における鳥インフルエンザ確認事例。人への感染例は報告されておらず、公衆衛生上の深刻な影響は現段階では限定的。ただし感染しやすい家禽への感染と、広域の対策実施（10km禁止区域、埋却処理）が報告されているため、スクリーニング基準で複数項目該当。IHR基準では2つ以上に該当せずフル評価の水準には達しないが、続報確認によって判定が変わる可能性あり。

article.articleHeadline: महिलाओं में साइलेंट किलर क्यों बन रहा टीबी, जानें यह बीमारी कितनी खतरनाक?
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Why is tuberculosis becoming a silent killer among women, and how dangerous is this disease?
article.articleSummary: Tuberculosis (TB) is increasingly a silent killer among women, extending beyond lungs to female genital TB, which damages reproductive organs. TB is a bacterial infection spread through the air when an infected person coughs, sneezes, or spits. Female genital TB can affect fallopian tubes, uterus, ovaries, and cervix, most commonly the fallopian tubes, causing infertility and pregnancy problems. Symptoms are often nonspecific and may include pelvic pain, menstrual irregularities, abnormal bleeding or discharge, along with general TB signs like fever, night sweats, weight loss, and loss of appetite. Risk factors include weakened immunity, diabetes, HIV, poor living conditions, crowded housing, malnutrition, and limited access to health services, all of which aid transmission and delay diagnosis. If identified and treated with antibiotics, TB can be cured, but completing the full course is essential to prevent lasting damage.

triage.headline_ja: 女性における結核がなぜサイレントキラーになっているのか、この病気はどの程度危険なのか？
triage.triage_reason: 結核とHIVの共感染は重大な公衆衛生課題だが、本記事は医学教育的な解説記事であり、新規の疾病クラスタや異常事象の報告ではない。情報が教育的性質であるため、シグナル性は限定的。
triage.notes: 本記事はインドにおける結核（特に女性の生殖器結核）の公衆衛生的課題に関する教育的解説記事である。既知のリスク因子（免疫低下、HIV、糖尿病、不十分な生活環境など）と臨床症状についての一般向け情報提供が主眼。新規クラスタ、異常事象、アウトブレイク情報の報告ではないため、フルRRA優先度は低い。ただしHIV共感染との関連や多剤耐性結核の懸念がある場合は継続監視が妥当。

article.articleHeadline: 国家疾控局：这几类病媒生物传染病由境外病例输入引起本土疫情的风险提升
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: National CDC: The risk of domestic outbreaks of these vector-borne infectious diseases caused by imported cases from abroad has increased.
article.articleSummary: On 2026-03-26, China's National Center for Disease Control and Prevention warned that rising temperatures and more active disease vectors have increased the risk of domestic outbreaks triggered by imported cases of vector-borne diseases. Dengue fever, chikungunya, and malaria face heightened local transmission risk in China due to cross-border case imports, based on epidemiological patterns and multi-channel surveillance. Fever with thrombocytopenia syndrome (FTS) will enter the epidemic season. Norovirus infection and other infectious diarrheas remain in their seasonal peak, while hand-foot-mouth disease is approaching its spring–summer peak. Respiratory infectious diseases are at relatively low levels. Spring travel raises exposure to vectors; authorities advise preventing mosquito and tick bites, frequent handwashing, and ensuring safe food and drinking water to enjoy the season.

triage.headline_ja: 国家疾控局：これらの媒介昆虫感染症は海外からの症例輸入による国内疫情発生リスクが上昇
triage.triage_reason: 複数の重要な感染症（デング熱、チクングニア熱、マラリア、SFTS、ノーロウイルス、エンテロウイルス71）が中国で同時に警告されており、国家CDC公式警告による異常性・重症度・国際的懸念が複合的に満たされている。複数の感染症の季節性ピークと海外輸入症例による国内流行リスク上昇が示唆されている。
triage.notes: 中国国家CDC公式警告による複数感染症の同時警告。デング熱、チクングニア熱、マラリアの媒介昆虫感染症に加え、SFTS（発熱性血小板減少症候群）、ノーロウイルス、手足口病など多様な感染症が季節的ピークに入ると指摘。春季の旅行に伴う媒介昆虫への曝露リスク増加と海外からの輸入症例による国内流行リスク上昇が明示されている。WPROスクリーニング基準全5項目該当。

article.articleHeadline: Kemenkes catat penurunan kasus campak hingga 95 persen
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ministry of Health records a 95 percent decrease in measles cases.
article.articleSummary: Measles in Indonesia fell sharply by week 11 of 2026 to 177 suspected cases and 121 confirmed, about 95% lower than week 1 (2,740 suspected, 2,268 cases). Week 9 had 8,716 cases and 10,826 suspects; week 8: 8,372 cases, 10,453 suspects, 6 deaths; week 7: 572 confirmed cases and 4 deaths. The Health Ministry credits mass immunization campaigns and hygiene education. As of 12 March 2026, 45 measles outbreaks (KLB) occurred across 11 provinces (Sumatra Utara, Sumatera Barat, Sumatera Selatan, Banten, West Java, Central Java, Yogyakarta, East Java, Nusa Tenggara Barat, South Sulawesi, Central Sulawesi). 22 districts conducted Outbreak Response Immunization (ORI) MR for ages 9–59 months; top ORI coverage: Pamekasan 47.93%, Jember 38.64%, Bima 22.73%. Five districts/cities conducted Catch Up Immunization (CuC) for MR, led by Jakarta Pusat 80.4% and Jakarta Barat 56.4%. Fifty-one health quarantine units support MR, aiming for 95% coverage before Lebaran 2026.

triage.headline_ja: 保健省は麻疹患者数の95パーセントの減少を記録
triage.triage_reason: インドネシアで麻疹の大規模流行が発生していたが、現在は急速に改善している。情報は主に良好な進展を示しているが、依然として複数州で流行が継続中であり、予防接種キャンペーンの効果検証が必要な段階。
triage.notes: 記事はインドネシアにおける麻疹流行の改善傾向を報告している。週1から週11にかけて患者数が95%減少したが、依然として11州45のアウトブレイクが継続中であり、政府による大規模予防接種キャンペーンが進行中。流行の終息段階にあるが、完全な制御前であるため経過観察が適切。

article.articleHeadline: Ituri : plus de 50 cas de morsures de chiens enregistrés en trois
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ituri: more than 50 cases of dog bites recorded in three.
article.articleSummary: In Ituri province, Bahema-Sud sector, south of Irumu territory, at least 50 dog-bite cases have been recorded in three months, centered in Kasenyi and Nyamavi near Lake Albert. An alert issued on March 24 by Dr. Dramani Musafiri, head of the Kasenyi veterinary dispensary, attributes the rise to a proliferation of stray dogs roaming the area. He warns most stray dogs carry rabies, a deadly viral disease posing risks to humans and domestic animals. He urges owners to register and vaccinate their dogs at Kasenyi dispensary and to keep dogs under control to curb further bites. Bahema-Sud civil society demands swift government action to halt stray-dog proliferation and protect the population from renewed rabies risk, calling for strict measures. The situation is a significant public health issue in Bahema-Sud.

triage.headline_ja: イトゥリ州：3ヶ月間で50件以上の犬噛み被害が報告される
triage.triage_reason: 狂犬病に関連した50件以上の犬噛み被害がDRCで報告されており、IHR基準で「深刻な公衆衛生への影響」「異常性」に該当し、管理可能性の懸念もある。フルリスク評価に進むべき案件。
triage.notes: 記事は狂犬病リスクを伴うイトゥリ州での犬噛み被害の急増を報告しており、地域での予防接種キャンペーンの必要性と野良犬管理についての行動を求めている。3ヶ月で50件以上という数字は当地域では異常であり、狂犬病の潜在的な流行リスクとして警視すべき。

article.articleHeadline: 国家疾控局：我国已稳步迈入结核病中低流行国家行列
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: National Center for Disease Control and Prevention: China has steadily joined the ranks of countries with medium-to-low tuberculosis prevalence.
article.articleSummary: As of March 26, 2026, China has entered the ranks of countries with medium-to-low tuberculosis prevalence, per the National Center for Disease Control and Prevention. Deputy director Liu Qing described a multi-pronged TB control strategy: expand use of new diagnostic technologies to maximize case finding; conduct chest imaging and pathogen testing for high-risk groups; integrate healthcare resources to provide prevention, hospital-based treatment, and community health management for TB patients. Advances include molecular drug-resistance testing, reducing diagnostic time from 4–8 weeks to 2–6 hours; by end-2025, drug-resistant TB screening reached 91%, above the global average of 83%. The program employs regionally differentiated control measures and promotes TB-free communities, with incidence in such areas falling 20–40%. Since 2012, TB incidence and mortality declined by about 30%, and treatment success remains above 90%.

triage.headline_ja: 国家疾控局：我国已稳步迈入结核病中低流行国家行列
triage.triage_reason: 中国の結核制御プログラムの成功事例に関する公式発表。患者数・死亡数の減少傾向、診断技術の向上、治療成績の改善など肯定的な進展が報告されており、新規の公衆衛生危機ではなく、既存の感染症対策の進展を示すニュース。
triage.notes: 本記事は結核の新規集団発生やアウトブレークを報告するものではなく、中国の結核制御プログラムの長期的な成功（2012年以来の患者数・死亡数30%減、治療成功率90%以上維持）を発表する公式声明。むしろ流行の低下と管理の改善を示唆する内容。シグナルトリアージの対象外。

article.articleHeadline: Mang thai 18 tuần, cô giáo mầm non nhập viện vì bị học sinh lây bệnh truyền nhiễm
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 18 weeks pregnant, preschool teacher hospitalized after contracting an infectious disease from students.
article.articleSummary: Chickenpox (varicella-zoster virus) in a 26-year-old pregnant preschool teacher at 18 weeks gestation in Hanoi. Admitted to Bach Mai Institute of Tropical Diseases/Hospital after direct exposure to infected children. Symptoms: sustained fever 38.2°C, fatigue, headache, vesicular rash on face, chest, and back. Investigations showed elevated inflammatory markers, splenomegaly, and fetal tachycardia (177 bpm). Treated with acyclovir and vigilant monitoring; fever resolved and skin lesions halted progression after 3 days; both mother and fetus remained stable and were discharged with outpatient follow-up. Varicella-zoster is highly contagious via respiratory droplets and direct contact with vesicle fluid. Non-immune pregnant women are at higher risk of severe maternal disease (e.g., pneumonia) and fetal risk if infection occurs before 20 weeks—congenital varicella syndrome (skin scarring, limb hypoplasia, cataracts, neurodevelopmental issues). Vaccination is the best prevention but live attenuated vaccines are contraindicated during pregnancy; complete vaccination at least 1 month before pregnancy.

triage.headline_ja: 妊娠18週の幼稚園教諭が生徒からの感染症に罹患し入院
triage.triage_reason: 水痘は対象国ベトナムで発生しており、妊娠中の重症例であるため臨床的関心はあるが、単一症例の個別事案であり、公衆衛生的な流行警告に該当する明確な兆候は認められない。情報収集と経過観察が必要。
triage.notes: 単一症例報告であり、患者はすでに軽快・退院している。水痘は周知のウイルス性疾患で、本報告は妊婦への重症化リスク啓発の医学的情報記事と考えられる。流行拡大の兆候やWHO通知基準を満たすイベントではないが、ベトナムでの水痘活動動向の今後の推移を注視する価値がある。

article.articleHeadline: 宁远县莲花小学开展2026年春季诺如病毒防控专题培训_科教_永州站
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ningyuan County Lianhua Primary School Conducts Spring 2026 Norovirus Prevention and Control Special Training | Science & Education | Yongzhou Edition
article.articleSummary: Norovirus prevention and control training was held on March 23, 2026, at Ningyuan County Lianhua Primary School in Yongzhou. The session targeted springtime campus infectious disease risk and focused on Norovirus transmission routes, typical symptoms (vomiting, diarrhea, fever), and incubation characteristics, emphasizing core prevention measures. It detailed morning and afternoon health checks, procedures for monitoring and tracing illness-related absences, and etiologic verification of cases. For campus food safety, the training stressed procurement, handling, processing, and sample retention hygiene to ensure a strong 'entry gate' against contamination. The program reinforced campus prevention responsibilities and updated contingency plans. Moving forward, Lianhua Primary School will maintain routine prevention activities, conduct periodic health education and drills, and strive to provide a safe, healthy, and orderly learning environment for students.

triage.headline_ja: 宁远县莲花小学开展2026年春季诺如病毒防控专题培训（宁远県蓮花小学が2026年春季ノロウイルス防御・対策専門研修を開催）
triage.triage_reason: 学校での予防啓発訓練の報道であり、実際の集団発生、死亡、入院例等の具体的な患者発生を示す情報がない。IHR基準、WPROスクリーニング基準のいずれも満たさない。
triage.notes: 本記事は湖南省永州市寧遠県の小学校におけるノロウイルス予防研修の実施内容についての一般的な啓発報道である。実際の患者発生事例、流行疑い、または感染症危機の具体的な兆候は記載されていない。教育機関による予防活動の一環として位置付けられ、シグナル検知の対象となる感染症イベントには該当しない。

article.articleHeadline: 近期感染性腹泻仍处于流行季 手足口病将进入春夏流行季
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Infectious diarrhea remains in the epidemic season; hand, foot and mouth disease will enter the spring–summer epidemic season.
article.articleSummary: Dengue fever, chikungunya, and malaria imported cases raise domestic outbreak risk in China as temperatures rise and vectors become more active. The National Center for Disease Control warned that overseas importations are increasing the chance of local transmission for these vector-borne diseases. Severe fever with thrombocytopenia syndrome (SFTS) is entering its peak season. Norovirus infections continue in the infectious diarrhea season. Hand, foot and mouth disease (HFMD) is moving into the spring–summer transmission period. Overall respiratory illnesses remain at a relatively low level. Public health officials urge springtime travelers and outdoor enthusiasts to take anti-mosquito and anti-tick precautions, practice frequent handwashing, and ensure safe food and water to stay healthy. Ongoing surveillance and preparedness for spring–summer outbreaks are emphasized.

triage.headline_ja: 近期感染性腹泻仍处于流行季 手足口病将进入春夏流行季
triage.triage_reason: 複数の既知感染症の季節的流行予測と輸入症例に関する公衆衛生警告であり、IHR基準は明確に満たさないが、WPROスクリーニング基準で異常性・長期曝露・流行しやすさが該当する。情報は予測的であり、実在する流行の規模や重症度の詳細が不明なため、WATCH段階での経過観察が適切。
triage.notes: 記事は中国の国家CDCからの季節的流行警告であり、複数の媒介動物感染症（デング熱、チクングニア、マラリア）の輸入症例増加と国内伝播リスク、及びSFTS、ノロウイルス、手足口病の季節的流行入期を報告している。現在進行中の流行の具体的な患者数、死亡数、施設での集団発生などの詳細データが提供されていないため、重症度の判定は困難。輸入症例による国内伝播リスクの点で注視価値あり。

article.articleHeadline: TP.HCM: 1 sinh viên mắc bệnh viêm não mô cầu
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ho Chi Minh City: 1 student contracted meningococcal meningitis.
article.articleSummary: As of 26 March 2026, one case of meningococcal meningitis was reported in Ho Chi Minh City, Bình Loi Trung Ward, during week 11.2026 (Mar 9–15). The patient is a 21-year-old university student at the University of Transport, currently studying online. Onset was Mar 9; admitted to Gia Dinh People's Hospital on Mar 10 and transferred to the Hospital for Tropical Diseases on Mar 11. The patient had not received meningococcal vaccination and is now in stable condition. Two housemates are being monitored and given a single 500 mg ciprofloxacin dose as post-exposure prophylaxis. HCDC will monitor close contacts for 10 days to prevent transmission. The Ministry of Health recommends prevention: personal hygiene, regular handwashing, covering the mouth when coughing, gargling with antiseptic solution, and maintaining well-ventilated living/working spaces. Vaccination is advised for children, adolescents, and high-risk individuals at qualified health facilities.

triage.headline_ja: ホーチミン市：1人の学生が髄膜炎菌性髄膜炎に罹患
triage.triage_reason: 髄膜炎菌性髄膜炎の単一症例報告であり、IHR基準2つ以上該当しない。ただしベトナムは対象国であり、クラスター発生の可能性や感染拡大リスクをスクリーニングして継続監視が必要。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーから、症例は単発だが未接種の大学生で、密接接触者への追跡監視が進められている。髄膜炎菌性髄膜炎はヒト-ヒト感染が可能な流行しやすい疾患であり、クラスター発生リスクがある。保健当局（HCDC・保健省）による介入と推奨が報告されており、政府レベルの関心が示唆されている。症例数は現在1名だが、長期曝露リスク（密接接触者への感染リスク）と流行しやすさ基準により、フルRRA実施前の経過観察（WATCH）が適切。

article.articleHeadline: Donor Funding Cut Threatens Ghana's TB Fight  --  Dr Ziem - Ghanaian Times
article.articleSummary: TB in Ghana faces funding cuts as Global Fund support declines from about $23 million to $14 million for the next three years, threatening progress toward eliminating TB as a public health threat by 2030. In Accra, Dr Benard Ziem of the National TB Control Programme calls for urgent domestic financing and integration with the proposed Free Primary Healthcare policy and NHIS uncapping. Ghana records about 44,000 new TB cases annually, with only roughly half detected and placed on treatment, sustaining transmission; nonetheless, treatment success is about 95% and TB deaths have fallen from 51 to 32 per 100,000. The Ministry and partners pledge private-sector collaboration; 10 digital X-ray machines and 15 GeneXpert machines were donated to boost detection and treatment. TB is caused by Mycobacterium tuberculosis, spread via coughing or sneezing, with symptoms including a persistent cough (>3 weeks), chest pain, fever, night sweats, and weight loss.

triage.headline_ja: 寄付金カットがガーナの結核対策を脅かす――ジーム博士
triage.triage_reason: 結核という既知の感染症で深刻な公衆衛生課題であり、スクリーニング基準（重症度、長期曝露、流行しやすさ）に複数該当するが、新規アウトブレイク或いは異常な状況は報告されておらず、社会的関心は資金問題に限定されている。情報不足のため経過観察段階が適切。
triage.notes: ガーナは対象国（GeoNames ID 2300660）として確認。結核は既知の風土病で、新規アウトブレイク或いは技術的異常性はないが、年間44,000件の新規患者、検出率・治療率の課題、および国際援助資金の大幅減少（約23百万ドルから14百万ドルへ）は管理可能性の低下を示す。IHR基準は1項目のみ該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響）だが、WPROスクリーニング基準の4項目該当および政府・国際支援の関心から、完全な見送りではなく注視が適切。

article.articleHeadline: 近半港人過去一年曾染新冠　比例顯著高於亞太地區
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Nearly half of Hong Kong residents have contracted COVID-19 in the past year, a rate significantly higher than that of the Asia-Pacific region.
article.articleSummary: COVID-19 in Hong Kong shows a high recent infection burden: as of 2026-03-26, 46% of residents report infection in the past year, higher than the Asia-Pacific average of 37%. A Public Health Concern Group online survey of 5 APAC regions (seven–eight 2023) with 5,026 respondents, including 1,006 from Hong Kong, identified four waves since January 2023, with the May–July 2023 peak recording over 170 severe cases and more than 90 deaths. Experts warn another active cycle may begin in coming months. Infections correlate with substantial concern: 86% fear hospitalization, 96% worry about long COVID. About 53% are willing to take an updated vaccine; 24% are unwilling, 23% undecided. Hesitancy drivers include vaccine side effects (34%), cost (17%), belief that COVID-19 is no longer serious (13%), and presumed natural immunity (13%). Vaccination is urged for high-risk groups (elderly, chronic patients, children, pregnant women) alongside continued hygiene measures.

triage.headline_ja: 香港の約半数の住民が過去1年間に新型コロナウイルスに感染、アジア太平洋地域の平均を大きく上回る
triage.triage_reason: COVID-19の既知の流行地域（香港）での感染負荷の監視統計であり、異常性は限定的。ただし感染率の上昇傾向と公衆衛生対応の必要性が示唆されるため経過観察が適切。
triage.notes: 香港を対象地域とする記事であり、中国(1814991)として計上。COVID-19は既知の継続流行疾患であり、新規の異常性は低いが、高い感染率(46%)、重症例・死亡(過去3年で170例以上の重症、90例以上の死亡)、ワクチン躊躇(53%のみ接種意思)が報告されている。公衆衛生の継続的対応が必要と判断される。IHR基準は1つ該当（serious_impact）であり、従来のシグナル閾値(2つ以上)には達していないが、WPROスクリーニング基準で3つ該当するため、情報充足度のある「WATCH」判定とした。

article.articleHeadline: 女子多年肢体麻木，开颅抓出3厘米寄生虫！如何预防寄生虫感染？
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Long-standing limb numbness in a woman: a 3-cm-long parasite removed during craniotomy! How can parasitic infections be prevented?
article.articleSummary: Neurocysticercosis caused by Taenia solium larvae (cysticercus) was removed from the brain of a female patient at Southwest Hospital, Army Medical University, China. She presented with limb numbness and seizures beginning in 2021; follow-up imaging revealed a migratory intracranial lesion and a tunnel sign indicative of parasitic infection. A 3 cm white worm was extracted via craniotomy, and she recovered with resolution of symptoms. A history of lifelong consumption of unboiled water supported exposure risk. Preventive guidance includes thoroughly cooking meat, fish, and seafood to safe temperatures; preventing cross-contamination between raw and cooked foods; avoiding raw or undercooked animal products and wild game; safe drinking water; meticulous hand hygiene; regular deworming of pets; travel precautions to parasite-endemic areas; proper food processing and storage; and routine medical exams for early detection of parasitic infections.

triage.headline_ja: 女性の長年にわたる肢体麻痺：開頭手術で3cm寄生虫を摘出！寄生虫感染予防方法は？
triage.triage_reason: 単一症例報告であり、集団発生・流行の兆候がない。国内の医療機関での個別治療事例であり、公衆衛生上の重大な影響や国際的拡大リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: 神経嚢虫症（Neurocysticercosis）は感染症だが、本記事は中国の軍医学大学所属病院での単一患者の臨床症例報告。集団発生や流行の証拠はなく、医学的な教育的記事としての性質が強い。予防ガイダンスの提示は標準的な医療情報提供であり、シグナルトリアージの対象とならない。

diseases.name: Human Infection with Avian Influenza A H9N2
Human Infection with Avian Influenza A H5N8

article.articleHeadline: Πρώτο ανθρώπινο κρούσμα της γρίπης των πτηνών στην ΕΕ: Τι γνωρίζουμε - Dnews
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: First human case of avian influenza in the EU: What do we know - Dnews
article.articleSummary: First human case of avian influenza A(H9N2) in the EU confirmed by the Italian Ministry of Health in a Lombardy resident. The patient is hospitalized and had a preexisting condition; infection followed travel to a non-European country, though it remains unclear whether the person is an Italian citizen or a foreign visitor. A(H9N2) can infect humans via direct exposure to infected poultry or contaminated environments; there has been no confirmed human-to-human transmission, and infections are typically mild. The ECDC regards the risk to the EU/EEA general population as very low. Historically, nearly all human H9N2 cases have been in China (~90%), with additional cases in Cambodia, Vietnam, India, and Africa (Egypt, Senegal, Ghana). The most recent non-EU cases were in China in February; last year there were 29 mainland China cases. Avian Flu Diary notes a media report that the patient is a boy who traveled to Africa, but this is unconfirmed by Italy’s health ministry.

triage.headline_ja: EUでの初の鳥インフルエンザ人感染例：何がわかっているか
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3項目該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）。新規病原体による初の人感染例がEUで確認され、複数国での過去感染報告があり、国際的関心が高い。
triage.notes: 記事は主としてEU内（イタリア・ロンバルディア）での初の確認ケースを報告しているが、患者の渡航先がアフリカ（詳細未確認）とされ、疫学的にはアジア太平洋地域での過去感染歴が重要。対象国内の過去感染報告はChina、Vietnam、India、Ghanaで確認。EEA/EU一般人口へのリスク評価は「非常に低い」とされているが、新規輸入感染症としてのシグナル性は高い。

article.articleHeadline: V Italiji primer ptičje gripe podtipa H9N2 pri človeku v Evropi - Svet24.si
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In Italy, a case of avian influenza subtype H9N2 in a human in Europe
article.articleSummary: As of 26 March 2026, Italy reports a single human infection with avian influenza A(H9N2) in Lombardy, in a traveler returning from Africa who is being treated for other health conditions. Epidemiologist Gianni Rezza classifies the case as imported and low-pathogenic, with no domestic transmission detected among contacts. This marks the first confirmed human case of H9N2 in Europe. Authorities tested all close contacts; none were infected. Some Italian media had claimed a pediatric case, but the Health Ministry did not confirm this. Officials emphasize H9N2 is less virulent than H5N1 and stress there is no cause for alarm. Globally, roughly 90% of human H9N2 infections have occurred in China, with cases also reported in Cambodia, Vietnam, and India, and in African countries Egypt, Senegal, and Ghana.

triage.headline_ja: イタリアで鳥インフルエンザH9N2の人への感染例がヨーロッパで報告
triage.triage_reason: H5N1およびH9N2の人への感染で、IHR基準3つ以上該当（異常性・国際拡大リスク・渡航制限リスク）、且つ複数対象国での感染が確認されている。
triage.notes: イタリアは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations に含めず。記事サマリーで明示的に「グローバルにH9N2感染が中国（約90%）、カンボジア、ベトナム、インド、エジプト、セネガル、ガーナで報告されている」と述べられており、対象国の中ではChina、Vietnam、India、Ghanaが確認される。エジプト・セネガル・カンボジアは対象国でない。H9N2はH5N1より病原性が低いとされているが、初めてのヨーロッパでの人への確認例であり、国際的拡大リスクが高い。

article.articleHeadline: Bệnh tay chân miệng gia tăng, nhiều ca trở nặng do biến chủng EV71​
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Hand, foot and mouth disease on the rise, many cases worsening due to EV71 variant strain.
article.articleSummary: HFMD is rising in Ho Chi Minh City and southern Vietnam, fueled by the Enterovirus 71 (EV71) variant with high virulence. From January 2026 to March 26, 2026, Ho Chi Minh City recorded 7,294 HFMD cases, up 241.3% year over year; 98 cases are severe (grade 2B+), 1.3% of total, up 4.6-fold. Hospital data show about 30 inpatients at Children’s Hospital 1, including 8 severe cases (2B–3), with 60–70 outpatient visits. Children’s Hospital 2 reports 700–1,300 monthly visits and 80–160 admissions, including 4HFMD grade-4 cases. EV71 accounted for ~25% of tested samples, raising risks of encephalitis, myocarditis, and death, especially in children under 5. About 10% of adults are asymptomatic carriers. Authorities urge strengthened surveillance, school and community interventions, prompt laboratory confirmation (2B+ cases sent to HCDC), and MOH-guided responses, plus hygiene measures under the “3 clean” principle (eat/drink clean, live clean, hands/objects clean).

triage.headline_ja: 手足口病が増加、EV71変異株により多くの症例が重症化
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ以上該当（重症例・死亡リスク・予想外の増加率・国際拡大リスク）かつWPRO基準4つ以上該当（異常な241%増加、重症度上昇、広範な曝露、高い流行性）。当該地域における重大な公衆衛生上の懸念。
triage.notes: EV71による高病原性変異株の関与、重症例（脳炎・心筋炎・死亡リスク）の増加、特に5歳以下の小児への影響が顕著。前年比241%の急激な増加は異常であり、地域での監視体制強化と対応が報告されている。ホーチミン市での7,294症例中98症例が重症（1.3%）で、重症率が4.6倍に増加している点が特に懸念される。

article.articleHeadline: 国家疾控局：基孔肯雅热和发热伴血小板减少综合征纳入乙类传染病管理 - 欧洲头条
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: National CDC: Chikungunya fever and fever with thrombocytopenia syndrome included in Class B infectious diseases management - Europe Headlines
article.articleSummary: China’s National Center for Disease Control and Prevention has added chikungunya fever and Severe Fever with Thrombocytopenia Syndrome (SFTS) to Class B infectious diseases. The update aims to bolster outbreak prevention and response. For chikungunya, imported cases have occurred since 2008 with local outbreaks triggered by imports since 2010; despite global spread in tropical/subtropical regions, China faced localized clusters in 2025 as Aedes mosquito distribution and activity extend, increasing domestic transmission risk. For SFTS, first Chinese cases appeared in 2009; transmission is primarily tick-borne in mountainous and hilly regions, with direct reporting since 2010 revealing broader tick vectors and rising regional cases, elevating spread risk. The policy shift will enhance surveillance and early warning, strengthen guidelines and clinician training, promote vector-control and environmental sanitation, and expand public health education and risk communication to enable precise, proactive prevention and control.

triage.headline_ja: 国家疾控局：基孔肯雅热と発熱伴血小板減少症候群が乙類感染症管理に追加される
triage.triage_reason: 中国がChikungunyaとSFTSを乙類感染症に格上げしたことは、両疾患の国内リスク上昇を示す重要な政策決定であり、IHR基準2項目以上（異常性・公衆衛生影響）に該当し、国際的な拡大懸念（特にChikungunyaのベクター媒介性）も存在するため。
triage.notes: 記事はChikungunyaとSFTSの両者が中国で規制強化対象となったことが主軸。ケニアはBluedotの発生地域に含まれるが、サマリー中に具体的な現地発生例の記載がなく、中国の政策文書の背景情報としての言及のみと判断し、verified_locationsから除外した。両疾患共にベクター媒介性であり、気候変動による媒介動物分布域の拡大（Aedesの活動拡大）が指摘されている点は公衆衛生上重要。

article.articleHeadline: Dịch tay chân miệng ở trẻ nhỏ: Nhận biết sớm, chăm đúng cách để tránh biến chứng nguy hiểm
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Hand, Foot, and Mouth Disease in Young Children: Early Recognition, Proper Care to Prevent Serious Complications.
article.articleSummary: Hand, Foot, and Mouth Disease (HFMD) commonly affects children under 5, especially during seasonal transitions and hot, humid weather. It is caused mainly by Coxsackievirus A16 and Enterovirus 71, spreading via fecal-oral routes and contact with saliva, nasal secretions, or contaminated objects. Most cases are mild but can progress rapidly within 24–48 hours, risking serious neurologic or cardiac complications. Early signs include fever, poor appetite, irritability, sore throat, excessive drooling, mouth ulcers, and vesicular rashes on the hands, feet, knees, and buttocks. Seek hospital care for fever above 39°C, lethargy, vomiting, or inability to drink. Home care emphasizes fever control, soft foods, oral hygiene, rest, and infection control. Prevention focuses on handwashing, cleaning toys, avoiding shared items, and limiting exposure during outbreaks; no widely available vaccine exists. Recovery typically occurs in 7–10 days.

triage.headline_ja: 幼い子どもの手足口病：早期認識と適切なケアで危険な合併症を防ぐ
triage.triage_reason: Enterovirus 71による手足口病の教育的記事であり、ベトナムでの発生報告である。異常性・予想外性は低いが、重症化リスク（神経・心臓合併症）の記述があり、引き続き状況を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 本記事は一般向けの健康教育コンテンツであり、具体的な流行規模やイベント検出情報は記載されていない。Enterovirus 71は過去にベトナムで重大な流行を引き起こしているため、リスク要因は存在するが、現段階では記事サマリーのみでは急速な拡大を示す兆候は認められない。続報の公開情報を注視し、症例数増加やクラスター報告があれば即座にPICKUPへの昇格を検討する。

article.articleHeadline: Hongo se transmite de gatos a humanos: Esto es lo que dice el estudio al respecto
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A fungus is transmitted from cats to humans: This is what the study says about it.
article.articleSummary: Originating in Brazil, the zoonotic fungal pathogen Sporothrix brasiliensis has spread across Latin America to hyperendemic regions over recent decades, causing human sporotrichosis presenting skin lesions primarily via cat-associated transmission. A new study by researchers at the University of Buenos Aires, contrasted with findings from Radboud University Medical Center-CWZ in the Netherlands and disseminated on ScienceDirect, characterizes Sporothrix brasiliensis as a highly virulent emergent pathogen. In cats, the fungus may be transmitted in yeast phase through implantation by scratches, bites, direct contact with exudative mucocutaneous lesions, or via respiratory droplets from infected or colonized domestic cats. The outbreak underscores the difficulty of controlling feline transmission chains and the clonal expansion of strains, calling for a collaborative, multisectoral, transdisciplinary approach spanning veterinary, public health, and environmental sectors.

triage.headline_ja: 猫から人間に感染する真菌：研究が明らかにしたことはこれだ
triage.triage_reason: スポロトリコーシスは既知の人獣共通感染症であり、ブラジルとアルゼンチンで既に定着している真菌病である。記事は研究成果の発表であり、新規発生事例の報告ではなく、緊急度の高いシグナルではない。ただし人獣共通感染症かつ猫との接触リスクがあるため経過観察が必要。
triage.notes: 記事は新規発生の報告ではなく、既知の地域流行病（ブラジル発祥のSporothrix brasiliensisのラテンアメリカ拡大）に関する研究成果の発表である。猫を介した人獣共通感染は既に確立された知見。ブエノスアイレスの大学研究とオランダ研究機関の協同研究であるが、アルゼンチンは対象国リストに含まれないため、verified_locationsはBrazilのみ。スポロトリコーシスは通常、自然界の環状疾患であり、制御可能とされているため緊急性は低い。

article.articleHeadline: SUS passa a oferecer teste rápido para dengue; exame permite diagnóstico antes da fase aguda da doença | G1
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: SUS starts offering rapid dengue test; the test enables diagnosis before the acute phase of dengue | G1
article.articleSummary: Brazil's Unified Health System (SUS) has added a rapid dengue diagnostic test (NS1 antigen) to its national procedures, enabling diagnosis in the first days of fever. The blood-based immunochromatography test detects dengue viral protein early, differentiating dengue from other febrile illnesses with results in minutes. It can be used at basic health units and hospitals, at no cost to patients, and may be requested by doctors, nurses, and biomedical professionals for all ages. While already in effect, rollout depends on service organization and SUS system updates, with progressive incorporation, especially during periods of higher dengue circulation. Early detection aids clinical management—monitoring for platelet drops and risk of severe dengue—and strengthens epidemiological surveillance of virus circulation.

triage.headline_ja: SUSがデング熱の迅速検査を提供開始；検査により急性期前のデング熱診断が可能に | G1
triage.triage_reason: 本記事はブラジルの公衆衛生制度における診断ツール（迅速検査）の導入についての報道であり、新規の感染症アウトブレイクやシグナルではない。既存のデング熱流行に対する医療対応の改善策の報告に過ぎず、IHR基準・WPROスクリーニング基準ともに該当しない。
triage.notes: 本記事は既知のデング熱に対する診断能力の向上（NS1抗原検査の導入）について報じたもので、新規のシグナルではない。公衆衛生施策の実装に関する報道であり、トリアージの対象外。

article.articleHeadline: Travellers reminded to protect themselves against mosquito bites
article.articleSummary: 2025 travel-associated chikungunya cases in England rose to 160—the highest annual total since 2014—up 43% from 2024 (112), with 159 in England and 1 in Wales; London accounted for 56%. Infections were mainly linked to Sri Lanka (75), India (17) and Bangladesh (16). Dengue dropped to 344 cases in 2025 from 904 in 2024, with India, Thailand and Indonesia as frequent travel destinations. Imported malaria cases remained high at 1,629 in 2025, down from 1,812 in 2024, with most occurring May–October; prevention relies on antimalarials and mosquito bite avoidance. UK climate is not suitable for Aedes spp., so no onward transmission is expected. Two chikungunya vaccines have been approved in the UK and are available privately after clinician assessment. Travel advice emphasizes DEET repellents, protective clothing, bed nets, and consulting Travel Health Pro before departures.

triage.headline_ja: 渡航者に蚊刺咬に対する自己防護を促す
triage.triage_reason: 英国への輸入感染症（チクングニア、デング、マラリア）の報告であり、スクリーニング基準1つ以上該当。ただし英国は対象国でなく、記事は公式啓発・予防勧告性質であり、検証済み対象国での新規発生流行ではないため、PICKUP基準は満たさない。続報を注視すべき情報。
triage.notes: 本記事は英国への輸入感染症に関する政府啓発であり、英国内での自動感染流行リスクはない（蚊媒介性疾患に適したAedes spp.生息地がない）。記事の主題は英国の渡航者への予防啓発であるが、チクングニア・デング・マラリアの発生源はスリランカ、インド、バングラデシュ、タイ、インドネシア等の南アジア・東南アジア地域。対象国としてはインド、タイ、インドネシアのみを verified_locations に含める。スリランカはDECEP対象国外であるため除外。継続的な輸入症例の監視と渡航関連リスク管理の観点から情報価値あり。

article.articleHeadline: TB still killing in Ghana despite free treatment  --  Dr Totimeh
article.articleSummary: Ghana remains a TB-endemic country despite free treatment, warns consultant neurosurgeon Teddy Totimeh. On 26 March, he said nearly 70% of TB cases in Ghana are undiagnosed, and about one-third of those who develop TB will die, underscoring the need for intensified screening and awareness. Totimeh, who contracted TB early in his career, said symptoms are often misdiagnosed as malaria or typhoid, delaying treatment. TB spreads by prolonged close contact and mainly affects the lungs but can spread through the bloodstream to the brain and spine, causing paralysis, meningitis, or stroke. The disease is linked to poverty, overcrowding, and poor nutrition that weaken immunity and activate latent TB. Persistent cough, fever, or coughing blood should not be ignored, and stopping medication can lead to drug-resistant TB. TB is treatable if treatment is completed; improved living conditions and adherence are crucial.

triage.headline_ja: ガーナで無料治療にもかかわらず結核で依然として死亡が発生 - Dr Totimeh
triage.triage_reason: ガーナの結核流行は重篤な公衆衛生影響を示しており、未診断率が高く（約70%）、死亡率が高い（患者の3分の1）。このため IHR基準で複数（serious_impact, unusual_unexpected）に該当し、スクリーニング基準でも複数該当するため、フルRRAに進めるべき。
triage.notes: 記事は結核が主題であるが、同時にマラリアと腸チフスの誤診問題も指摘されている。ガーナは結核流行国として周知であり、未診断率の高さと死亡率の高さは緊急対応が必要な公衆衛生課題。医療従事者による警告発言も信頼性を高めている。

article.articleHeadline: 普通市民如何预防结核病？中疾控专家答羊晚记者问
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: How can ordinary citizens prevent tuberculosis? A China CDC expert answers Yangcheng Evening News reporters' questions.
article.articleSummary: On March 24, World Tuberculosis Day, China CDC TB Prevention and Control Center researcher Zhao Yanlin outlined practical TB-prevention measures for China, aligned with the 2026 theme: Comprehensive action, full commitment, and public participation to end TB. Tuberculosis is an airborne, chronic infectious disease that is preventable, curable, and controllable. Citizens should: 1) maintain daily protection—open windows for 30+ minutes, 2–3 times daily in homes and offices; wear masks in crowded public spaces and on public transport; cover coughs/sneezes; avoid spitting; and uphold regular sleep, balanced nutrition, exercise, and limit smoking and alcohol. 2) monitor for TB symptoms—cough or sputum for >2 weeks, coughing blood, low fever, night sweats, fatigue, or weight loss; seek prompt medical care and inform clinicians of duration. 3) high-risk groups (close contacts, elderly, diabetes, immunocompromised) should be regularly screened. 4) confirmed TB patients should adhere to treatment; do not stop meds, as most patients can be cured.

triage.headline_ja: 普通市民はどのように結核病を予防するか？中国疾病対策予防センターの専門家が羊城晩報記者の質問に答える
triage.triage_reason: 記事は結核の予防啓発・一般情報提供であり、新規の感染症クラスター、異常な流行、または急速な拡大を示していない。通常の公衆衛生メッセージであり、IHRおよびWPROスクリーニング基準の該当がない。
triage.notes: この記事は世界結核デーに合わせた中国疾病対策予防センターの予防啓発情報であり、新規イベント報告ではない。既知の風土病である結核についての一般的な予防措置と症状モニタリング情報を提供しているもので、シグナルトリアージの対象外と判定される。

article.articleHeadline: कानपुर के डॉक्टरों ने बच्ची के दिल से निकाली टीबी गांठ,चार घंटे चली हाई-रिस्क सर्जरी!
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Kanpur doctors removed a tuberculous mass from a girl's heart during a four-hour high-risk surgery.
article.articleSummary: Kanpur doctors at LP S Cardiology Institute removed a large tuberculous mass from a 12-year-old girl’s heart during a four-hour high-risk surgery. Fatehpur district resident Lakshmi Patel had progressive breathlessness at rest, swelling in the body and legs, and worsening cardiac symptoms. Echo revealed a large mass in the right heart nearly obstructing blood flow, with the surrounding pericardial membrane abnormally thickened and fluid around the heart. Although initially suspected to be a tumor, the lesion was identified as tuberculous in origin. The operation successfully excised the mass, and the patient remained completely safe during the procedure. The team calls the case the world’s first of its kind. This report underscores intracardiac tuberculosis presenting as a cardiac mass in a child, a rare, high-risk scenario managed surgically.

triage.headline_ja: カンプル医師が少女の心臓から結核性腫瘤を摘出、4時間の高リスク手術
triage.triage_reason: 医学的に稀な症例報告であるが、新規感染症の集団発生やアウトブレイクではなく、単一患者の診断および治療例。IHR基準およびWPRO基準のいずれも該当しない。
triage.notes: 本記事は結核の稀な合併症（心膜内結核による心臓内腫瘤）の医学的症例報告である。単一患者への外科的介入の成功事例であり、公衆衛生上の流行の兆候やアウトブレイクではない。シグナルトリアージの対象外。

article.articleHeadline: अमेरिका समेत इन देशों में फिर से बढ़ रहे कोरोना वायरस के केस, ये वेरिएंट बढ़ रहा चिंता
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: COVID-19 cases are rising again in these countries, including the United States; this variant is raising concerns.
article.articleSummary: SARS-CoV-2 BA.3.2 variant is fueling renewed concern as COVID-19 cases rise in the United States and other nations. CDC data show this lineage detected in 23 countries, with over two dozen US cases across 29 states and six international travelers as of March 2026, tracked by traveler-based genomic surveillance. BA.3.2 originated in South Africa about two years ago; Europe has also seen cases, including in Denmark and the Netherlands, and the variant accounted for about 35% of COVID-19 cases there last year. The spike protein carries roughly 75 mutations, raising worries of immune evasion and potentially reduced vaccine effectiveness, though no severe symptoms have been reported yet and transmission appears higher. India’s experts say no major local threat currently; vaccination coverage is high and symptoms resemble flu, but vigilance remains.

triage.headline_ja: アメリカを含むこれらの国でコロナウイルスの症例が再び増加しており、このバリアントが懸念を高めている
triage.triage_reason: SARS-CoV-2 BA.3.2バリアントが23カ国で検出され、国際的な拡大を示唆している。IHR基準では異常性（新バリアント）、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限のリスクが認められ、3つ以上該当する。社会的・政治的関心も高い。
triage.notes: 記事は米国、南アフリカ、オランダ、デンマークを言及しているが、対象国リストはインドのみ。BA.3.2バリアントの免疫回避懸念とワクチン有効性低下の可能性が重要。インドでは現在重大な脅威はないとされているが、ワクチン接種率が高く症状は軽度との情報。追跡は継続すべき。

article.articleHeadline: Xô, mosquito!: Prefeitura intensifica ação de combate à dengue neste sábado | Roraima em Foco
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Shoo, mosquito!: City Hall intensifies the fight against dengue this Saturday | Roraima in Focus
article.articleSummary: Boa Vista City Hall launches a vector-control campaign to eliminate breeding sites for dengue, Zika, and chikungunya in 14 high-infestation neighborhoods. The campaign begins on Saturday, March 28, 2026, with simultaneous visits to homes not accessible during prior rounds. It will also occur on two additional Saturdays in April (the 11th and 25th), with morning and afternoon shifts to maximize household coverage. Endemic disease control agents (ACEs) will visit domiciles, inspecting backyards to eradicate potential breeding sites and protect residents, especially those at home. Agents will be uniformed, bearing badges and identification. The effort targets arboviruses through environmental elimination of larval habitats, focusing on areas with elevated infestation indicators and continuing public health measures to reduce transmission.

triage.headline_ja: 蚊よ去れ！：ボアビスタ市役所が土曜日にデング熱対策を強化 | ロライマ州ニュース
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル（ロライマ州ボアビスタ）におけるデング熱、ジカ熱、チクングニア熱の媒介蚊対策キャンペーンの報道。地元保健活動に関する情報が主体で、深刻な異常事象や国際的拡大リスクは現時点では記載されていない。継続的な経過観察が必要。
triage.notes: 記事は地域の媒介蚊制御キャンペーンを報道しており、進行中の感染症対策活動を反映している。複数の蚊媒介性アルボウイルス（デング熱、ジカ熱、チクングニア熱）が同時に対象となっており、高い蔓延地域での継続的な曝露リスクが示唆されている。ただし、急速な増加、死亡報告、または国際的な拡大の明示的な証拠は記載されていない。地域の公衆衛生対応が機能しているため、「不明」な要素が多い段階での WATCH 判定。

article.articleHeadline: Tak Cuma Covid-19, Lab Canggih Milik Kalimantan Selatan Bisa Deteksi Kanker dan Tuberkulosis
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Not Just COVID-19, South Kalimantan's Advanced Lab Can Detect Cancer and Tuberculosis.
article.articleSummary: Banjarbaru, South Kalimantan, Indonesia, has developed an international-standard molecular biology laboratory with Biosafety Level 2+ to strengthen detection of infectious diseases and cancer screening. The facility, under Arlan Prabowo, enables PCR-based testing for a range of conditions beyond COVID-19, including TB, and HPV DNA testing for cervical cancer screening as part of government priorities to curb non-communicable diseases. Sample throughput is rising as districts increasingly send specimens to the provincial lab. The lab's capabilities are supported by a clinical microbiology specialist as the person in charge and trained analysts in molecular biology. Looking forward, services will expand to cover additional infections and cancers, aligning with growing demand for technology-driven health services in Kalimantan Selatan.

triage.headline_ja: COVID-19だけではない、南カリマンタン州の最新鋭ラボは癌と結核も検出可能
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は感染症の発生・流行イベントではなく、検査施設の能力紹介に関する情報提供記事である。実際の患者発生、流行兆候、公衆衛生上の急性的脅威を示す内容がなく、いずれのトリアージ基準も該当しない。
triage.notes: 本記事はインドネシア・南カリマンタン州の検査施設の機能紹介であり、新規感染症イベント、流行、または公衆衛生危機の報告ではない。COVID-19とTBの診断能力について言及されているが、これは施設整備の記事であり、実際の発生・流行データは含まれていない。シグナルトリアージの対象外。

article.articleHeadline: 初春肺炎高发季警惕社区获得性肺炎 科学防治守护呼吸健康
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Early Spring: A High-Incidence Season for Pneumonia — Be Vigilant for Community-Acquired Pneumonia; Science-Based Prevention and Treatment to Safeguard Respiratory Health.
article.articleSummary: Community-acquired pneumonia (CAP) surges in early spring in China, with more than ten million CAP cases annually and about 45% in people aged 65 and older. High-risk groups include those with diabetes, hypertension, or COPD. Symptoms: cough with sputum, chest pain, fever, and dyspnea; severe cases may lead to respiratory failure or septic shock. Spring factors—rapid temperature shifts, dry air, post-holiday indoor crowding, and vitamin D deficiency—increase susceptibility. Pathogens are diverse and influenza co-infection complicates diagnosis; rising antibiotic resistance (MRSA, MDR Streptococcus pneumoniae) challenges therapy. Prevention emphasizes vaccination (pneumococcal and influenza) for older adults and chronic-disease patients, plus ventilation, humidity control, hand hygiene, and prompt medical care for fever or cough. A novel adult CAP antibiotic, lefamulin acetate (brand Xin乐妥®), recently approved in China, offers IV and oral forms with a typical 5–7 day course; safe in the elderly and those with renal impairment, enabling IV-to-oral switch and shorter hospital stays.

triage.headline_ja: 初春肺炎高发季警惕社区获得性肺炎 科学防治守护呼吸健康
triage.triage_reason: 中国における市中肺炎（CAP）の季節的増加を報告しており、高齢者や慢性疾患患者での重症化リスク、抗菌薬耐性菌（MRSA、多剤耐性肺炎球菌）の拡大が述べられているが、具体的な流行規模、死亡例、新規クラスタ形成の情報が不足。教育的・啓発的な内容であるため即座のPICKUPの基準に達しない可能性がある。
triage.notes: 記事は市中肺炎（CAP）の季節的な増加と予防啓発が主題。年間1,000万件超のCAP症例、65歳以上での高発症率、MRSA・多剤耐性肺炎球菌などの抗菌薬耐性菌の拡大が指摘されている。ただし、異常な流行の報告というより、春季の季節性疾患への警戒呼びかけであり、新規医薬品（レファムリン酢酸塩）の紹介も含まれるため、啓発記事の性質が強い。引き続き流行動向と耐性菌の拡大状況を注視すべき。

article.articleHeadline: 安特羅腸病毒疫苗三期臨床數據 發表於國際知名期刊npj Vaccines | 聯合新聞網
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Phase 3 clinical data of the Antro-enterovirus vaccine published in the internationally renowned journal npj Vaccines | United News Network
article.articleSummary: Antro Enterovirus 71 vaccine, produced by Guoguang Biotech at its Tanzi (Taichung) plant using a bioreactor, reports phase 3 data published in npj Vaccines. In Taiwan and Vietnam, 4,011 children received two doses 28 days apart, achieving 99.21% efficacy and 100% reduction in EV71-related hospitalizations. Longitudinal follow-up includes a 2-year Vietnam study with 100% seroprotection, and a ongoing 7-year durability study in Taiwan. The vaccine has lower antigen/adjuvant content, with favorable safety and low fever incidence. Taiwan granted regulatory approval in 2023; applications are ongoing in Vietnam, Macau, and Thailand, with regional expansion planned. GMP-certified in Thailand and Vietnam; projected annual capacity above 1 million doses to meet Southeast Asian demand. The program supports regional EV71 protection via scalable bioreactor-based production.

triage.headline_ja: 安特羅腸病毒疫苗三期臨床數據 發表於國際知名期刊npj Vaccines | 聯合新聞網
triage.triage_reason: 本件はEnterovirus 71ワクチンの臨床試験結果の学術発表報告であり、感染症アウトブレイク・危機管理イベントではない。ワクチン開発進捗の報道であり、現在の感染症流行・発症事例は記事に含まれていない。
triage.notes: 本記事は医薬品開発・臨床試験の進捗報道であり、感染症危機管理のシグナルトリアージ対象外。発生地域フィールドに多数の国が列挙されているが、これはワクチン開発・申請の対象国であり、実際のアウトブレイクイベントではない。

article.articleHeadline: ▷ Brote de fiebre chikungunya en Lomas de Zamora: síntomas y alerta epidemiológica | Actualizado marzo 2026
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: ▷ Chikungunya Fever Outbreak in Lomas de Zamora: Symptoms and Epidemiological Alert | Updated March 2026.
article.articleSummary: An autochthonous Chikungunya fever case was detected in Ingeniero Budge, within Lomas de Zamora, Buenos Aires Province, Argentina, prompting a sanitary alert. After confirmation, ten more symptomatic individuals were isolated. The vector Aedes aegypti transmits chikungunya, the same mosquito responsible for dengue. The initial symptomatic case appeared on March 5, with officials citing possible local transmission linked to previously imported cases. Regionally, chikungunya cases are rising in Brazil and Bolivia; Argentine provinces such as Salta, Santiago del Estero, and Tucumán have reported locally acquired cases without travel. From July 2025 to March 14, 2026, 96 suspected Chikungunya cases were recorded: 5 confirmed, 2 probable, 69 negative, and 20 still under investigation. Of the confirmed cases, 4 were imported after travel to Bolivia and Cuba (Bahía Blanca, La Plata, and Lomas de Zamora with 2). The remaining autochthonous case is in Ingeniero Budge. Authorities urged intensified vector prevention and control in Aedes-affected areas.

triage.headline_ja: ロマス・デ・サモーラにおけるチクングニア熱の流行：症状と疫学的警報｜2026年3月更新
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で異常性・国際拡大リスク・渡航制限リスクの3基準に該当。WPROスクリーニング基準でも異常性・流行可能性・管理性で複数基準該当。ブラジルとボリビアにおける地域的な症例増加と局所伝播確認により国際的拡大リスクが明確。
triage.notes: アルゼンチンはWPRO対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations には記載せず。ただし記事サマリーはブラジルでのチクングニア症例増加を明記しており、ブラジルは対象国（GeoNames ID 3469034）であるため追加。ボリビア（対象国外）とキューバ（対象国外）への渡航関連輸入症例も確認されているが対象国ではない。複数国での局所伝播と輸入症例の地域的クラスター形成により、国際的な拡大リスクが高い。

article.articleHeadline: Nipah virus could turn into something "far more severe", scientists warn
article.articleSummary: Nipah virus remains a regional threat with two laboratory-confirmed cases recorded in West Bengal, India, on 26 January 2026. Both patients were nurses at a hospital in North 24 Parganas; one slipped into coma, required mechanical ventilation, and died in February; the other nurse was discharged. Nipah is a serious, rare zoonosis transmitted from bats or contaminated food, and can spread between people through close contact; there are no licensed vaccines or treatments, though early supportive care improves survival. WHO assesses a low spillover risk beyond India at present. The authors warn that deforestation, urban expansion, agricultural intensification, and greater human–bat interactions amplify risk; pigs magnify transmission. Similar conditions exist in Cambodia, Thailand, and the Philippines, increasing regional spillover potential. They advocate One Health approaches with regular funding, regional coordination, and continuous surveillance, ecological monitoring, and cross-border communication rather than episodic preparedness.

triage.headline_ja: ニパウイルスは「より深刻な」状況に変わる可能性がある、と科学者が警告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3つ以上該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）。ニパウイルスは高い致死率を持つ希少な人獣共通感染症で、東南アジア地域での拡大リスクが指摘されており、シグナルとして識別される。
triage.notes: カンボジアは発生地域に含まれているが、記事サマリーではカンボジアでの実際の発生は言及されていない。インド（西ベンガル州）での確認症例と、フィリピン、タイでの地域的なリスク増加が記事の主題である。ニパウイルスの高い致死率（記事で言及される患者死亡）と人獣共通感染症の性質、及びOne Healthアプローチの必要性の強調が、地域警戒の必要性を示唆している。

article.articleHeadline: Foot-and-mouth disease detected on KZN pig farm - SABC News - Breaking news, special reports, world, business, sport coverage of all South African current events. Africa's news leader.
article.articleSummary: Foot-and-mouth disease detected on a pig farm in the Dannhauser area of northern KwaZulu-Natal. Pigs on the affected farm have been vaccinated to contain the outbreak and reduce viral load. The disease began in KwaZulu-Natal in 2021 and has since spread nationwide, previously affecting mainly beef and dairy cattle. In Amajuba District, where Dannhauser is located, more than 13,000 pigs and over 4,000 cattle have been vaccinated. A nationwide mass vaccination campaign is underway to limit spread, with vaccination efforts in the southern Ugu and Harry Gwala districts largely completed and most herds covered.

triage.headline_ja: KZN(クワズル・ナタール州)の豚農場で口蹄疫が検出される
triage.triage_reason: 口蹄疫は重要な動物疾病だが、本イベントは南アフリカの家畜農場での発生であり、対象国(インド)ではない。インドは発生地域フィールドに含まれているが、記事サマリーでは南アフリカでの発生が主題である。動物疾病として既に確立した制御対策が進行中であり、人間への直接的な公衆衛生脅威は限定的。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIの発生地域フィールドにはインド(Uttar Pradesh, Ugu)が含まれているが、記事サマリーを注意深く読むと、口蹄疫イベントは南アフリカ(KwaZulu-Natal, Amajuba District, Dannhauser)で報告されている。インドの地名は誤った地理的マッピングの可能性があり、実際のイベント発生地は南アフリカのみ。対象国リスト内に南アフリカは含まれていないため、verified_locationsは空配列。

article.articleHeadline: МЕНА: Египетският посланик в Гана участва в приемането на доставка от медицинска помощ за борба с хепатит С
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: MENA: The Egyptian ambassador to Ghana participates in receiving a shipment of medical aid to combat Hepatitis C.
article.articleSummary: On 26 March 2026, Egyptian Ambassador to Ghana Wael Fathi attended a medical-aid shipment for Hepatitis C treatment, donated by Egypt to Ghana's Ministry of Health, according to MENA. Attendees included Ghana's Deputy Minister of Health, members of Parliament, health officials, WHO representatives, and local media. Ambassador Fathi highlighted President Abdel Fattah al-Sisi's Hepatitis C initiative and Egypt's commitment to supporting African states; Egypt's elimination of the virus, recognized by the WHO, underpins this aid. He noted growing Egypt–Ghana cooperation and the shared political will to strengthen bilateral ties rooted in long-standing historical links. Ghana's Deputy Minister commended Egypt's ongoing medical aid in fighting Hepatitis C, a major health challenge, and welcomed broader health-cooperation programs to bolster Ghana's health capacity. The shipment represents the third consecutive medical-aid delivery from Egypt, underscoring Cairo's sustained support for Africa, highly valued by Ghana's leadership and people.

triage.headline_ja: MENA: エジプト駐ガーナ大使がC型肝炎対策医療支援物資の受け取りに参加
triage.triage_reason: 本件はC型肝炎対策の医療支援物資の外交的な受け渡しセレモニーであり、新規の感染症アウトブレイクや公衆衛生上の危機を示す兆候がない。既知疾患の治療支援プログラムの報道である。
triage.notes: 本記事はC型肝炎の治療支援物資の外交的受け渡しセレモニーに関する報道。エジプトからガーナへの支援物資の第3次配送であり、既知疾患の治療プログラムである。新規の感染症クラスタ、アウトブレイク、または公衆衛生上の異常事態を示唆する情報は含まれていない。シグナル検知の対象外。

article.articleHeadline: 新冠活躍期或再臨 逾四成半人過去一年曾感染 專家籲高危人士及早接種更新疫苗
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: COVID-19 active phase could return; over 45% of people infected in the past year, experts urge high-risk individuals to receive the updated vaccine early.
article.articleSummary: COVID-19 activity in Hong Kong may enter another active phase as the virus continues circulating. An APAC survey shows 46% of Hong Kong respondents infected in the past year, higher than the regional average of 37%; Japan, Singapore, South Korea and Taiwan were also included. Experts note Hong Kong tends to cycle every 6–9 months; the last cycle ended about eight months ago, suggesting a new wave could arrive. Updated LP.8.1 COVID-19 vaccines are urged for high-risk groups before cases rise, given vaccine effectiveness against hospitalization at 70.2–84.9% and against death at 76.2–95.8%. Reinfection risk is ~20% higher in those with chronic disease. Childhood uptake of initial doses remains below 50%, though mRNA vaccines offer ~80% protection. The government provides free LP.8.1 vaccines to the elderly in care homes, 65+, 50–64 with chronic conditions, 6 months+ immunocompromised, and pregnant individuals; others may self-pay after medical advice.

triage.headline_ja: 新冠活躍期または再臨の可能性 過去一年間で45%以上の人が感染 専門家は高リスク者への早期ワクチン接種を促す
triage.triage_reason: COVID-19の再流行の可能性に関する専門家の警告は注視すべきだが、現時点では確定的なアウトブレイク報告や国際的拡大の明確な兆候がなく、情報がやや不足している。
triage.notes: 記事の主焦点は香港であり、China（香港含む）のみ verified_locations に含める。WPRO基準では prolonged_exposure（継続的なウイルス循環）と epidemic_prone（6-9ヶ月周期で流行しやすい特性）の2基準が該当。ただし現時点では「可能性」「警告」段階であり、確定的なアウトブレイク報告ではないため WATCH 判定とした。

article.articleHeadline: Онищенко рассказал о том, как должна осуществляться охрана от оспы обезьян
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Onishchenko explained how protection against Monkeypox should be carried out.
article.articleSummary: Monkeypox protection in Russia should go beyond border controls. Public health expert Gennady Onishchenko argues that containment has long focused on guarding borders and territories because travelers may be asymptomatic on arrival and develop symptoms at home. Primary healthcare must be alerted and trained, and diagnosis should be guided by geographic history as well as clinical signs. For example, a patient with fever and skin lesions who recently visited Thailand should trigger suspicion of monkeypox, prompting immediate isolation and treatment. Diagnostics must be available across the territory, not transported from places like Kamchatka to Moscow for confirmation. Local facilities should perform first line testing to prevent delays. The strategy emphasizes territorial surveillance, rapid local diagnosis, isolation, and timely treatment initiation when travel history indicates exposure.

triage.headline_ja: オニシェンコ氏がサル痘対策について説明：国境管理だけでなく包括的な対策が必要
triage.triage_reason: ロシアおよびタイで具体的なサル痘発生事例が報告されている可能性があり、公衆衛生対応戦略に関する専門家の見解が述べられている。ただし、現在の患者数や重症度などの具体的疫学情報が不足しており、緊急的なシグナルとは言い難い。
triage.notes: 記事はロシアの公衆衛生専門家による意見記事で、タイでの曝露歴を例に挙げている。ロシア自体の確定患者数や発生状況は記事サマリーから不明。サル痘は既知の人獣共通感染症であり、国際的に拡大するリスクがあるが、現時点での具体的な流行規模や重症度の情報が不十分。タイは対象国リストに含まれるため verified_locations に追加。ロシアは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Major travel warning as 'breakbone fever' cases soar after celeb Cuba trips
article.articleSummary: Dengue, or 'breakbone fever', prompted a CDC international alert after a higher-than-expected number of traveller-imported cases from 17 countries, including Cuba. In the United States, nearly 500 dengue cases have been reported so far in 2026, most among travellers returning from abroad. Dengue is transmitted by Aedes mosquitoes; symptoms typically include high fever, nausea, vomiting, a rash, and severe body aches, with a subset progressing to dengue haemorrhagic fever, a medical emergency that can cause internal bleeding, shock, organ failure, and death within hours. The CDC’s Level 1 travel notice does not ban travel but cautions risk assessment for Cuba and other destinations such as Vietnam, the Maldives, and Colombia. Preventive measures include registered insect repellent, long-sleeved clothing, and staying in air-conditioned or screened accommodations. Context includes a publicised aid mission to Havana by Jeremy Corbyn and Kneecap.

triage.headline_ja: セレブのキューバ旅行後に『デング熱』感染者が急増、主要な渡航警告が発令
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3つ以上該当（異常性・国際的拡大リスク・渡航制限リスク）。複数国での感染者増加と公式アラート発令により、フルRRA対象。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではベトナムとモルディブ・コロンビアが具体的に言及されているが、対象国リストではベトナムのみ該当。キューバからの輸入症例が米国CDCのLevel 1警告を引き起こし、複数国での急増が報告されている。高い社会的・政治的関心（有名人の旅行、公式アラート）。

article.articleHeadline: बिलासपुर में बर्ड फ्लू से हड़कंप, हजारों पक्षी नष्ट, बढ़ा संक्रमण का खतरा
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Avian influenza panic in Bilaspur as thousands of birds are culled; infection risk increases.
article.articleSummary: Avian influenza (bird flu) confirmed at a government poultry farm in Koni, Bilaspur, Chhattisgarh. Deaths began around 16–17 March; lab confirmation followed by March 26 after a five-day rise to thousands of dead birds and a six-day delay in sending samples. In response, authorities culled over 22,000 birds and more than 25,000 eggs, plus 79 quintals of feed and hatchery materials. A 1-km infected zone and a 10-km surveillance zone were declared, with a ban on bird trade in these areas. Kanan Pendari Zoological Park was closed for one week from March 25. Health teams conducted door-to-door surveys; some residents reported cold/flu symptoms and are tested if symptomatic. Despite the outbreak, chicken sales continued in nearby villages; enforcement gaps include open disposal of carcasses in the Khamtarai area and ongoing poultry supply. Staff shortages hinder containment efforts.

triage.headline_ja: ビラスプル市の鳥インフルエンザ混乱、数千羽の鳥が殺処分、感染リスク増加
triage.triage_reason: インドにおける高病原性鳥インフルエンザの確認事例。人獣共通感染のリスク、大規模な殺処分と複数州への拡大可能性、公衆衛生上の深刻な懸念が認められ、IHR基準3つ、WPROスクリーニング基準複数該当。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーから、チャッティスガル州ビラスプル地区の政府家禽農場で高病原性鳥インフルエンザが確認されたことが明確。3月16-17日から死亡鳥が発生し、22,000羽以上が殺処分。ヒマーチャル・プラデーシュ州との地理的近接性と、感染防止体制の不十分さ（スタッフ不足、死体の露天処分、密集した家禽飼育地域での継続販売）により、地域内および隣接地域への拡大リスク高。住民の呼吸器症状と検査の存在から、人獣共通感染のリスクが現存。

article.articleHeadline: Bird Flu In Chhattisgarh's Bilaspur: Over 22,000 Poultry Birds Culled, 25,000 Eggs Destroyed
article.articleSummary: Avian influenza (bird flu) outbreak in Bilaspur district, Chhattisgarh, at a government poultry farm in the Koni area. Infected from March 19–24, the outbreak prompted culling of 22,808 poultry birds and destruction of 25,896 eggs and about 79 quintals of poultry feed within the infected zone. Approximately 4,400 chickens died before confirmation. Authorities imposed strict movement controls, declaring a 1 km infected zone and a 10 km surveillance zone, and established a 24/7 control room. A rapid response team under the joint director of veterinary services was deployed; surveillance of farms intensified and poultry sale centers monitored. Health monitoring of farm workers is underway, with testing and antiviral treatment if symptoms appear. No human infections have been reported to date. Current date: 2026-03-26.

triage.headline_ja: チャッティスガルのビラスプルにおける鳥インフルエンザ：22,000羽以上の家畜が殺処分、25,000個の卵が破棄
triage.triage_reason: 家禽での鳥インフルエンザ集団発生であり、異常性・予想外性が高く、ヒトへの転じるリスクが存在する。IHR基準2項目（異常性・国際的拡大リスク）、WPRO基準3項目以上に該当。
triage.notes: 家禽での大規模集団発生（22,808羽殺処分）。現時点でヒト感染報告なしだが、農場労働者の健康監視が進行中。鳥インフルエンザは人獣共通感染症であり、今後のヒト感染への転じリスク監視が必要。インドは対象国に含まれ、チャッティスガル州で確認されている。

article.articleHeadline: UKHSA warning for anyone going on holiday after rise in infections
article.articleSummary: UKHSA warns holidaymakers after a travel-related infection rise, highlighting mosquito-borne diseases. In 2025, chikungunya infections in England, Wales and Northern Ireland rose 43% to 160 cases from 112 in 2024, with the majority linked to travel to Sri Lanka, India and Bangladesh. The illness causes fever, severe joint pain and swelling, muscle pain, headaches, nausea, fatigue and rash; symptoms can persist for weeks or months. Dengue cases fell to 344 in 2025, down from 904 in 2024. Imported malaria in the UK reached 1,629 cases in 2025, though this is down from 1,812 in 2024, malaria remains at high levels. Preventive measures include using DEET-based repellent, covering exposed skin, and sleeping under insecticide-treated nets; travelers should consult Travel Health Pro and may discuss chikungunya vaccination with a travel clinic, especially when travelling over Easter or spring.

triage.headline_ja: UKHSA、感染症増加に伴い休暇旅行者への警告を発令
triage.triage_reason: 複数の蚊媒介感染症（Chikungunya、Dengue、Malaria）の輸入症例が報告されており、WPROスクリーニング基準の異常性・長期曝露・流行性で該当する可能性があるが、主にUK国内での警告であり、IHR基準の国際的拡大リスク評価には情報が不足している。引き続き動向を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 記事はUK内の輸入感染症に関する警告であり、実際の発生地はインド、スリランカ、バングラデシュ。対象国リストではインドのみが該当。Chikungunya感染が2024年から43%増加（112→160例）、Malaria輸入症例が1,629例と高い水準であることが注目される。ただし、UK当局の予防啓発であり、対象国での新規発生の直接報告ではない点に留意。

article.articleHeadline: Saúde promove palestra para servidores no Dia Mundial de Combate à Tuberculose
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Health Department promotes a lecture for civil servants on World Tuberculosis Day.
article.articleSummary: On March 25, 2026, Ibiporã’s Municipal Health Department held a TB and leprosy training for about 70 health workers, aligned with World Tuberculosis Day. The session, titled 'Update: Diagnosis and Management of Tuberculosis and Leprosy,' occurred at the Center for Worker Technology Auditorium (CTTI) in Ibiporã. Lectures were delivered by municipal staff and members of the Infectology Action and Research Group from UEL. Ana de Sousa (UEL Nursing) and students Luana da Silva and Fabiane de Oliveira presented epidemiological data and emphasized contact tracing for leprosy and screening of individuals with respiratory symptoms of tuberculosis. Dermatologist Rafael Garani (CAIS) addressed leprosy diagnosis and management; Aline Yoshida (Municipal Epidemiological Surveillance) covered TB diagnosis, management, and infection control. Thalita Loução (SMS) highlighted simplified neurological examinations for leprosy and sampling techniques for TB. The event supports ongoing staff training to improve health services.

triage.headline_ja: 保健省がWorld Tuberculosis Dayに公務員向け講演会を開催
triage.triage_reason: 教育・訓練イベントの報道であり、感染症の異常発生、患者数増加、重篤例、死亡などの疫学的事象を示す証拠がない。IHR基準・WPROスクリーニング基準に該当しない。
triage.notes: 記事はブラジルのIbiporãにおけるWorld Tuberculosis Day（3月24日）関連の教育イベント報道。結核とハンセン病についての講演・訓練が約70名の保健労働者を対象に開催されたもので、疫学的シグナルではなく健康教育プログラムの報告である。患者数増加、異常発生、死亡事例などの証拠なし。
