article.articleHeadline: Easter holidaymakers warned about mosquitos after surge in tropical virus in UK
article.articleSummary: Chikungunya cases in the UK rose to 160 in 2025, up from 112 in 2024—the highest since 2014, per UKHSA. Transmission is by Aedes aegypti and Aedes albopictus, but onward UK spread is unlikely as these mosquitoes are not established here. Most infections are travel-associated, acquired abroad between April and September, linked mainly to holidays in India, Sri Lanka and Bangladesh. The illness causes sudden high fever and severe joint pain that can last months, with headaches, light sensitivity and rashes; fatalities are rare. Imported malaria remained high in 2025 at 1,629 cases, down from 1,812 in 2024. Two chikungunya vaccines have been approved in the UK and are available privately via travel clinics. Easter holidaymakers are advised to use DEET, wear protective clothing, sleep under bed nets, check Travel Health Pro, and seek pre-travel advice 4–6 weeks before departure.

triage.headline_ja: イースター休暇でのモスキート警告—英国でのトロピカルウイルス急増後
triage.triage_reason: チクングニヤ熱は英国での輸入症例の増加を示しているが、地域伝播の可能性は低く、対象国（インド、スリランカ、バングラデシュ）での流行データは記事に含まれていない。情報不足のため経過観察が適切。
triage.notes: 記事の主題は英国での輸入チクングニヤ症例の増加であり、実際の流行地はインド・スリランカ・バングラデシュ。バングラデシュは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。英国での地域伝播リスクは低いと明記されている。対象国での流行の詳細情報が不足しているため、WATCHレベルの評価とした。

article.articleHeadline: Gia tăng ca mắc tay chân miệng: Nhận biết ngay 6 dấu hiệu nguy hiểm ở trẻ
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Rising cases of hand, foot and mouth disease: Recognize six warning signs in children.
article.articleSummary: HFMD surges in Vietnam (March 2026): Ho Chi Minh City reports 837 new cases in the latest week, up 97% from the four-week average, with 2 deaths; year-to-date cases exceed 7,200 and deaths reach 3, a 241% rise versus 2025. Severe cases (2B+) total 98, up 4.6-fold. Enterovirus 71 (EV71) detected in 25% of tested samples (6/24), a virulent strain linked to neurological and respiratory complications; no specific antiviral exists. Hospitals are to admit per MOH guidelines, test all 2B+ HFMD cases at HCDC, and report via the Community Health Platform. In March 2026 the MOH approved an HFMD vaccine; VNVC is coordinating with Substipharm Biologics (Switzerland) to bring it to Vietnam. Hanoi records 187 cases in 13–20/3 (1,090 YTD) with 3 school outbreaks (22 total, 5 active). National Pediatric Hospital reports nearly 3,000 HFMD diagnoses this year, about one-third hospitalized; most cases mild, some progress rapidly.

triage.headline_ja: 手足口病の症例増加：子どもの6つの危険な兆候を認識する
triage.triage_reason: ベトナムでEV71を含む手足口病が急速に増加し、死亡例、重症例、学校での集団発生が報告されている。IHR基準3つ該当（深刻な影響、異常、国際的拡大リスク）し、WPROスクリーニング基準4つ該当（異常、重症度、長期曝露、流行しやすさ）。国内でも国際的にも注視が必要。
triage.notes: EV71は神経学的・呼吸器合併症のリスクが高い病原株。重症例が4.6倍に増加、死亡例3件報告。学校での集団発生複数（22件、5件が活動中）。ワクチン承認（2026年3月）が管理対策として進行中。ベトナム国外への伝播リスクも鑑みて、WPROレベルでの監視必要。

article.articleHeadline: TP.HCM ghi nhận một sinh viên mắc viêm não mô cầu, theo dõi người tiếp xúc gần
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ho Chi Minh City records a student with meningococcal meningitis; close contacts are being monitored.
article.articleSummary: Ho Chi Minh City (week 11: Mar 9–15) reports two meningococcal meningitis cases. A 21-year-old student from Bình Lợi Trung ward, Ho Chi Minh City, who studies online at the Transport University, developed symptoms Mar 9, was admitted Mar 10 to Gia Định People’s Hospital and Mar 11 to the Tropical Disease Hospital, discharged Mar 19 after stabilization; no vaccination against meningococcal disease reported. Two cohabitants received a single 500 mg ciprofloxacin prophylaxis, with 10 days of close-contact monitoring. A second case involves an 11-year-old from Phú Quốc, An Giang, treated at the Tropical Disease Hospital after close contact with a classmate who died from the disease on Mar 16. Early treatment within about 12 hours led to improvement after three days. Background: humans are reservoirs; carriers 5–25% generally, 30–40% in outbreak zones; disease spreads rapidly via respiratory droplets; mortality 8–15% with potential severe sequelae (hearing loss, cognitive impairment, paralysis).

triage.headline_ja: ホーチミン市で髄膜炎菌性髄膜炎の学生患者を記録、濃厚接触者を監視中
triage.triage_reason: 髄膜炎菌性髄膜炎の複数事例（2例）報告であり、IHR基準で「異常/予想外」「重症度」の2基準を満たし、また高い死亡率（8～15%）と急速な伝播リスクがあるため、フルRRA進行が必要。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーでホーチミン市（ホーチミン市管轄下の行政区）とフー・クォック（アンザン省）で2例の髄膜炎菌性髄膜炎が報告されている。アンザン省は対象国リストに含まれないため、検証済み地域はベトナムのみ。患者の年齢は21歳と11歳で、予防接種歴がない、またはワクチン未接種状況が明記されている。濃厚接触者の監視と予防的抗生物質投与が実施されており、保健当局による対応が確認できる。

article.articleHeadline: Belum 3 Bulan, Ada 277 Warga Sikka Digigit Anjing, 4 Positif Rabies
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In under three months, 277 Sikka residents were bitten by dogs, 4 positive for rabies.
article.articleSummary: Rabies cases in Sikka Regency, East Nusa Tenggara, Indonesia, escalated as of January 1–March 25, 2026, with 277 people bitten by dogs. Of 74 samples tested, four were positive for rabies, confirmed in the villages of Done, Leguwoda, Masabewa, and Bera; one suspected case in Paga. Eus Keupung, Head of Veterinary Health at the Sikka Agriculture Service, notes that public awareness and adherence to pet-management rules are critical, as reluctance to tether or regulate pets hampers vaccination efforts. In response, village-level SOPs activate upon lab-confirmed cases: the camat issues a decree to close the affected area, forwarded to the village to form a Rapid Response Team (TRC) with three working groups—Animal Health, Public Health, and KIE (communication, information, and education)—involving security personnel, community members, religious leaders, and health volunteers.

triage.headline_ja: 3ヶ月未満で277人がシッカ地域で犬に咬まれ、4人が狂犬病陽性
triage.triage_reason: インドネシア・シッカ地域で短期間に277人の犬咬傷事件と4件の狂犬病陽性確認が報告されており、異常性・重症度・感染伝播可能性を満たすスクリーニング基準が複数該当する。地域保健当局が公式な対応体制を整備している点も確認される。
triage.notes: シッカ地域は東ヌサテンガラ州に位置する。狂犬病は100%致死性疾患であり、277人の咬傷事件は通常予想外の規模。当局が村レベルのSOP発動と迅速対応チーム(TRC)の編成を実施している点から管理可能性の対応も確認されるが、ペットの不適切な管理が根本的課題として指摘されている。

article.articleHeadline: Wolbaquia: cooperação garante adoção de novo método contra a dengue em Curitiba
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Wolbaquia: Cooperation Guarantees Adoption of a New Method Against Dengue in Curitiba.
article.articleSummary: Curitiba adopts Wolbachia-method to reduce dengue, Zika and chikungunya transmission by replacing local Aedes with Wolbachia-infected mosquitoes. The Mayor signed a technical cooperation on March 25, 2026, between the Curitiba City Hall and Wolbito do Brasil, to implement the Wolbachia Method in the municipality. The Wolbito bio-factory in Curitiba—installed in 2025 as the world’s largest Wolbachia mosquito facility—works under a national program. The initiative, though Curitiba did not initially meet federal prioritization criteria, will proceed in Sítio Cercado neighborhood under two release strategies (egg releases and adult Wolbachia-carrying mosquitoes) to compare results within the same area. A one-month community-engagement phase precedes an estimated 26-week rollout. The program complements existing arbovirus prevention efforts; Curitiba already achieved a 92% reduction in cases in the past year, and Niterói (RJ) reported up to an 89% reduction in dengue after similar deployments.

triage.headline_ja: ウォルバキア：クリチバのデング熱対策における新しい方法の採用が協力により保証される
triage.triage_reason: ウォルバキア法によるデング熱・ジカ熱・チクングニア熱対策の実装という予防的介入であり、IHR基準の緊急性は低いが、ブラジルにおける生物学的制御の大規模展開として注視の価値がある。
triage.notes: 本記事はデング熱などの伝播を減らすための予防的なウォルバキア法の導入に関するもので、アウトブレイク報告ではない。クリチバ市がウォルバキア蚊ファクトリー（世界最大規模）を保有し、市域でのロールアウトを開始したことは、ベクター制御における革新的な介入であるため経過観察の価値がある。

article.articleHeadline: An emerging human eye disease is associated with aquatic virus zoonotic infection - Nature Microbiology
article.articleSummary: POH-VAU is an emergent recurrent anterior uveitis with persistent ocular hypertension identified in China and linked to CMNV, an aquatic virus. Across 18 high-aquaculture provinces, POH-VAU frequency correlated with aquaculture production in 2022–2024 (r=0.51, P=0.030); no correlation in 2019–2021. Clinically, POH-VAU presents with recurrent anterior uveitis, keratic precipitates, aqueous cells and very high IOP risking optic nerve damage. In 70 patients, 82.9% had ≥2 episodes; 51.4% reached peak IOP >45 mmHg. Combined antiviral (ganciclovir) ophthalmic therapy, steroids and IOP-lowering meds reduced IOP/inflammation in 70%; 35.7% required long-term therapy; 30% remained uncontrolled and needed trabeculectomy, with 2-year complete and qualified success of 68.8% and 81.3%. Recurrence occurred in 62.5%; 72.7% maintained normal IOP with brief therapy. Laboratory analyses found CMNV-like particles (~25 nm) in iris; CMNV RdRp detected; CMNV load correlated with higher IOP and older age; RdRp 98.96% identical to aquatic CMNV; phylogenetic clustering with CMNV from cultured fish/shrimp. ELISA on sera used recombinant CMNV coat protein.

triage.headline_ja: 新興の眼球疾患が水生ウイルス人畜共通感染に関連している - Nature Microbiology
triage.triage_reason: 新興ウイルス感染症による眼疾患（POH-VAU）が中国で確認され、養殖業との関連性が示唆されている。異常な新興感染症、重症度（眼神経障害のリスク、高眼圧）、人畜共通感染の特性を備えており、IHR基準およびスクリーニング基準の複数に該当。Nature Microbiology誌への掲載により国際的関心も高い。
triage.notes: POH-VAU（Persistent Ocular Hypertension-associated Anterior Uveitis）は新興感染症であり、CMNV（清明病毒）という水生ウイルスが病原体と特定されている。養殖業と相関性があり、18の高養殖省で確認。70症例中82.9%が再発性で、30%は難治性。人畜共通感染の特性と養殖産業への関連性から管理可能性についてはさらなる情報が必要。

article.articleHeadline: SUS oferece teste rápido de dengue para diagnóstico na fase pré-aguda
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: SUS offers rapid dengue test for diagnosis in the pre-acute phase.
article.articleSummary: Brazil’s public health system (SUS) has incorporated a rapid dengue test (NS1 antigen) to detect infection in the first days of symptoms. The test, now in SUS’s national procedure table, enables registration, funding, and routine use in primary care, outpatient clinics, and hospitals. It uses a blood sample and immunochromatography, yielding results in minutes and can be performed for patients of all ages at no direct cost. Early diagnosis improves patient monitoring for warning signs such as thrombocytopenia and the risk of severe dengue, and enhances epidemiological surveillance. The integration is already in effect, but rollout will be gradual as services organize and SUS systems are updated, with emphasis during periods of higher dengue circulation.

triage.headline_ja: SUSがデング熱の前急性期診断のための迅速検査を提供開始
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルの公衆衛生システムによるデング熱診断検査の導入は重要な公衆衛生施策であるが、この記事は新しい感染症イベントの探知ではなく、既存の対策強化に関する報道である。国際的な拡大リスクやIHR基準に該当する明確な懸念が不足している。
triage.notes: 本記事はデング熱の新規発生イベントではなく、ブラジルのSUS（統一保健システム）による迅速診断検査の導入・運用に関する公式施策の報告である。Azerbaijan や Sus(町)が発生地域として含まれているが、記事サマリーはブラジルのみを主題としており、これら地域の感染症イベントは記事内容に反映されていない。公衆衛生措置の強化は重要だが、シグナルトリアージの対象としては既存疾患への対応強化であり、新規の危機事象ではない。

article.articleHeadline: Easter travellers issued urgent warning over rise of mosquito-borne infections
article.articleSummary: UKHSA warns Easter and spring travellers about rising mosquito-borne infections. Chikungunya infections in England are at their highest level in more than a decade, while malaria cases among returning travellers remain high. In 2025, 160 chikungunya infections were reported in England and Wales, all travel-associated, with the majority linked to Sri Lanka (75), India (17), and Bangladesh (16). Chikungunya symptoms include sudden fever and joint pain; other possible effects are severe joint and muscle pain, headaches, photophobia, and skin rashes. Symptoms typically improve within a few weeks, but joint pain may persist for months or longer. The warning stresses essential precautions against mosquito bites when travelling. All infections were linked to travel. The data reflect UK residents returning from Asia and the Indian Ocean region; no locally transmitted cases are described.

triage.headline_ja: イースター旅行者に蚊媒介感染症の増加について緊急警告が発令
triage.triage_reason: チクングニア熱とマラリアの旅行関連感染が報告されており、WPROスクリーニング基準の複数項目に該当する可能性があるが、英国での局所流行がなく、記事サマリーが主にトラベルアラートであるため、情報深掘りが必要。
triage.notes: 記事の主題は英国への帰還者のリスク警告であり、チクングニア熱の最大発生地はスリランカ（対象国外）およびインド。英国での局所流行なし、全症例が旅行関連。対象国からはインドのみ該当。スリランカおよびバングラデシュは対象国リストに含まれていないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Prefeitura de Belmiro Braga promove Dia "D" contra a dengue com caminhada, informação e vacinação
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Belmiro Braga City Hall promotes D-Day against dengue with a walk, information and vaccination.
article.articleSummary: On May 12 in Belmiro Braga, the City Hall launched the D-Day Belmiro Against Dengue, a cross-sector effort involving municipal authorities, students, health agents, and residents in the city center as part of a state campaign against Aedes aegypti. The walk from Praça da Matriz ended at the Centro Basic Health Unit (UBS Centro), where Wolff Klabin Municipal School students handed out leaflets, demonstrated breeding-site elimination, and answered questions. UBS Centro offered dengue vaccination for children and adolescents per Ministry of Health guidelines for ages 6–16, with boosters for at‑risk groups. By day’s end, more than 350 youths were vaccinated, up 27% from the same period last year. The initiative also installed standing-water collection points and applied larvicides in high‑risk areas. Health Secretary Dr. Carlos Silva emphasized that information, vaccination, and environmental control together can reduce dengue, chikungunya, and Zika, potentially serving as a model for other regional municipalities.

triage.headline_ja: ベルミーロ・ブラガ市がデング熱に対するDデー実施、散歩、情報提供、ワクチン接種を実施
triage.triage_reason: 本イベントは公衆衛生上の予防活動であり、ホットスポットが発生している可能性は低い。記事内容は市当局の主導で実施された計画的なワクチン接種キャンペーンであり、異常な感染症集積や緊急対応の必要性を示唆するシグナルには該当しない。
triage.notes: 本イベントはブラジルにおけるデング熱予防キャンペーンの実施を報じたもので、350人以上の若年層へのワクチン接種と環境対策が実施された計画的な公衆衛生イニシアティブ。シグナルトリアージの対象となるような新規感染症発生やアウトブレイクの兆候は認められない。

article.articleHeadline: 国家疾控局：中国已进入全球结核病中低流行国家行列
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: National CDC: China has entered the ranks of the world's middle-to-low-prevalence tuberculosis countries.
article.articleSummary: China has moved into the global mid-to-low tuberculosis (TB) prevalence category, with TB incidence and mortality down about 30% since 2012 and treatment success rates above 90%. On March 26, 2026, Beijing authorities stated that the national TB situation remains serious despite progress, with roughly 10% of counties/districts still high-prevalence areas, indicating uneven prevention and control and ongoing challenges in case finding and treatment adherence. TB symptoms are variable; early signs include low fever, night sweats, fatigue, reduced appetite, weight loss, and a mild cough with scant sputum. To combat TB, the National Center for Disease Control and Prevention is expanding new diagnostics, including chest imaging and bacteriological testing for high-risk groups, and strengthening an integrated health service system for continuous management, including drug-resistant TB care. Future work will push molecular testing, AI-assisted diagnosis, and enhanced data analytics and monitoring to improve prevention and control.

triage.headline_ja: 国家疾控局：中国已进入全球结核病中低流行国家行列
triage.triage_reason: 結核病は既知の風土病であり、記事は中国の結核流行が「中低流行国」へと改善したことを報告している。IHR基準や緊急性を示す要素がなく、社会的・政治的関心も限定的である。
triage.notes: 記事は結核症例の新規発生や アウトブレイクではなく、中国における既知風土病の流行改善を報告するニュース性の低い疾病サーベイランス情報である。公衆衛生上の予期しない危機的状況を示唆していない。

article.articleHeadline: Rodeiro intensifica combate à dengue com ação da TechDengue na Praça do Morro do Maringá
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Rodeiro Intensifies the Fight Against Dengue With TechDengue's Action at Morro do Maringá Square
article.articleSummary: Dengue prevention initiative TechDengue organized a community action at Morro do Maringá Square in Rodeiro on March 11 to reinforce prevention as dengue circulates in the municipality. The epidemiological monitoring team provided practical guidance to eliminate Aedes aegypti breeding sites, focusing on removing standing water and properly disposing of bottles, tires and cans; placing sand in plant saucers; regular cleaning of gutters and drains; and keeping water tanks tightly closed. In addition to prevention, the team outlined key dengue symptoms—high fever, body aches, retro-orbital pain, and red rash—and urged residents to promptly visit a health post for evaluation and treatment to prevent serious complications. The event reflects municipal commitment and partnerships in ongoing health education and surveillance to curb dengue transmission in Rodeiro.

triage.headline_ja: ロデイロがテックデングの活動でデング熱との戦いを強化 マリンガの丘広場で実施
triage.triage_reason: デング熱の予防啓発イベントであり、深刻な感染症発生や異常な流行を示す具体的な患者数や死亡情報がない。コミュニティ教育活動は通常の公衆衛生対応であり、IHR基準またはWPRO基準を満たさない。
triage.notes: 記事はブラジルのロデイロ市における定期的なデング熱予防活動について報じているもの。患者数、死亡事例、異常な流行の増加など、フルRRAを必要とする具体的な感染症シグナルは含まれていない。

article.articleHeadline: Three dead in major outbreak of hand, foot and mouth disease in Vietnam
article.articleSummary: HFMD surges in Vietnam, centered in Ho Chi Minh City, with about 7,300 cases nationwide this year and 837 in the city during March 9–15. Eight severe cases have been reported, six from other provinces; Ho Tram Commune recorded four HFMD clusters. Enterovirus 71 (EV71) appeared in 25% of tested samples, a virulent strain linked to rapid spread and possible neurological or respiratory complications, including death in children under five. HFMD mainly affects young children but can infect adults. Transmission occurs via droplets, contaminated surfaces, blister fluid, and stool. Symptoms include fever, sore throat, mouth ulcers, and a rash on hands and feet; most children recover in 7–10 days. Prevention emphasizes handwashing (20 seconds), cleaning surfaces, and keeping blisters clean. Authorities propose mandatory isolation for nine infectious diseases, including HFMD, with groups for confirmed, suspected, carriers, and exposed cases, potentially at home, facilities, or border gates.

triage.headline_ja: ベトナムでの手足口病の大規模流行で3人が死亡
triage.triage_reason: Enterovirus 71を含む手足口病の大規模流行が報告され、死亡例を含む重症症例が確認されている。5歳未満の小児での死亡リスク、神経学的・呼吸器合併症の可能性、および急速な拡散の可能性がある病原体であるため、IHR基準（公衆衛生への深刻な影響、異常性）および WPRO基準（重症度、流行しやすさ）に該当する。
triage.notes: 記事は明確にベトナム（ホーチミン市を中心）でのEV71含有手足口病の流行を記述している。2026年3月時点で全国約7,300例、3月9-15日の1週間でホーチミン市837例が報告されており、8例の重症例と3例の死亡が確認されている。EV71は検査陽性例の25%で検出されており、神経学的・呼吸器合併症および小児死亡の高リスク病原体である。当局は隔離措置を含む対応を検討中。

article.articleHeadline: CDC warnt vor Dengue-Fieber bei Reisenden
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: CDC warns travelers about dengue fever.
article.articleSummary: Dengue fever (Breakbone Fever), a mosquito-borne illness, is prompting a US CDC travel warning after an unusually high number of cases among travelers returning from abroad. The warning covers travelers from Afghanistan, Bangladesh, Bolivia, Cook Islands, Guyana, Maldives, Mali, Mauritania, New Caledonia, Pakistan, Samoa, Sudan, Timor-Leste and Vietnam. Among recent travelers, dengue cases have been reported from Vietnam, Cuba and Colombia. In the United States, most dengue infections are acquired overseas, though active local transmission is occurring in U.S. territories such as American Samoa, Puerto Rico and the U.S. Virgin Islands. This year, the United States has recorded 496 dengue cases. Dengue symptoms range from fever, nausea, and rashes to severe muscle and joint pain; in severe cases, there can be internal bleeding and life-threatening complications. The CDC urges anyone with suspected dengue to seek prompt medical care, particularly if returning from the listed countries or presenting severe symptoms.

triage.headline_ja: CDCが渡航者へのデング熱に関する警告を発令
triage.triage_reason: 複数国での異常な高い症例数報告（旅行者からの報告増加）、国際的な拡大リスク、米国での局所伝播が確認され、IHR基準3項目以上に該当。また、地域スクリーニング基準において異常性・重症度・流行しやすさ基準に該当し、社会的・政治的関心も高い。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIが提供する発生地域には20地域が列挙されているが、対象国リストとの照合により、記事サマリーで実際にデング熱が報告・警告されている対象国はベトナム、バングラデシュ、パキスタンの3ヵ国のみ。米国領土（プエルトリコ、米国領ヴァージン諸島）での局所伝播も記述されているが、これらは対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations には含めない。本イベントは米CDCによる国際旅行警告という重要な公衆衛生上の施策であり、WPROスクリーニング基準5項目すべてに該当するため、シグナルとして拾い上げ、フルRRA実施が適切。

article.articleHeadline: Vírus furtados circularam 350 metros dentro da Unicamp e ficaram 40 dias desaparecidos
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Stolen viruses circulated 350 meters inside Unicamp and were missing for 40 days.
article.articleSummary: Stolen samples of Influenza A H1N1 and Influenza A H3N2 circulated about 350 meters inside the University of Campinas (Unicamp) campus in Campinas, Brazil, and were missing for 40 days before the Federal Police (PF) recovered them. The materials came from a Biosafety Level 3 Virology Laboratory located between the Institute of Biology and the Faculty of Food Engineering (FEA). A researcher was arrested in flagrante for theft, illicit transport of biological material, and exposing public health to risk; her husband, Michael Edward Miller, is also under investigation. The PF reported no external contamination and said all samples remained on campus, later forwarded to the Ministry of Agriculture with confidential details. The route passed through high-traffic areas, including classrooms and common spaces, with materials found in freezers, manipulated tubes, and discarded vials. Chronology: Feb 13 disappearance; Mar 23 searches; Mar 24–25 rediscovery; Mar 25 investigation into the husband.

triage.headline_ja: 盗難されたウイルスがUnicampキャンパス内で350メートル流通し、40日間行方不明だった
triage.triage_reason: BSL-3ウイルスサンプルの盗難・不正な生物材料輸送と公衆衛生リスク曝露という異常で予想外のイベント。複数のIHR基準およびWPRO基準を満たし、政府・社会的関心が高い。
triage.notes: BSL-3ウイルスサンプルの盗難・40日間の行方不明という異常事象。キャンパス内の共有スペースを経由した曝露リスク、研究者の逮捕、および公衆衛生リスク曝露の法的責任が関わる。幸い外部への漏出なしとの報告だが、バイオセキュリティ危機管理の観点から継続注視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: SUS passa a oferecer teste rápido para diagnóstico precoce da dengue - Metro 1
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: SUS begins offering rapid diagnostic test for early diagnosis of dengue - Metro 1.
article.articleSummary: On 26 March 2026, Brazil's Unified Health System (SUS) began offering a rapid dengue diagnostic test by integrating the NS1 antigen test into the SUS national procedure table, ensuring registration, funding, and routine use in primary care, clinics, and hospitals. The blood-based NS1 test detects dengue virus early, within the first days of fever, before antibody responses develop. The test is free of charge in both primary care and hospital settings and may be requested by physicians, nurses, and biomedical professionals for patients of all ages. Full nationwide rollout depends on local service organization and system adaptation, with expansion expected gradually, particularly during periods of higher dengue incidence.

triage.headline_ja: SUSがデング熱の早期診断のための迅速診断検査の提供を開始
triage.triage_reason: デング熱の診断体制整備に関する公衆衛生政策イベントであり、感染症の流行検知や制御に関連する重要な情報ではあるが、新規感染症発生や流行拡大を示唆する内容ではなく、IHR基準およびWPROスクリーニング基準の満たし方が限定的である。
triage.notes: 本記事はデング熱自体の流行イベントではなく、ブラジルSUSの診断検査プログラム導入に関する政策ニュースである。デング熱は当地で周年性の感染症であり、迅速検査導入は検診強化を示唆するが、新規流行や流行拡大を直接的に示すものではない。ブラジルにおけるデング熱の流行状況についての追加情報が必要である場合はWATCHを続行。

article.articleHeadline: Morcegos vampiros estão mudando de dieta e começaram a buscar seres humanos em vilarejos isolados - BM&C NEWS
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Vampire bats are changing their diet and have begun to seek humans in isolated villages - BM&C NEWS
article.articleSummary: Vampire bats are now feeding on human blood in isolated Latin American villages, a documented shift linked to deforestation. Diphylla ecaudata, driven from natural prey such as wild birds and feral pigs, increasingly hunts near human settlements. Brazilian researchers from the Federal University of Pernambuco collected fecal samples in Catimbau National Park and detected human DNA, challenging prior assumptions about the species’ ability to digest mammalian blood; findings are published in international zoology journals. Bites cause minimal blood loss, but bat saliva contains analgesic and anticoagulant compounds, enabling unnoticed bites during sleep. The major risk is rabies transmission and secondary infections. Attacks cluster on unprotected houses in fragmented forests, reflecting human encroachment on virgin habitats. Preventive measures include mosquito nets, sealing roof gaps, vaccinating domestic animals, and health authorities monitoring nearby colonies to avert outbreaks.

triage.headline_ja: ヴァンパイアコウモリが食性を変え、孤立した村の人間を襲い始めた - BM&C NEWS
triage.triage_reason: 狂犬病の潜在的リスク要因（コウモリによる人間への咬傷増加、唾液中の抗凝固物質による無自覚感染）が記述されており、スクリーニング基準を満たす。ただし現在のところ実際の狂犬病事例報告や患者情報が記事に明記されていないため、情報不足によりWATCH判定とする。
triage.notes: 記事はコウモリの行動変化と潜在的な狂犬病リスクに焦点を当てているが、実際の狂犬病患者や確定例の報告は含まれていない。ブラジル連邦ペルナンブーコ大学による研究報告に基づく予防的警告と位置付けられる。脱森林化による動物と人間の接触増加という背景要因が確認された。続報で実患者報告が出た場合はPICKUPに昇格の可能性あり。

article.articleHeadline: कोरोना पर नई टेंशन! दुनिया में फिर बढ़ने लगे कोरोना केस, फैल रहा है नया BA.3.2 वेरिएंट!
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: New concern over COVID-19! Worldwide COVID-19 cases are rising again, as a new BA.3.2 variant spreads!
article.articleSummary: COVID-19 BA.3.2 variant is spreading in more than 20 countries, including the United States, fueling renewed concern as cases rise globally. US CDC data show BA.3.2 is gradually expanding; it was first detected in South Africa in 2024 and now shows increased activity. The spike protein of BA.3.2 carries roughly 75 mutations, potentially aiding immune escape and higher transmission. In India, no cases have been reported so far; experts say the risk remains low due to high vaccination coverage, and severe disease is less likely. No universal mask mandate exists, but doctors advise wearing masks in crowded places, hospitals, and public transport. Worries about renewed boosters are premature; many populations are already vaccinated, and vaccines largely reduce severe illness and hospitalization even if infection occurs. If symptoms such as fever, cough, or cold appear, seek medical advice and maintain hygiene.

triage.headline_ja: 新型コロナウイルスの新たな懸念！世界中で新たに新規感染者数が増加し、新しいBA.3.2変異株が拡大中！
triage.triage_reason: COVID-19の新変異株（BA.3.2）による世界的な感染拡大が報告されており、スクリーニング基準で異常性・流行しやすさが該当するが、IHR基準2つ以上の該当と明確な重症度の証拠が不足しているため。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーでは米国と南アフリカでの検出が言及されているが、対象国リストに含まれていないため、インドのみを verified_locations に含める。インドについては「報告事例なし」と明記されているが、国際的な感染拡大の文脈に含まれているため検証対象地域とした。BA.3.2変異株の高い変異数（75個）と免疫回避能が報告されているため、異常性と流行しやすさの基準に該当。ただし、インドでは重症度の懸念が低いとされており、ワクチン接種率の高さが言及されている。IHR基準は国際的拡大が確認されているため2つ該当。

article.articleHeadline: Combate à dengue é o primeiro foco de nova coalizão global de saúde - News Rondônia
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Fighting dengue is the primary focus of a new global health coalition.
article.articleSummary: Dengue becomes the primary target of the Global Coalition for Local and Regional Production, Innovation and Equitable Access, announced by Brazil’s Health Ministry during its G20 presidency. The coalition includes Germany, China, France, Russia, and the African Union, aiming to decentralize medical-supply production to give developing countries rapid access to health technologies and reduce reliance on major powers’ supply chains. Dengue is said to affect more than 100 countries, with up to 400 million infections annually, driven by climate change. To strengthen vaccination, Brazil’s Instituto Butantan and China’s WuXi plan to scale the Butantan DV dengue vaccine, targeting about 30 million doses from 2026, positioning Brazil as a Southern Hemisphere arbovirus innovation hub. Separately, Brazil approved 100% domestic Tacrolimus production via a transfer with India, securing lifelong treatment for roughly 120,000 SUS patients and shielding against external shortages. A new RNA vaccine center at UFMG, funded at 65 million reais, will advance mRNA capabilities alongside Fiocruz and Butantan to address future pandemics.

triage.headline_ja: デング熱との闘いは新しいグローバルヘルスコアリションの主要な焦点である
triage.triage_reason: デング熱に関する国際的な協力枠組みの発表であり、政策・行政的関心は高いが、具体的な新規流行や重大な公衆衛生危機ではなく、構造的な対策強化の報道である。記事サマリーからは具体的な流行の拡大や重症化のシグナルは明確でない。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はデング熱パンデミック対策のための国際的な医療製造・流通の枠組み構築であり、新規流行の報道ではない。デング熱の流行しやすさ（epidemic-prone）と長期的な露出（prolonged exposure）の基準に該当するが、具体的な流行の急変や危機的状況の報告ではないため、WATCH段階での経過観察が適切。Brazil、China、Indiaが記事で言及される主要な対象国として verified_locations に含められた。

article.articleHeadline: Kadinkes Sidoarjo Ingatkan Waspada Penyakit Saat Arus Balik Lebaran 2026 - Suara Merdeka Jatim
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Head of Sidoarjo Health Office Urges Vigilance Against Diseases During the 2026 Eid al-Fitr Return Traffic - Suara Merdeka Jatim
article.articleSummary: Head of the Sidoarjo Health Office, Lakhsmie Herawati Yuwantina, urged vigilance against disease during Eid al-Fitr 2026 return traffic in Sidoarjo Regency, East Java. With high mobility and crowded transport, the risk of illness rises. Individuals should be physically fit before long trips and undergo health checks; those with fever, cough, or runny nose should postpone travel. Potential upticks include Acute Respiratory Infections (ISPA/ARI), influenza, Dengue Fever, and gastroenteritis (diarrhea and vomiting), driven by crowding, weather changes, and limited sanitation along travel routes. Preventive measures include PHBS—regular handwashing, hand sanitizer after touching public facilities, and proper coughing/sneezing etiquette; mask use (prefer KN95/N95) for those unwell or at high risk. Authorities have prepared health posts at terminals, stations, and airports, with handwash stations, temperature checks, queue management, and medical referrals. Vaccination is encouraged for vulnerable groups. Historical patterns show ISPA and Dengue rising after Eid due to fatigue and mobility.

triage.headline_ja: シドアルジョ保健局長、2026年イード・アルフィトル帰省ラッシュ時の病気警戒を呼び掛け
triage.triage_reason: インフルエンザとデングの季節的発生リスク警告であるが、具体的な患者数や異常な増加傾向の報告がなく、予防措置の呼び掛けベースの情報。情報不足により確定的なシグナルとは判定できない。
triage.notes: イード帰省時の大規模人口移動（高い曝露）とインフルエンザ・デングの流行可能性（流行易しい）が確認される。ただし、具体的な患者発生報告や異常な感染増加の証拠がなく、現状は予防啓発の段階。今後の患者発生報告があれば PICKUP への格上げが必要。

article.articleHeadline: UK travellers warned by UKHSA to protect themselves against infection on holiday
article.articleSummary: Chikungunya in England is travel-associated and at the highest level in more than a decade, up 43% from 2024 (112 cases). Most cases linked to Sri Lanka (75), India (17), and Bangladesh (16); WHO notes higher incidence across the Indian Ocean region. Disease presents with fever and joint pain; most recover in 1–2 weeks, but joint symptoms can last months to years, with up to 12% experiencing discomfort 3 years after infection. No onward UK transmission. Two chikungunya vaccines have been approved in the UK and are available privately via travel clinics after professional assessment. Preventive measures include DEET, covering skin, and insecticide-treated bed nets. Travelers should consult Travel Health Pro and consider vaccination discussions 4–6 weeks before travel.

triage.headline_ja: UK travellers warned by UKHSA to protect themselves against infection on holiday（英国旅行者、UKHSAが休暇中の感染から身を守るよう警告）
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3項目該当（異常性・国際拡大リスク・渡航制限リスク）。インド洋地域でのチクングニア熱の急速な増加（43%増）が報告され、複数国にまたがる感染拡大パターンを示しており、公衆衛生上の関心が高い。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーは主にイングランド/英国での輸入事例（travel-associated cases）を扱っているが、イングランド・英国は対象国リストに含まれない。感染源地の中で対象国はインドのみ（17症例）。スリランカ（75症例）とバングラデシュ（16症例）は記事に言及されているが、対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。インド洋地域でのWHOの高い発生率指摘により、地域的な懸念があるが、対象国範囲では検証可能なシグナルはインドの関連に限定される。

article.articleHeadline: Acadêmicas de Enfermagem da Unitins promovem ação sobre HTLV e tuberculose em UBS de Augustinópolis - Voz do Bico
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Nursing students from Unitins promote an action on HTLV and tuberculosis at the Augustinópolis Basic Health Unit - Voz do Bico
article.articleSummary: On Tuesday, March 24, 2026, nursing students in their 9th semester from Unitins Campus Augustinópolis conducted an HTLV and tuberculosis education action at Unidade Básica de Saúde I – Manoel Alves Ramos in Augustinópolis, Tocantins, Brazil. Part of supervised internship, the activity informed community members about transmission, prevention, diagnosis, and treatment, and reinforced ongoing primary care follow-up. HTLV is less known but can affect the immune system and is associated with neurological and hematological diseases; tuberculosis remains a major public health challenge in Brazil and primarily affects the lungs. Student Karolaine Sousa da Silva highlighted the practical value and community impact of health education, while the initiative also sought to reduce stigma with accessible, humanized language. The UBS nurse in charge, Karinny Alencar, and faculty member Cristiana Soares stressed the role of university–service collaboration and strengthened access to information, early symptom detection, and sustained care within the SUS.

triage.headline_ja: Unitins大学の看護学生がアウグスティノーポリスの基礎保健施設でHTLVと結核に関する啓発活動を実施
triage.triage_reason: 記事は結核とHTLVの教育啓発活動の報告であり、新規の感染症アウトブレイク、異常な発生パターン、または急速な拡大を示すエビデンスがない。地域の基礎保健施設における通常の公衆衛生教育イベントである。
triage.notes: 本記事はブラジルの教育機関による結核啓発活動の報告であり、感染症イベント（アウトブレイク、流行、異常発生）ではなく、通常の公衆衛生教育プログラムである。シグナルトリアージの対象外。ブラジルは対象国リストに含まれていないため、verified_locationsは空配列。

article.articleHeadline: Three dead in major outbreak of hand, foot and mouth disease in Vietnam
article.articleSummary: Vietnam reports three deaths this year from hand, foot and mouth disease (HFMD) in Vietnam, with Ho Chi Minh City recording about 7,300 cases since January, including 837 cases from 9–15 March. Eight severe cases overall, six from other provinces; 30 school-based clusters and 49 community clusters, including four in Ho Tram Commune. Enterovirus 71 (EV71) was detected in 25% of tested samples, a virulent strain associated with higher risk of neurological and respiratory complications and death in children under five. HFMD mainly affects children under five but can infect adults; symptoms include fever, sore throat, painful mouth sores, and a hands-and-feet rash. Spread occurs via droplets, contaminated surfaces, blister fluids, and stool. Prevention emphasizes handwashing (20 seconds), disinfecting surfaces, and keeping blisters clean; schools urged to improve facilities and messaging. The health ministry floated mandatory isolation for nine infectious diseases including HFMD, with rapid-response within hours and potential isolation at home, facilities, or border gates, with possible requisition of facilities.

triage.headline_ja: ベトナムで手足口病の大規模流行、3人死亡
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常・予想外な流行、国際拡大リスク）。WPRO基準も4つ該当。EV71という神経症状・呼吸器症状リスクの高い株による多発事例。
triage.notes: ホーチミン市を中心に約7,300例、死亡3例。EV71が25%の検体で検出され、神経症状・呼吸器症状のリスク高。30の学校関連クラスター、49の地域クラスターが報告されており、5歳未満の小児が主要な影響を受けている。政府は9つの感染症に対する義務的隔離を検討中。国際的な注視と支援の可能性あり。

article.articleHeadline: Sesapi reforÃ§a aÃ§Ãµes de combate Ã  dengue no territÃ³rio da Serra da Capivara
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Sesapi reinforces dengue-control actions in the Serra da Capivara territory.
article.articleSummary: Brazil’s dengue-control efforts intensify in Serra da Capivara health territory, Piauí. On March 25, 2026, a joint task force of the State Health Secretariat (Sesapi) launched operations in São Raimundo Nonato to curb dengue transmission as cases rise in the Serra da Capivara region. The team, drawing from Environmental Health Surveillance and Epidemiological Surveillance units, plans field visits to Bonfim do Piauí to investigate a suspected death earlier in the week and to inspect additional municipalities within the territory. Activities will include enhanced case registration and monitoring, guidance to health services on clinical management of dengue patients, and support to municipalities in contingency planning. A key aim is reducing underreporting, improving data quality and clinical care, and strengthening integrated action across the 20 municipalities of the territory.

triage.headline_ja: セサピがセッラ・ダ・カピバラ地域のデング熱対策を強化
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル（対象国）のデング熱事例の増加が報告されており、WPRO基準で複数項目に該当する可能性があるが、現時点では死亡事例が「疑い」段階であり、重症度や国際的拡大のリスク評価に不確実性がある。
triage.notes: 記事はブラジル・ピアウイ州のセッラ・ダ・カピバラ地域でのデング熱対策強化について述べている。症例増加傾向とヒト-ヒト感染の可能性（蚊媒介）があることからEpidemicProneに該当。ただし死亡は「疑い」段階で確認されておらず、また局所的対応であり国際的拡大のリスクは低い。政府による対応が進行中。

article.articleHeadline: Kemenkes dorong penanganan penyakit ATM di Papua Pegunungan
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ministry of Health urges treatment of ATM disease in the Papua Highlands.
article.articleSummary: As of 26 March 2026, Indonesia's Ministry of Health, via Adinkes, urged intensified management of AIDS, tuberculosis, and malaria (ATM) in the Papua Highlands. The program aims to integrate ATM control into regional planning, aligning central and local efforts toward eliminating ATM. Implementation requires cross-sector government and community involvement, not just health agencies. Six Papuan Highlands districts—Jayawijaya, Nduga, Yahukimo, Mamberamo Tengah, Yalimo, and Pegunungan Bintang—receive Global Fund support and are prioritized for intervention. The initiative could be expanded to districts nationwide, though Global Fund focus remains on these six. The locus of interventions remains unchanged, but security concerns have led to adjusting delivery by consolidating activities in selected sites with approval from Adinkes pusat to minimize casualties.

triage.headline_ja: 保健省、パプア高地のATM疾患（エイズ・結核・マラリア）対策の強化を促進
triage.triage_reason: 結核とマラリアの統合管理プログラムが複数地域で実施されている点で関心を要するが、現在のところは通常の公衆衛生プログラム推進の報道であり、新規爆発や異常な状況の報告ではない。情報が限定的であるため経過観察が妥当。
triage.notes: 記事はインドネシア保健省によるエイズ・結核・マラリア（ATM）の統合管理プログラムの推進ニュースであり、新規のアウトブレイク報告ではない。パプア高地の6地域（Jayawijaya、Nduga、Yahukimo、Mamberamo Tengah、Yalimo、Pegunungan Bintang）が重点地域として指定されており、Global Fundの支援を受けている。セキュリティ上の懸念から活動の配置を調整しているとの記載あり。疾患負荷は存在するが、通常の公衆衛生政策実行段階と判断される。

article.articleHeadline: SUS passa a oferecer teste rápido para dengue que ajuda a evitar casos graves
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: SUS starts offering a rapid dengue test that helps prevent severe cases.
article.articleSummary: Brazil's Unified Health System (SUS) has incorporated a rapid dengue NS1 antigen test into its national health table, enabling early detection within the first days of fever. The immunochromatography-based blood test yields results in minutes and can be used in primary care, ambulatory clinics, and hospitals, with no direct cost to patients. By identifying the dengue virus protein NS1 before antibody responses develop, it improves timely patient management, monitoring for warning signs such as platelet drop and progression to severe dengue, and strengthens epidemiological surveillance. The measure, published in the Diário Oficial on 2026-03-26, allows formal registration, funding, and routine use across public health facilities. Physicians, nurses, and biomedical professionals can order the test for patients of all ages, with expansion to the public network planned progressively, particularly during periods of higher dengue activity.

triage.headline_ja: SUSがデング熱の急速検査の提供を開始し、重症例の予防に役立つ
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルでのデング熱検査導入は公衆衛生対策の重要な進展だが、新規の疾患発生や異常なアウトブレイクを示す情報はなく、既知の流行への対応強化である。IHR基準を満たさず、スクリーニング基準1つ該当するが情報不足のため経過観察推奨。
triage.notes: 本記事は新規のデング熱アウトブレイク報告ではなく、ブラジル公衆衛生システム(SUS)による診断能力強化の施策である。デング熱は風土病として既知の脅威であり、検査導入は対応改善を示すが新規の異常事象ではない。スクリーニング基準『長期曝露』に該当（デング熱の継続的流行）するが、深刻度やアウトブレイク状況の詳細情報が不足しているため、WATCH判定とした。

article.articleHeadline: Kemenkes dorong penanganan penyakit AIDS, TBC dan malaria di Papua Pegunungan - ANTARA News Megapolitan
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ministry of Health urges management of AIDS, TB, and malaria in the Papua Highlands - ANTARA News Megapolitan
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-03-26, Indonesia’s Ministry of Health via Adinkes nationwide urges intensified management of AIDS, tuberculosis (TB), and malaria (ATM) in the Papua Highlands. The aim is to integrate ATM control into regional planning to synchronize central and local efforts toward eliminating AIDS, TB, and malaria. Success depends on cross-sector collaboration among government and non-government entities and communities. Six priority districts in Papua Highlands—Jayawijaya, Nduga, Yahukimo, Mamberamo Tengah, Yalimo, and Pegunungan Bintang—receive Global Fund support for ATM elimination, with potential expansion to other districts in the country. Global Fund monitoring currently focuses on these six districts. Security concerns influence intervention delivery, necessitating adaptations and approval from central Adinkes. The effort seeks to improve public health outcomes and allow communities to live more peacefully and prosperously.

triage.headline_ja: インドネシア保健省、パプア高地におけるエイズ、結核、マラリアの対策強化を呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: 結核とマラリアが確認された対象国イベント（インドネシア）だが、記事はポリシー声明・地域計画統合の方針発表であり、新規アウトブレイクや異常な流行を示す具体的なデータが不足。継続的な監視が必要。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーは保健省による統合的対策方針の発表であり、新規患者数、死亡率、流行曲線などの具体的な疫学データを含まない。Global Fund支援を受ける6地区（Jayawijaya、Nduga、Yahukimo等）での長期的な病原体曝露と流行易感染性が確認されるため、スクリーニング基準2項目該当。セキュリティ上の懸念が対策実施に影響している点も注視。追加情報（患者数増加、死亡例、地域的異常）が確認されれば段階的に判定見直し対象。

article.articleHeadline: सोनिया गांधी की सेहत को लेकर बड़ा अपडेट, संक्रमण के बाद सर गंगाराम में चल रहा इलाज
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Major update on Sonia Gandhi's health: undergoing treatment at Sir Ganga Ram Hospital after contracting an infection.
article.articleSummary: New Delhi-based Congress leader Sonia Gandhi, 79, is hospitalized at Sir Ganga Ram Hospital after contracting an infection. She was admitted on the night of March 24 at about 10:22 PM with mild fever and infection, reportedly aggravated by a sudden weather change. The hospital says she is receiving antibiotics and is showing steady improvement under the supervision of an expert team of senior physicians. Although her condition is currently stable, she will remain under medical observation for the next few days. Discharge will be considered only after full recovery. The update, issued by the hospital, comes as Gandhi has recently maintained a cautious approach to her health and has been visiting the hospital for routine check-ups. This report reflects the situation as of March 26, 2026.

triage.headline_ja: ソニア・ガンジーの健康状態に関する大きな更新：感染症後、サー・ガンガラム病院で治療中
triage.triage_reason: 単一の高齢者政治家の個人的な医療入院であり、公衆衛生危機を示す兆候がない。疾患は「未知の疾患」とされているが、詳細な流行学的情報がなく、感染症イベントとしての公衆衛生的重要性は認められない。
triage.notes: 本記事は単一の高齢者患者（政治家）の個人的な医療事象の報道であり、感染症イベント監視対象とはならない。疾患名が「Unknown Illness」とされており、具体的な病原体が特定されていない。流行学的リンク、複数患者のクラスター、公共の保健上の影響など、感染症イベント検知に必要な重要情報が欠落している。政治的関心の存在は、公衆衛生上の懸念と区別されるべき点である。

article.articleHeadline: H1N1 estava entre as amostras de vírus furtadas na Unicamp
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: H1N1 was among the virus samples stolen at Unicamp
article.articleSummary: H1N1 and H3N2 influenza A samples were among materials stolen from Unicamp’s Virology Laboratory in Campinas, Brazil. The items were removed without authorization and remained outside the NB-3 biosafety level facility for about 40 days, within the university. The main suspect, professor Soledad Palameta Miller, was arrested in a Federal Police operation and later released to respond in freedom; she could face charges including theft, irregular transport of biological material, and risking public health. Her husband, veterinarian Michael Edward Miller, is under investigation. Officials say there was no external contamination and all samples were recovered, confined to the university. The investigation began in February after a researcher noticed the disappearance; the police operation occurred in March. The defense argues she used external labs due to space issues.

triage.headline_ja: H1N1はUnicampで盗まれたウイルスサンプルの中に含まれていた
triage.triage_reason: バイオセキュリティインシデント（NB-3施設からのウイルスサンプル盗難）として異常性と潜在的な公衆衛生リスクが存在するが、当局発表では外部汚染なし、サンプルは全て回収され大学内に限定されているため、即座のアウトブレイク拡大リスクは低い。ただし情報は限定的。
triage.notes: 本事象は感染症の自然発生的なアウトブレイクではなく、バイオセキュリティ・バイオセーフティインシデント（盗難）である。記事では当局が外部汚染なし、サンプル回収済み、大学内に限定と発表しているため、現時点での公衆衛生への深刻な影響は確認されていない。ただし、NB-3レベルの病原体が40日間施設外に放置された点および盗難という異常事象はセキュリティ観点から関心が高い。アウトブレイク兆候がない限り、見送り判定もあり得るが、情報限定かつバイオハザード関連のため経過観察が妥当。

article.articleHeadline: Surto de doença de Chagas em Macapá: seis casos são confirmados e uma morte é registrada
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Chagas disease outbreak in Macapá: six cases confirmed and one death recorded.
article.articleSummary: Six acute Chagas disease cases have been confirmed in Macapá, Amapá, Brazil, with one death, as of 26 March 2026. Cases are concentrated in the southern zone, with additional occurrences in Jardim Marco Zero, Zerão, Buritizal, and Universidade neighborhoods. Investigations point to ingestion of contaminated açaí processed in a blender at Jardim Marco Zero; the Triatomine kissing bug was likely crushed with the fruit, enabling Trypanosoma cruzi transmission. The SVS health agency declared a localized outbreak and the state government activated a contingency plan to contain transmission. Acute Chagas symptoms include fever lasting more than seven days, severe headache, marked weakness, and facial and leg swelling; individuals with these signs should seek immediate care. Preventive measures emphasize safe food handling, purchasing açaí only from licensed establishments that perform heat treatment (branqueamento), proper hygiene in preparation areas, and protective screens on homes. An intensive citywide inspection of açaí blenders is underway to prevent further cases.

triage.headline_ja: マカパでのシャーガス病の流行：6例が確認され、1人の死亡が記録される
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3項目に該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的リスク）。食品経由の急性シャーガス病の集団発生であり、死亡例があり、食品安全に関わる予想外の感染経路の確認のため。
triage.notes: 食品経由（アサイ）の急性シャーガス病集団発生は極めて異常。Triatomine節足動物の直接的な食品混入による確認病例。死亡例を含み、重症度が高い。熱処理不十分な食品製品を扱う複数の州での二次感染リスクが存在し、国際的な食品安全警告の対象となる可能性がある。

article.articleHeadline: Italy confirms first European human H9N2 avian flu case
article.articleSummary: Italy reports the first European human case of avian influenza A(H9N2) in Lombardy; a traveler from outside Europe is hospitalized, isolated, and receiving treatment with co-morbidities after confirmation by the Italian Ministry of Health on March 25. Contacts have been identified as part of routine surveillance. Globally, since 1998 and as of 27 February 2026, 195 human A(H9N2) cases have been reported in ten countries across Asia and Africa, with no clusters or person-to-person transmission detected. Infection is typically driven by direct contact with infected birds or contaminated environments, and sporadic human cases are not unexpected where the virus circulates in birds. In the latest monitoring (29 November 2025–27 February 2026), ten human cases were reported: Cambodia (1 A(H5N1)); China (8 A(H9N2), 1 A(H10N3)); none fatal. The EU/EEA risk to the general population from this event is assessed as very low.

triage.headline_ja: イタリア、ヨーロッパ初の人間H9N2鳥インフルエンザ症例を確認
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準の異常性・予想外性と国際的拡大リスク、およびWPRO基準の異常性・重症度・流行可能性に該当。新興感染症の国際的拡大第一例であり、フルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: 記事はイタリアでの初ヨーロッパ症例を主題としているが、対象国リストではイタリアは対象外。グローバル文脈では中国での継続的なH9N2症例報告が記載されており、中国は対象国。H9N2の国際的拡大とヨーロッパ初進入は公衆衛生上の重要なシグナル。患者は海外からの渡航者で、接触追跡中。EU公式リスク評価は「非常に低い」だが、新規地域への病原体進入という観点からフルRRA推奨。

article.articleHeadline: ظهور أول حالة أوروبية مصابة بأنفلونزا الطيور
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: First European Case of Avian Influenza.
article.articleSummary: Italy confirms first European human case of avian influenza A(H9N2) in Lombardy. The patient, hospitalized with deteriorating health, arrived from a non-European country; whether Italian resident or foreign visitor unspecified. H9N2 is typically acquired via direct contact with infected poultry or contaminated environments; no human-to-human transmission documented; infections generally mild. Globally, about 90% of human H9N2 infections have occurred in China, with cases also in Cambodia, Vietnam, India, and Africa (Egypt, Senegal, Ghana). The most recent Chinese cases were reported in February; last year China reported 29 mainland cases. Italian media claims the patient was a child in Africa, but the Ministry of Health did not confirm. As of 26 March 2026.

triage.headline_ja: イタリアが鳥インフルエンザで初のヨーロッパ人感染者を確認
triage.triage_reason: H9N2型とH5N8型の人感染事例を含む。イタリアでの初の欧州人感染は異常・予想外であり、国際的な懸念を呼び起こす可能性が高い。IHR基準3項目該当（異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク），WPRO基準複数該当。
triage.notes: 記事はイタリアでのH9N2初感染を主題としているが、サマリーでは中国，カンボジア，ベトナム，インド，エジプト，セネガル，ガーナでの既知事例を言及。対象国リストに該当する国（India, China, Vietnam, Ghana）を verified_locations に含める。イタリア，エジプト，セネガル，カンボジアは対象国外のため除外。患者の詳細情報（年齢，居住国）が確定していない点，H9N2の人-人感染が報告されていない点に留意。H5N8も疾患リストに含まれるが，サマリーではH9N2が主体。

article.articleHeadline: New COVID variant 'Cicada' in the US: Will it affect India? Know symptoms, precautions, and vaccine protection
article.articleSummary: As of 26 March 2026, BA.3.2, nicknamed 'Cicada', is a distinct SARS-CoV-2 variant with 70–75 spike-protein mutations, raising immune-escape concerns. Detected in the United States via traveler screenings, clinical samples, and wastewater, it has spread across about 25 US states (e.g., California, Florida, New York, Texas, New Jersey, Illinois, Pennsylvania, Virginia) and to at least 23 countries since first identified in South Africa in November 2024, with early European cases in Denmark, Germany, and the Netherlands. Two sublineages, BA.3.2.1 and BA.3.2.2, show ongoing evolution. Symptoms are similar to prior COVID-19, with severe sore throat highlighted; other common symptoms include cough, fever or chills, fatigue, loss of taste/smell, GI symptoms, and shortness of breath. No BA.3.2-specific vaccine exists; existing vaccines are likely to continue to protect against severe disease and hospitalization. India has no confirmed widespread spread; monitoring is ongoing. Basic precautions—masking, ventilation, vaccination boosters, hand hygiene—remain advisable.

triage.headline_ja: 米国の新型コロナウイルス変異株『Cicada』：インドに影響するのか？症状、予防策、ワクチン保護について
triage.triage_reason: COVID-19の新規変異株（BA.3.2 'Cicada'）が複数国で検出され、異常性と流行の可能性が認められるが、インドでの確認例がなく情報不足。IHR基準の達成状況が不明確なため。
triage.notes: 記事はインドへの影響可能性について扱っているが、インド国内での確認例は記載されていない（『India has no confirmed widespread spread』と明記）。発生地域はUS複数州および欧州各国（デンマーク、ドイツ、オランダ）が主体だが、対象国リストに該当するのはインドのみ。新規変異株は国際的に拡大しており、IHR基準2つ該当、WPRO基準3つ該当するも、インド国内への実際の影響がまだ限定的であるため、経過観察段階と判定。続報による国内での確認例の有無が重要。

article.articleHeadline: Dengue Exploding Globally: Worldwide Cases 500,000 In 2000; 14 Million Cases In 2024, W. 9,000 Deaths
article.articleSummary: Dengue fever surged to 14 million global cases in 2024 with about 9,000 deaths, majority in the Americas, after 2023’s near 7 million. Transmission is driven by Aedes aegypti; Peru eradicated the vector in 1958, but outbreaks since 1990 have revived transmission amid rapid urbanization and air travel. Brazil faced widespread impact, with 17 cities declaring states of emergency and hospitals overwhelmed. Despite better reporting, dengue remains the world’s most common and fastest-growing mosquito-borne disease. Public-health strategies combine machine learning to forecast outbreaks and the release of hundreds of millions of Wolbachia-infected mosquitoes to suppress transmission. Implementation faces logistical, political, and funding hurdles, but Peru and Brazil are pushing for sustained investment.

triage.headline_ja: デング熱が世界規模で急増：2000年の50万件から2024年は1400万件、死亡約9000件
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3つ以上該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク、複数国での渡航・貿易制限リスク）。2024年に1400万件、9000死亡という大規模アウトブレイクで、対象国ブラジルが深刻な影響を受けており、WPROスクリーニング基準も複数満たす。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはペルーとブラジルを具体的に言及しているが、対象国リストではブラジルのみが該当。ペルーは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。2024年の1400万件というグローバルデータと死亡数は重大な公衆衛生危機を示唆している。ブラジルで17都市が非常事態宣言、病院が過負荷状態という具体的な影響報告あり。

article.articleHeadline: SUS passa a oferecer teste rápido para detectar dengue nos primeiros dias
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: SUS begins offering rapid test to detect dengue in the first days.
article.articleSummary: Brazil's Federal Government has officially incorporated the NS1 rapid antigen test for early dengue diagnosis into the Unified Health System (SUS). The test detects dengue virus NS1 protein within minutes, enabling diagnosis in the first days after symptom onset and fostering faster clinical decisions and treatment to prevent progression. Availability will extend to primary health care units, outpatient clinics, and hospitals nationwide, but effective rollout depends on state and municipal procurement and distribution. The move responds to rising case numbers and a record of more than 1,600 dengue deaths in 2025, underlining the importance of early detection. If successfully implemented, it could speed triage, shorten patient pathways and reduce hospital burden.

triage.headline_ja: SUS（統一保健制度）がデング熱の早期診断のための迅速検査を提供開始
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルにおけるデング熱の公衆衛生対応の強化に関するニュースであり、異常性や予想外性は低い。既知の流行への診断能力向上の施策であり、新規の危機的な状況ではない。
triage.notes: ブラジルでは2025年に1,600人以上のデング熱死亡報告があり、流行が継続中である。本記事は公衆衛生応答の強化に関するもので、新規のシグナルではなく既知流行への対応施策である。継続的な監視は推奨されるが、緊急な全規模RRA（Rapid Risk Assessment）は必要ないと判断。

article.articleHeadline: إيطاليا تسجل أول إصابة أوروبية بأنفلونزا الطيور
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Italy records first European case of avian influenza.
article.articleSummary: First human case of low-pathogenic avian influenza A(H9N2) detected in Europe, in Lombardy, Italy. The patient, with deteriorating health prior to infection, was hospitalized. The individual arrived from a non-European country; travel details not disclosed. H9N2 typically transmits to humans via direct contact with infected poultry or contaminated environments; no human-to-human transmission has been reported, and cases have generally been mild. Globally, about 90% of human H9N2 infections have occurred in China, with documented cases in Cambodia, Vietnam, India, and Africa (Egypt, Senegal, Ghana). In February, China reported additional infections; mainland China recorded 29 cases last year. This case marks Europe’s first reported human infection with H9N2 avian influenza.

triage.headline_ja: イタリアが鳥インフルエンザの初の欧州人感染例を記録
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準2項目該当（異常性・国際的拡大リスク）。欧州初の人間H9N2感染例であり、グローバルに検出されるH9N2ウイルスの欧州への侵入を示唆する。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではイタリア（イタロリアナ）での初発見が主題だが、イタリアは対象国リストに含まれないため、verified_locationsには含めない。サマリー記載の対象国：中国（H9N2の約90%）、カンボジア（非対象国）、ベトナム、インド、エジプト（非対象国）、セネガル（非対象国）、ガーナ。患者の感染源が非欧州国（詳細未開示）であり、渡航関連の国際的拡大経路が示唆されている。現在までヒト-ヒト感染報告なし、症例は一般的に軽症。

article.articleHeadline: Olaszország megerősíti első európai humán H9N2 madárinfluenza-esetet
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Italy confirms its first European human H9N2 avian influenza case.
article.articleSummary: First European human case of A(H9N2) avian influenza confirmed in Lombardy, Italy, involving a traveler from outside Europe who is hospitalized with A(H9N2). The patient has comorbidities; isolation ongoing and routine contact tracing completed. The European Centre for Disease Prevention and Control (ECDC) notes 195 human A(H9N2) infections since 1998 across ten Asian and African countries, with no evidence of sustained human-to-human transmission. Human infections typically result from direct contact with infected birds or contaminated environments, and sporadic cases are expected in areas with avian circulation. A recent ECDC/EFSA monitoring report (Nov 29, 2025–Feb 27, 2026) documented ten human avian influenza cases, none fatal, from Cambodia (A(H5N1)) and China (eight A(H9N2), one A(H10N3)). The current case is considered very low risk for EU/EEA populations.

triage.headline_ja: イタリアが初のヨーロッパ人H9N2鳥インフルエンザ感染事例を確認
triage.triage_reason: H9N2鳥インフルエンザの欧州初の人間感染事例であり異常性と国際的懸念は存在するが、患者は欧州域外からの旅行者で入院中、ヒト-ヒト感染の持続的な証拠なし、EU/EEAにおけるリスクは極めて低いと評価されている。追加情報（流行拡大、地域内感染の有無）の確認が必要。
triage.notes: 記事で確認されている対象国内の発生はChinaのH9N2感染例（8件）のみ。イタリア（ロンバルディア州）での初欧州事例は旅行者由来で、カンボジアでのH5N1事例も記載されているが、カンボジアは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。IHR基準を満たしているがECDCによるリスク評価が「極めて低い」であり、EU/EEA域内での継続的拡大の懸念が現時点では低いため、WATCH段階での継続監視が適切と判断。

article.articleHeadline: Η Ιταλία επιβεβαιώνει το πρώτο ανθρώπινο κρούσμα H9N2 στην Ευρώπη
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Italy confirms the first human case of H9N2 in Europe.
article.articleSummary: Italy reports the first human case of avian influenza A(H9N2) in Europe, in Lombardy—a patient who travelled from a non-European country (imported case). The patient is hospitalized in isolation with pre-existing conditions and receiving treatment; laboratory confirmation was issued March 25 by the Italian Ministry of Health. This marks Europe’s first human A(H9N2) case, with contacts identified under routine surveillance. Globally, from 1998 through February 27, 2026, 195 human A(H9N2) infections have been reported across Asia and Africa, with no clusters and no sustained human-to-human transmission. Transmission is usually via direct contact with infected poultry or contaminated environments. The ECDC notes sporadic cases are not unexpected where the virus circulates in poultry, and current EU/EEA risk for the general population is very low for this case. In the period Nov 29, 2025–Feb 27, 2026, 10 human avian cases were reported: Cambodia (1 H5N1) and China (8 H9N2, 1 H10N3), none fatal.

triage.headline_ja: イタリアがヨーロッパで初めてのH9N2鳥インフルエンザの人間感染例を確認
triage.triage_reason: ヨーロッパで初めての人間H9N2感染確認であり、IHR基準において異常性（unusual/unexpected）と国際的拡大リスクに該当。グローバルな監視対象ウイルスのヨーロッパへの侵入であり、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はイタリアの事例報告であるが、対象国リストではイタリアは含まれていない。しかし、記事サマリーでは過去の統計データとしてChinaでの8件のH9N2症例（2025年11月29日～2026年2月27日）が明記されている。Cambodiaも1件のH5N1症例が報告されているが対象国リストに含まれていない。Chinaの症例が記事に具体的に含まれているため verified_locations に China を含める。本事例は輸入症例（非ヨーロッパからの渡航患者）であり、ヨーロッパでのヒト-ヒト感染拡大リスクは現在低いが、国際的な鳥インフルエンザ監視の観点から重要なシグナル。

article.articleHeadline: Italia confirma el primer caso humano europeo de gripe aviar H9N2
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Italy confirms the first European human case of H9N2 avian influenza.
article.articleSummary: Italy reports the first human case of avian influenza A(H9N2) in Europe, in a traveler arriving from outside the continent and now hospitalized in Lombardy, with preexisting conditions and in hospital isolation. The Ministry of Health confirmed the case on March 25, noting immediate investigations and contact tracing. Since 1998 through February 27, 2026, global reports list 195 human A(H9N2) infections across ten countries in Asia and Africa, with no human-to-human clusters or sustained transmission. Human infections are typically linked to direct contact with infected birds or contaminated environments. The ECDC cautions that sporadic human cases are not unexpected in areas where the virus circulates in birds. A joint ECDC/EFSA update (Nov 29, 2025–Feb 27, 2026) records ten human avian flu cases: Cambodia (one A(H5N1)); China (eight A(H9N2) and one A(H10N3)). Overall EU/EEA population risk remains very low.

triage.headline_ja: イタリア、H9N2鳥インフルエンザの欧州初の人間感染例を確認
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3項目該当（異常/予想外性、国際拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。欧州初のH9N2人間感染で国際的に重要な信号。ただし患者が海外から流入した旅行者で、指標症例性は限定的。
triage.notes: イタリアのH9N2ケースは欧州初だが、患者は域外からの流入旅行者。サマリーではカンボジア（A(H5N1) 1件）と中国（A(H9N2) 8件、A(H10N3) 1件）での発生が記載されており、これらが対象国。イタリアは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。WPROスクリーニング基準は異常性のみ該当し、重症度は不明だが限定的、持続的曝露リスクなし、ヒト-ヒト感染クラスターなし。IHR基準の3項目該当がPICKUP判定の主要因。

article.articleHeadline: Italien meldet ersten H9N2-Vogelgrippefall beim Menschen in Europa
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Italy reports the first H9N2 avian influenza case in humans in Europe.
article.articleSummary: Italy reports the first human case of avian influenza A(H9N2) in Europe. An imported case from outside Europe is hospitalized in Lombardy, Italy, with A(H9N2) infection; the patient has preexisting conditions and is isolated during treatment. Investigations including contact tracing were completed; routine preventive and surveillance measures are in place. Since 1998 through 27 February 2026, ten countries in Asia and Africa have reported 195 human cases of A(H9N2) avian influenza, with no human-to-human transmission detected to date. In recent surveillance (29 November 2025–27 February 2026), ten human avian influenza cases were reported: eight in China with A(H9N2), one in China A(H10N3), and one in Cambodia with A(H5N1); none were fatal. The EU/EEA risk to the general population from A(H9N2) linked to this event is assessed as very low. Transmission is typically via direct contact with infected birds or contaminated environments.

triage.headline_ja: イタリア、ヨーロッパで初のH9N2鳥インフルエンザ患者を報告
triage.triage_reason: ヨーロッパにおける初の人間H9N2鳥インフルエンザ症例であり、異常性が高く、国際的な関心が高い。IHR基準では unusual_unexpected と international_spread で該当、WPRO基準では abnormal_unexpected と severity で該当。
triage.notes: イベント情報の発生地域にはイタリア・カンボジア・中国が含まれているが、記事サマリーの主題は「イタリアでの初のH9N2症例報告」であり、当該患者は「ヨーロッパ外からの輸入症例」。対象国リストではイタリアに相当する国がないため、中国のみ verified_locations に含める（サマリーで中国の直近サーベイランスデータが言及されているため）。ただし、本トリアージの主要な関心は、ヨーロッパでの初症例という異常性と国際的波及リスクにある。

article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Italy confirms the first European case of H9N2 avian influenza in a human.
article.articleSummary: Italy confirms the first European human case of avian influenza A(H9N2). The patient, who travelled from outside Europe, is hospitalized in Lombardy in isolation and receiving therapy, with comorbidities. Italian authorities report all necessary checks were completed and contacts identified under routine prevention and surveillance. ECDC data show 195 human cases of A(H9N2) worldwide since 1998 through 27 February, across ten countries in Asia and Africa, with no human-to-human transmission or clusters observed; infections typically result from direct contact with infected birds or contaminated environments. A joint ECDC-EFSA update indicates ten human avian influenza cases from 29 November to 27 February, all in Asia: one A(H5N1) in Cambodia; eight A(H9N2) and one A(H10N3) in China, with no deaths. Overall EU/EEA risk from this case remains very low.

triage.headline_ja: イタリアが鳥インフルエンザH9N2の初のヨーロッパ人感染事例を確認
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で異常/予想外性と国際的拡大リスクの2基準に該当。ヨーロッパでの初のH9N2人感染事例であり、アジア・アフリカ限定から地域拡大への転換点を示唆するシグナル。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではイタリアでの事例を主題としており、イタリアはスクリーニング対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations から除外。サマリー内に「ECDC-EFSA update」で言及されたカンボジア（対象国外）と中国（1814991）での事例について、実際に中国での直近報告があるため中国のみ検証地域として含める。患者の重症度は低く、接触者追跡も進行中で、EU/EEA全体のリスク評価は非常に低いとされている。

article.articleHeadline: Fiebre Meningocócica: Síntomas, Vacuna y Riesgos en Tailandia
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Meningococcal Fever: Symptoms, Vaccine, and Risks in Thailand.
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-03-26, Thai health authorities have issued meningococcal vaccination recommendations, targeting four at-risk groups, after a recent surge of meningococcal disease cases in Thailand, some fatal within 48 hours. Meningococcal disease can be rapid and deadly. Key symptoms include high fever, severe headache, neck stiffness, and sensitivity to light; seek urgent medical care if these symptoms appear. Current data indicate a combined morbidity and mortality rate of 13% for meningococcal disease in Thailand. Officials are implementing measures to curb transmission and safeguard the population. The frequency of meningococcal disease in Thailand remains unclear, but authorities stress vaccination as a preventive measure for the identified risk groups. The disease progresses quickly and can be fatal; awareness of symptoms and prompt medical evaluation are crucial to reduce the risk of complications and death.

triage.headline_ja: 髄膜炎菌熱：タイにおける症状、ワクチン、およびリスク
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3項目該当（公衆衛生への深刻な影響、異常/予想外、国際的拡大リスク）。WPROスクリーニング基準でも複数該当し、致死性疾患の急速な流行がタイで報告されている。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーに「最近の髄膜炎菌疾患症例の急増」「48時間以内に致命的」「13%の合計罹患率および死亡率」が明記されており、重症度および急速な進行が確認される。タイ保健当局による予防接種推奨の実施は、公式な対応が開始されていることを示唆している。

article.articleHeadline: Kemenkes Sorot Darurat AIDS, TBC, dan Malaria di Papua Pegunungan
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ministry of Health Highlights AIDS, TB, and Malaria Emergency in the Papua Highlands.
article.articleSummary: Indonesia's Ministry of Health, via Adinkes, intensifies control of AIDS, TB, and malaria (ATM) in the Papua Highlands, stressing centralized integration of prevention programs from national to district levels to achieve realistic elimination targets. Ferdinan J. Laihad of Adinkes underscores that malaria efforts cannot remain fragmented and must be embedded in regional planning documents, with multi-sector collaboration across government agencies, NGOs, and communities to address geographic and social challenges in Papua Highlands. Interventions focus on six priority districts—Jayawijaya, Nduga, Yahukimo, Mamberamo Tengah, Yalimo, and Pegunungan Bintang—areas long supported by the Global Fund for AIDS, TB, and malaria programs. Global Fund still tracks these six districts, but the approach should widen to other vulnerable areas. Security issues influence field operations, prompting consolidation at specific points to minimize risk. The Ministry aims for integrated, adaptive programs to curb ATM transmission and improve living conditions.

triage.headline_ja: インドネシア保健省、パプア高地のエイズ、結核、マラリア緊急事態を強調
triage.triage_reason: 複数の重篤な感染症（TB、マラリア、AIDS）がパプア高地で報告されており、スクリーニング基準で重症度と流行しやすさに該当するが、記事は政策対応・プログラム強化に焦点であり、新規発生や急性の危機的状況の報告ではなく、情報が不足している。
triage.notes: 記事はパプア高地における既知の三大感染症（AIDS/TB/マラリア）に対する政府の統合的対応強化についての報告であり、新規の急性イベントというより長期的な公衆衛生対策の発表。グローバルファンドの支援を受ける6県での取り組みが中心。セキュリティ上の課題も言及されており、実地操作への影響がある。フルRRAの判定には追加情報が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Sesapi realiza força-tarefa para conter avanço da dengue no sul do Piauí
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Sesapi forms a task force to contain the spread of dengue in southern Piauí
article.articleSummary: Dengue outbreak response escalated in Serra da Capivara health territory in southern Piauí, Brazil, as the State Health Secretariat (Sesapi) formed a task force on March 25, 2026, to contain transmission. Health teams from Environmental Surveillance and Epidemiological Surveillance traveled to São Raimundo Nonato to coordinate with regional and municipal colleagues, outlining activities including investigations of a suspected death in Bonfim do Piauí and inspections in other municipalities within the territory. The operation will intensify case recording and case monitoring, reinforce guidance on clinical management of dengue patients, and assist municipalities in contingency planning. Sub-notification of cases is a key focus to improve diagnostic accuracy and guide interventions. The initiative covers all 20 municipalities in Serra da Capivara territory, with ongoing collaboration between Sesapi and local health authorities through next week.

triage.headline_ja: セサピ、ピアウイ州南部のデング熱の拡大を抑制するためにタスクフォースを組成
triage.triage_reason: デング熱の局所的な流行対応であり、死亡例が疑われるなど重症度指標がある。しかし、国際的拡大の証拠やIHR基準の複数該当は確認できず、情報が限定的なため経過観察が適切。
triage.notes: ブラジル（対象国）のピアウイ州南部で発生。死亡疑い例が言及されており重症度がある。ただし、記事は地域の公式対応を報道しており、国際的な拡大リスクや渡航制限の兆候は認められない。WPROスクリーニング基準では5/5該当するが、社会的・政治的関心は限定的（政府対応が主体）。情報が限定的で、国内対応の段階と判断されるため、WATCH判定が適切。

article.articleHeadline: ایتالیا اولین مورد انسانی H9N2 در اروپا را تایید کرد
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Italy confirmed the first human case of H9N2 in Europe.
article.articleSummary: Italy confirmed Europe’s first human case of avian influenza A(H9N2). The patient, who traveled from outside Europe to Lombardy, is hospitalized with A(H9N2) infection and has underlying health conditions, currently in hospital isolation. Rapid investigations identified and monitored contacts as part of routine preventive surveillance. There is no evidence of human-to-human transmission. Globally, from 1998 through 27 February 2026, there have been 195 human A(H9N2) infections in ten countries across Asia and Africa, with no deaths and no sustained transmission. EFSA/ECDC monitoring for 29 November 2025–27 February 2026 records 10 recent human avian influenza cases: Cambodia (1 A(H5N1)); China (8 A(H9N2) and 1 A(H10N3)). The current risk to the general EU/EEA population is very low. Infections typically arise from direct contact with infected birds or contaminated environments; the incident is imported.

triage.headline_ja: イタリア、ヨーロッパにおけるH9N2型の最初のヒト感染例を確認
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ該当（異常性、国際拡大リスク、貿易制限リスク）。ヨーロッパにおけるH9N2ヒト感染の初例であり、国際的に重大な意味を持つ。WPRO基準複数該当、社会的・政治的関心が極めて高い。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではイタリアのH9N2初例が主題であるが、イタリアは対象国リストに含まれない。一方、中国からのケース（8例のA(H9N2)）がグローバル監視データとして言及されており、対象国である中国を verified_locations に含める。カンボジアも言及されているがリストに含まれないため除外。患者は域外からの輸入例で、ヒト・ヒト感染の証拠なし。EU/EEA人口への現在のリスクは非常に低いとされているが、新規地域でのヒト感染例の出現は公衆衛生上の重大な懸念。

article.articleHeadline: Primul caz de gripă aviară H9N2 la om, confirmat în Italia
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: First human case of H9N2 avian influenza, confirmed in Italy.
article.articleSummary: First human case of avian influenza A(H9N2) confirmed in Europe, Italy. The patient, who traveled from outside the continent, is hospitalized in Lombardy and in isolation, with preexisting medical conditions; contacts have been identified as part of routine surveillance. A(H9N2) is not new and circulates in Asia and Africa. Since 1998 through 27 February 2026, the ECDC reports 195 human cases across 10 countries in Asia and Africa, typically from direct contact with infected birds or contaminated environments; there have been no human outbreaks or sustained human-to-human transmission. The current risk to the European general population is considered very low. In the latest monitoring period (29 November 2025–27 February 2026), 10 human avian-flu cases were reported globally: Cambodia—1 case of A(H5N1); China—8 cases of A(H9N2) and 1 case of A(H10N3); no fatalities reported.

triage.headline_ja: イタリアで初の人間H9N2鳥インフルエンザ症例を確認
triage.triage_reason: H9N2人間感染は欧州初の確認症例で異常/予想外性が高く、IHR基準2つ以上に該当。国際的な懸念を引き起こしうる新規シグナル。
triage.notes: イタリアでの初症例は欧州内での報告だが、対象国リストに欧州諸国は含まれていないため verified_locations に含めない。サマリーで言及されるアジア地域（カンボジア、中国）のうち、対象国に該当するのは中国のみ。患者は大陸外からの渡航者で、現在イタリア国内は隔離・監視状況。欧州全体への直接的リスクは低いと評価されているが、H9N2の人間感染例が地理的に拡大している点は国際的懸念材料。

article.articleHeadline: Antibiotic Alternative Battles Foodborne Salmonella
article.articleSummary: China-origin study identifies bacteriophage W5 as a highly specific biocontrol agent against foodborne Salmonella. Isolated from wastewater, W5 lyses planktonic Salmonella and disrupts Salmonella biofilms on milk, meat, and eggs, and on food-contact surfaces under realistic storage conditions. Published in Applied and Environmental Microbiology by Gou and colleagues at Gansu Agricultural University (Lanzhou), the work profiles W5’s morphology, stability, growth kinetics, and genome to confirm efficacy and safety, noting absence of virulence and antibiotic resistance genes. The findings support a green alternative to chemicals and antibiotics, with potential for integration across the farm-to-fork chain—as a livestock feed additive, surface disinfectant in meat-processing plants, or a preservative spray for produce—providing a residue-free option to combat antimicrobial-resistant Salmonella.

triage.headline_ja: 抗生物質の代替案がフードボーン・サルモネラに対抗
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は中国発祥の研究論文紹介であり、実際の感染症アウトブレイクではなく、バクテリオファージを利用した食品バイオコントロール技術の開発・検証レポートです。人での実際の患者発生や公衆衛生上の急性危機は述べられていません。
triage.notes: 記事は研究成果の紹介であり、実際の感染症アウトブレイク情報ではありません。Bluedot APIが疾患名（Typhoid、Paratyphoid）とSalmonellaの関連キーワードで検出したと考えられますが、サマリーの主題は予防技術の開発です。実際の患者発生地は記載されていないため verified_locations は空配列です。

article.articleHeadline: झारखंड में सर्पदंश और कुष्ठ रोग अब 'अधिसूचित बीमारी' घोषित, निजी अस्पतालों को भी देनी होगी हर केस की रिपोर्ट  - jharkhand declares snakebite leprosy notifiable diseases
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In Jharkhand, snakebite and leprosy are now declared notifiable diseases; private hospitals will also have to report every case.
article.articleSummary: Jharkhand government has declared snakebite and leprosy as notifiable diseases, mandating reporting of their cases across the state. All government and private hospitals must report every case, including snakebite deaths, to state authorities. District-level reports must be submitted to the Civil Surgeon’s office, with the health department issuing separate notifications to implement the policy. The move follows rising snakebite fatalities and persistent rural beliefs and practices surrounding treatment. The new surveillance requirement aims to strengthen public health response, improve data on incidence and mortality, and guide resource allocation for prevention, treatment, and outreach across Jharkhand.

triage.headline_ja: ジャールカンド州でヘビ咬傷とハンセン病が「届出義務疾病」に指定、民間病院も全症例報告義務
triage.triage_reason: 本記事はジャールカンド州による疾病届出義務制度の導入という行政措置であり、新たな感染症の流行イベントではない。ハンセン病の新規患者数増加や急速な拡大を示す疫学的エビデンスがない。
triage.notes: 本記事の主題は、既存のハンセン病とヘビ咬傷の負担に対応するための行政的な通知制度の導入である。流行宣言や患者数の急増を示す内容ではなく、公衆衛生インフラの強化を目的とした政策変更である。疾病の新規出現や異常な増加の兆候は認められない。

This case follows international monitoring that, from 29 November 2025 to 27 February 2026, recorded 10 human avian influenza cases with no deaths: Cambodia (1 case of A(H5N1)); China (8 cases of A(H9N2) and 1 case of A(H10N3)). As of 27 February 2026, ECDC/EFSA reported 195 human A(H9N2) cases across ten countries in Asia and Africa.
