triage.headline_ja: イタリアが鳥インフルエンザH9N2のヨーロッパ初の人間感染例を確認
triage.triage_reason: H9N2の初のヨーロッパ人間感染例であり、異常・予想外性が高い。IHR基準で少なくとも2つ（異常/予想外、国際的拡大リスク）に該当し、国際的な関心と監視体制の強化が見込まれる。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIが複数地域（Lombardia、Italy、Cambodia、China、Africa）を挙げているが、記事サマリーの主題はイタリアでの初の人間感染例。中国とカンボジアは過去の国際監視データの参照として言及されているに過ぎない。対象国リストに含まれるのはChinaのみ。Italyはイタリアで発生しているが対象国リストに含まれていないため、verified_locationsには含めない。ただしイタリアでの初の確認例であり、国際的な関心が高い重要なシグナルである。

article.articleHeadline: Pesquisa com participação de São Carlos cria teste inovador de Covid mais rápido e barato
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Study involving São Carlos develops an innovative COVID-19 test that is faster and cheaper.
article.articleSummary: COVID-19 test developed with scientists from Sao Carlos (UNESP Araraquara campus) in collaboration with the University of Brasilia (UnB) and IFSC/USP, published in Biomedical Microdevices. The technology uses lab-engineered yeast to specifically recognize SARS-CoV-2, integrated into a device that detects the virus by electrical signal changes. By replacing imported antibodies with the yeast-based recognition on the yeast surface, the method reduces costs while preserving accuracy. The sensor can be used with portable equipment, increasing access in resource-poor regions and enabling use in clinics and health posts for rapid diagnosis. It also differentiates SARS-CoV-2 from influenza and dengue, lowering false positives and enabling earlier detection at very low viral loads. The researchers highlight the approach's core is yeast-high-sensitivity electronics integration, with potential adaptation to other infectious diseases and large-scale deployment in public health.

triage.headline_ja: サンカルロスの参加による研究がより迅速で安価なCOVID-19テストを開発
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は技術開発・研究成果の報道であり、感染症の集団発生イベント（アウトブレイク）ではない。公衆衛生上の新規患者発生や流行拡大を示す証拠がなく、IHR基準およびWPROスクリーニング基準のいずれにも該当しない。
triage.notes: 本記事はCOVID-19、インフルエンザ、デングウイルスの検査技術開発に関する科学ニュースであり、感染症発生情報（EBS対象）ではない。Bluedot APIが疾患名に複数の感染症を含めているが、これは検査の対象となる疾患が列記されているだけで、イベント自体は疾病の流行や集団発生ではない。シグナルトリアージの対象外として適切に見送られるべきである。

article.articleHeadline: Induk Harimau di Kebun Binatang Bandung Terinfeksi Virus, Satu Anak Harimau Meninggal Dunia
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Tigress at Bandung Zoo Infected with Virus, One Tiger Cub Dies.
article.articleSummary: Bandung Zoo in Bandung, Indonesia, reports a Bengal tiger cub died from a virus carried by its tigress mother. The eight‑month‑old cub died on March 24, 2026. The surviving cub remains under intensive care after infection believed to be transmitted by the tigress since birth. The two cubs were born on July 12, 2025 to Sahrulkan and Jelita. Bandung Mayor Muhammad Farhan stressed the death was not due to neglect, noting the virus is typical of the big-cat family. The surviving cub has shown improvement: diarrhea and vomiting resolved, increased activity, and resumption of eating. Treatments include antibiotics, antiemetics, rehydration fluids, immune supplements, and antivirals, under five veterinarians’ care, after a 72‑hour critical phase.

triage.headline_ja: バンドン動物園のトラの母親がウイルスに感染、子トラ1頭が死亡
triage.triage_reason: 本イベントは動物園のベンガルトラにおける動物疾病であり、ヒトの公衆衛生上の脅威を示す証拠がない。記事サマリーに人間への感染リスク、国際的拡大の可能性、または管理上の困難さの記述がない。
triage.notes: 本イベントは動物園の飼育動物（ベンガルトラ）に限定された動物疾病である。Unknown Illnessという疾患分類だが、サマリーではビッグキャット科に典型的なウイルスとされており、ヒト感染症の兆候はない。EBS活動の対象外と判定される。

article.articleHeadline: Dinkes Sumut Temukan 387 Kasus Suspek Campak dan 18 Kasus Positif - Tribun-medan.com
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: North Sumatra Health Office Finds 387 Suspected Measles Cases and 18 Positive Cases
article.articleSummary: On 2026-03-26, North Sumatra Health Office in Medan reported 387 suspected measles cases from January 2026 to March 4, with 18 laboratory-confirmed measles and no deaths. Immunization with Measles-Rubella (MR) rose from 80.79% in 2024 to 84.1% in 2025 but did not reach the national 93% target, mainly due to vaccine stock shortages. In 2025 the central stock buffer was insufficient because MR vaccines were diverted for the MR BIAS campaign in August, limiting routine stock. Of 33 districts/cities in North Sumatra, only eight reached the immunization target, with Deliserdang the highest at 132.51%. Officials stressed the need for MR dose 2 (MR2) to reach about 95% protection, since MR1 alone does not confer herd immunity; MR2 coverage among infants in Sumut also remains below the 83.1% target.

triage.headline_ja: 北スマトラ州保健局、麻疹の疑い例387件と陽性確定例18件を確認
triage.triage_reason: 麻疹とルベオラの発生が確認されており、スクリーニング基準で異常性・重症度・流行性が該当するが、死亡がなく情報不足のため経過観察段階と判定。
triage.notes: 北スマトラ州メダンで麻疹とルベオラの発生を確認。387件の疑い例と18件の確定例が報告されているが死亡例なし。予防接種率（MR）が全国目標の93%に達していない点（84.1%）が懸念される。流行しやすい環境と予防接種カバレッジの不足がWPRO基準で複数該当するが、国際的拡大の兆候や死亡例の報告がないため、現段階ではWATCHに設定。続報で患者数増加や死亡例の有無を確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: अमेरिका में फैला कोरोना का नया 'सिकाडा वैरिएंट, वैक्सीन को भी दे रहा है चकमा! कितना खतरनाक
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A new 'Sikada' variant of the coronavirus spreading in America, outsmarting the vaccine! How dangerous.
article.articleSummary: New Omicron-family sub-variant BA.3.2, nicknamed 'Sikada', is spreading in the United States, with samples in about half the states and wastewater data from three aircraft and 132 wastewater samples across more than 20 states. Cases are reported in at least 23 countries. CDC notes 22-23 countries; WHO classifies Sikada as a Variant Under Monitoring, not a Variant of Concern. First identified in November 2024 in South Africa; spread accelerated through 2025. The variant carries roughly 70-75 mutations, making it distinct. In the U.S., hospitalizations are rising in Florida, California, and New York; no major mortality increase yet. It can infect some vaccinated individuals; early studies suggest immune evasion but not higher virulence. Symptoms resemble flu: high fever, sore throat, persistent cough, body aches, fatigue; some patients have shortness of breath and loss of taste/smell. No cases in India; vigilance due to international travel remains.

triage.headline_ja: アメリカで広がるコロナウイルスの新しい『シカダ変異株』、ワクチンをも回避中！どれほど危険か
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で異常性と国際的拡大リスクが該当（2つ以上）。WHO監視下の変異株が23ヵ国で報告され、米国で入院増加が報告されており、フルRRA進行に値する。
triage.notes: 発生地域にUSAが含まれるが、対象国リストに米国は含まれていないため verified_locations には含めない。インドはサマリーで『インドではケースなし、国際的な渡航による警戒が必要』と明記されているため、潜在的リスク地域として対象国である1269750(India)を記載。WHO VUM指定変異株で国際的な関心が高く、PICKUP判定の根拠は IHR基準（異常性+国際的拡大）と WPRO基準（複数該当）である。

article.articleHeadline: Canada Issues Urgent Travel Advisory for Italy, Spain, Greece, China, and India, Warning Tourists of Rare Disease Risks and Key Health Precautions - Travel And Tour World
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-03-26, Canada warns travelers to Italy, Spain, Greece, China, and India about visceral leishmaniasis, a potentially life-threatening disease transmitted by sandflies. The Public Health Agency of Canada (PHAC) highlights visceral leishmaniasis as the severe form of leishmaniasis (distinct from cutaneous and mucocutaneous), contracted via bites from infected sandflies most active at dusk and dawn. Symptoms include fever, significant weight loss, enlarged spleen or liver, and anemia, with incubation spanning weeks to months. There is no vaccine or specific preventive medication; travelers should implement protective measures to reduce sandfly exposure. Early diagnosis and treatment are crucial to prevent fatal outcomes. If symptoms develop during or after travel, seek medical care promptly to ensure rapid management and care. The advisory emphasizes vigilance for health risks in these destinations.}

triage.headline_ja: カナダがイタリア、スペイン、ギリシャ、中国、インドへの緊急渡航警告を発令―稀少感染症のリスクと重要な健康対策について観光客に警告
triage.triage_reason: カナダが複数国への渡航警告を発令し、内臓リーシュマニア症（致死的リスク）について国際的に広げており、社会的関心が高い。IHR基準でも異常性・国際拡大リスク・渡航制限リスクが認められ、WPROスクリーニング基準では重症度と流行可能性が該当する。対象国（インド、中国）での発生情報を含む。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIが列挙した発生地域にはイタリア、スペイン、ギリシャ、カナダが含まれているが、これらは対象国リストに該当しないため除外。記事サマリーから、内臓リーシュマニア症の感染地として明記されているのは対象国のうち中国とインドのみ。カナダの渡航警告は情報発出元であり感染発生地ではない。複数国への渡航警告という社会的インパクトが大きく、フルRRA対象としてピックアップされるべきシグナル。

article.articleHeadline: Италия сообщила о первом в Европе случае гриппа H9N2 у человека
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Italy reported the first human case of H9N2 avian influenza in Europe.
article.articleSummary: Italy reports the first human case of avian influenza A(H9N2) in Europe. An individual arriving in Lombardy from outside Europe is hospitalized with A(H9N2) avian influenza; the patient has comorbidities, is isolated in hospital, and receiving treatment. Contact tracing was completed under routine prophylaxis and surveillance. This marks Europe’s first human H9N2 infection; no evidence of human-to-human transmission or clusters has been identified. Since 1998 through 27 February 2026, ten Asian and African countries have reported 195 human A(H9N2) cases. Infections typically arise from direct contact with infected poultry or contaminated environments. In the monitoring period 29 November 2025–27 February 2026, ten human avian influenza cases were reported globally with no fatalities: Cambodia (one A(H5N1)); China (eight A(H9N2), one A(H10N3)). ECDC assesses the current EU/EEA population risk from A(H9N2) as very low in light of this case.

article.articleHeadline: Italie: premier cas humain européen de grippe aviaire H9N2 confirmé
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Italy: first European human case of H9N2 avian influenza confirmed.
article.articleSummary: Imported human case of avian influenza A(H9N2) detected in Lombardy, Italy, after travel from outside Europe; the patient is hospitalized, has comorbidities, and is isolated while receiving treatment. The European Centre for Disease Prevention and Control (ECDC) confirms this is the first human A(H9N2) case detected in Europe, with contacts identified as part of routine surveillance. No human-to-human transmission or outbreak cluster has been reported. Since 1998 and up to 27 February 2026, 195 human A(H9N2) infections have been reported across ten countries in Asia and Africa. Human infections are most often linked to direct contact with infected birds or contaminated environments; sporadic cases are expected where the virus circulates in birds. In the period 29 November 2025–27 February 2026, ten human cases were reported—Cambodia (one A(H5N1)) and China (eight A(H9N2), one A(H10N3)); none fatal. ECDC deems the risk to the general EU/EEA population very low.

article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A mosquito sparks panic in the United States after a rise in dengue fever cases - Youm7
article.articleSummary: Dengue fever is rising in the United States, triggering a CDC traveler alert as infections among returning travelers climb. The agency reports 496 dengue cases in the U.S. so far this year, mostly travel-associated. Countries linked include Cuba, Colombia, Vietnam, Bolivia, Pakistan, and the Maldives. Although most infections are acquired abroad, the CDC warns of potential local transmission in Puerto Rico, American Samoa, and the U.S. Virgin Islands. Dengue is a mosquito-borne viral illness causing fever, nausea, vomiting, rash, and severe muscle and joint pains; about 25% of infections are symptomatic. Severe dengue can progress rapidly and be life-threatening, and prior dengue infection increases risk of severe disease upon reinfection. Preventive advice includes using insect repellent, wearing protective clothing, and seeking medical care promptly if fever or warning signs appear after travel.

article.articleHeadline: Dinkes Kota Madiun tingkatkan deteksi kasus baru penyakit TBC - ANTARA News Jawa Timur
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Madiun City Health Office steps up detection of new tuberculosis cases - ANTARA News East Java
article.articleSummary: To reach the government’s TB elimination target for 2030, Madiun City Health Office in East Java is intensifying detection of new tuberculosis (TB) cases. The annual target is to identify over 1,000 TB cases in health facilities. The TB Sweep program at the neighborhood level engages community health centers (puskesmas) and Posyandu Integrated Primary Service posts to boost case finding. Residents are also urged to self-screen via the E-Tibi app (etibi.dinkes.jatimprov.go.id/skrining), which asks about symptoms such as a cough lasting more than two weeks and exposure to TB. Data show 2025 detections reached 1,281; 2024 had 1,268; early 2026 recorded 158, totaling 2,707 cases over three years. About half of the patients are non-residents seeking care in Madiun. TB treatment should be completed regularly for at least six consecutive months and is provided free at all puskesmas.

article.articleHeadline: Innovative Antibiotic Alternative Targets Foodborne Salmonella
article.articleSummary: Salmonella, a major foodborne pathogen, is targeted by a novel bacteriophage W5 from China (Gansu Agricultural University). W5 shows high specificity for Salmonella, lysing planktonic cells and those in biofilms on milk, meat, egg surfaces, and food-contact equipment. Isolated from wastewater, W5's morphology and genome show no virulence or antibiotic-resistance genes, indicating safety for potential applications. In vitro and in situ tests demonstrate W5 degrades Salmonella biofilms under real-world storage conditions, with activity across varied temperatures and pH, indicating robust stability. This phage-based approach offers a chemical-free alternative to antibiotics, enabling phage-based disinfectants, food preservatives, and use as a livestock feed additive to prevent colonization. Challenges remain, including regulatory approval, formulation stability, large-scale production, and integration into existing food-safety workflows for commercial deployment.

article.articleHeadline: В Китае выявили бактериофаг, эффективно уничтожающий штаммы сальмонеллы
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In China, a bacteriophage that effectively destroys Salmonella strains has been identified.
article.articleSummary: China’s microbiologists at Gansu Agricultural University identified a previously unknown bacteriophage from the W5 family that targets Salmonella strains, including antibiotic-resistant ones. In experiments, this phage infected three of the most dangerous Salmonella variants responsible for typhoid fever and various forms of salmonellosis and rapidly proliferated, with a latent period of about 22 minutes. The phage reliably reduces Salmonella contamination on meat, dairy, and other food products and inhibits biofilm formation that can shield bacteria from antibiotics. Researchers isolated 27 phages from livestock environments and slaughterhouses before pinpointing W5 as a candidate with precise activity against Salmonella colonies present in food and packaging materials. Described as safe for humans, this phage could become a valuable tool to enhance food safety in production. ASM press release, dated 2026-03-26.

article.articleHeadline: Minas confirma 17 casos de mpox em 2024
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Minas Gerais confirms 17 mpox cases in 2024.
article.articleSummary: Minas Gerais reports 17 mpox (monkeypox) cases in 2026, with all patients recovered. Belo Horizonte leads with 11 cases, Contagem has 3, and Formiga, Ribeirão das Neves, and Manhuaçu each have 1. All cases occurred in males aged 25–56. Transmission is via direct contact with skin lesions, body fluids, and contaminated materials; symptoms include skin lesions, lymphadenopathy, fever, headache, body pains, chills, and weakness. There is no specific mpox treatment; patients receive supportive care and most cases are mild to moderate. Prevention emphasizes isolation during the transmission period, avoiding sharing personal items, and diligent hand hygiene. Vaccination priority groups include people living with HIV/AIDS with immunosuppression (CD4 < 200 cells/µL in the last six months), laboratory workers at biosafety level 2, and individuals with direct exposure to fluids or secretions of suspected/confirmed cases. Epidemiological monitoring is ongoing.

triage.headline_ja: ミナス・ジェライス州が2024年にmpox 17例を確認
triage.triage_reason: Mpoxの確認例報告で、HIV陽性者を含む特定の高リスク集団へのワクチン接種戦略の言及があり、公衆衛生対応が実施されている。複数地域での発生と継続的な疫学監視の実施が確認できる。
triage.notes: 記事は2026年のイベントを報告しているが、見出しに2024年と記載されている矛盾がある。すべての患者が回復しており、重症度は低い。しかし、ヒト-ヒト感染可能性、HIV陽性者の優先ワクチン接種対象化、複数地域での同時発生、継続的な疫学監視により、スクリーニング基準4項目が該当。ブラジル国内での対応能力は確認できるが、シグナルとしてピックアップし、フルRRAで詳細評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: 國家疾控局：春夏季蚊媒傳染風險上升 - 香港文匯網
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: National Center for Disease Control and Prevention: Mosquito-borne transmission risk rising in spring and summer
article.articleSummary: On 2026-03-26, China’s National Center for Disease Control and Prevention briefed on tuberculosis control and spring–summer mosquito-borne disease prevention. TB remains a major health concern; China uses enhanced chest imaging and pathogen testing for high-risk groups, and rapid molecular tests cut drug-resistant TB diagnosis from weeks to hours. By end-2025, nationwide screening for drug-resistant TB reached 91%, above the global average of 83%. TB incidence and mortality have fallen about 30% since 2012, with cure rates above 90%, placing China in the global mid-low TB-prevalence tier. For spring–summer mosquito-borne diseases, imported dengue, chikungunya, and malaria risks rise as travel increases and climate warms, expanding Aedes habitats and potentially extending transmission. 2026 faces higher local transmission risk than previous years, with clustering possible. Authorities advocate integrated multi-disease prevention for dengue and chikungunya, stronger port/border cooperation, expanded vector surveillance, multiplex testing, data-integrated analytics, and R&D. Dengue, chikungunya, and fever with thrombocytopenia syndrome are now Category B infectious diseases.

triage.headline_ja: 国家疾病管理予防センター：春夏季の蚊媒介感染症リスク上昇
triage.triage_reason: 中国における複数の蚊媒介疾患（デング熱、チクングニア熱、マラリア）および結節熱血小板減少症候群の流行リスク上昇が公式発表されているが、現在のところ具体的な症例数や重症度の報告がなく、情報不足。継続監視が必要。
triage.notes: 中国の公式な疾病対策機関による春夏季の蚊媒介疾患リスク警告。デング熱、チクングニア熱、マラリアが輸入症例として増加リスクがあり、2026年は地域内感染リスクが過去より高いと評価されている。結節熱血小板減少症候群もカテゴリーB感染症に指定。ただし現在の実際の症例報告や重症度情報が記事サマリーには含まれていない。

article.articleHeadline: SUS vai oferecer teste rápido para dengue - 26/03/2026 - Equilíbrio e Saúde - Folha
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: SUS to Offer Rapid Dengue Test - March 26, 2026 - Balance and Health - Folha
article.articleSummary: Brazil's SUS will begin offering a rapid dengue diagnostic test (NS1) in public health units after a Ministry of Health ordinance published March 26, 2026 in the Official Journal. The NS1 rapid test detects the viral NS1 protein during the acute phase and is indicated for use within the first five days of symptoms. A positive result confirms an acute infection; a negative result does not exclude it. Availability depends on state and municipal procurement and distribution. ANVISA notes NS1 is present in all four dengue serotypes, enabling faster diagnosis and treatment. The move comes as dengue slows but Brazil recorded 28 dengue deaths in 2026, per the Ministry of Health Arboviruses Monitoring Panel. Other approved methods include serology (after day 6) and RT-PCR, with different detection windows and capabilities.

triage.headline_ja: SUSがデング熱の迅速診断テストを提供開始 - 2026年3月26日 - バランス・ヘルス - フォーリャ
triage.triage_reason: デング熱の診断検査の導入は公衆衛生対応の強化を示す通常の保健政策であり、異常な流行事象ではない。死亡数は限定的（28例）で、国際的な感染拡大リスクやIHR基準の該当は認められない。
triage.notes: 本記事はデング熱の診断検査方法の導入に関する保健政策ニュースであり、新規の感染症流行事象ではない。ブラジル国内でのデング熱活動は確認されるが、現在は「減速している」と記載されており、急速な拡大や危機的状況は示唆されていない。2026年の死亡数28例は継続的な監視対象ではあるが、シグナルレベルのトリアージ基準には達していない。

article.articleHeadline: À la source des zoonoses : comprendre - surveiller - prévenir les risques d'émergence
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: At the source of zoonoses: understanding, monitoring, and preventing the risks of emergence.
article.articleSummary: France’s PREZODE program (PEPR PREZODE) under France 2030, supported for five years, aims to understand ecological, epidemiological, and sociocultural drivers of zoonotic emergence and shift from reactive to anticipatory public health action. Led by Manon Lounnas (IRD), it centers on One Health, integrating animal and human health with food systems and environments, to propose prevention strategies, bolster socio-ecological resilience, and enhance early detection. Zoonoses arise when pathogens jump between animals and humans; about 60% of human infectious diseases are of animal origin, rising to 75% for emerging diseases. Drivers include climate change, deforestation, intensive agriculture, and global trade; examples include Nipah-like spillovers and arboviruses reaching Europe, underscoring vulnerability and the dilution effect of biodiversity in reducing transmission. CARE uses community-based research in France, Côte d’Ivoire, and Zimbabwe to study risky behaviors. PREZODE works at faunal–livestock–human interfaces and vulnerability zones, with ZOLA in Vietnam/Bangladesh (poultry markets) and ZOOCAM in Camargue to curb avian flu, emphasizing multidisciplinary, participatory approaches and no single solution.

triage.headline_ja: 人獣共通感染症の源流を理解し、監視し、出現のリスクを防ぐ
triage.triage_reason: 複数の動物由来感染症（ニパウイルス、鳥インフルエンザ）が記載されており、スクリーニング基準の「流行しやすさ」に該当する可能性があるが、記事は研究プログラムと予防戦略の紹介が中心で、実際の流行イベントの報告ではなく、情報不足のため経過観察が必要。
triage.notes: 記事はフランスのPREZODEプログラムの紹介であり、実際の感染症イベント・流行報告ではなく、研究・予防戦略が主題である。引用されている国（コートジボワール、ジンバブエ、バングラデシュ、ベトナム）は研究対象地域として言及されているが、これらの国での実際の患者発生やアウトブレイクの報告は含まれていない。対象国リストに該当し記事で実際の流行が述べられている国はベトナムのみ（鳥インフルエンザ関連の言及）だが、具体的なイベント詳細は記載されていない。

article.articleHeadline: Meglépték, amire senki sem számított: mindent bevetnek a pusztító kór megfékezésére
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: They surpassed what no one expected: they're pulling out all the stops to curb the devastating disease.
article.articleSummary: Brazil extended for another 180 days the national animal health emergency declared for avian influenza last year, despite no new cases in commercial farms. According to the Ministry of Agriculture, the preventive extension aims to ensure the conditions to quickly contain and eradicate outbreaks. Brazil, the world’s largest poultry exporter, confirmed an avian influenza outbreak at a commercial poultry farm in May 2025; the outbreak was isolated and no further infections have been detected in commercial stock. Consequently, major importing countries gradually lifted trade restrictions on Brazilian poultry products. Source: Reuters. Published 2026-03-26.

triage.headline_ja: 予想外の対策：破壊的な疾病を抑制するためにあらゆる手段を講じている
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルにおける鳥インフルエンザの国家動物衛生緊急事態が180日間延長されたが、商業農場での新規感染例がないため、現時点での深刻な流行継続は確認されていない。予防的延長措置であり、情報が限定的である。
triage.notes: ブラジルは世界最大の家禽輸出国であり、2025年5月に商業農場での鳥インフルエンザ発生が確認されたが、その後新規感染が検出されていない。記事は予防的な緊急事態延長措置についており、現在の流行状況よりも政策対応を重視している。引き続き流行の再発生を監視する必要があるが、現段階では情報不足のためWATCH判定とした。

article.articleHeadline: CCZ confirma 4° morcego com raiva em Campo Grande
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: CCZ confirms 4th bat with rabies in Campo Grande.
article.articleSummary: Rabies confirmed in Campo Grande, Brazil: The Municipal Center for Zoonoses (CCZ) reports the fourth bat testing positive for rabies in the city this year. The infected bat was found on a residence balcony in Jardim Campo Alto; the resident isolated the animal before CCZ contact. The bat was collected and sent to laboratory tests, which confirmed the rabies virus. This case expands the perception that infected bats can appear in any type of property, not only upper floors, underscoring ongoing viral circulation in the capital. Previous detections occurred in Santa Fé and Vivendas do Bosque; authorities stress prevention and immediate reporting of any live or dead bats. CCZ is located at Av. Sen. Filinto Müller, 1601, Vila Ipiranga. WhatsApp reporting: (67) 99142-5701, Monday–Friday, 7:00–17:00.

triage.headline_ja: CCZ、カンポ・グランデで4番目の狂犬病感染コウモリを確認
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルでのコウモリの狂犬病確認は予想外の現象だが、情報が限定的（死亡なし、ヒト感染なし、局所的）であり、フルリスク評価前の経過観察が適切。
triage.notes: 狂犬病はWHOの報告対象疾患だが、本報告は動物（コウモリ）での確認であり、ヒト症例や重症感染者はない。地域的に限定されており、既に当局による監視体制が構築されている。引き続き、ヒト感染例の発生の有無を注視すべき。

article.articleHeadline: Macuco realiza 'Dia D' de prevenção à Dengue
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Macuco Holds Dengue Prevention Day.
article.articleSummary: Dengue Prevention Day was held in Macuco on March 25, organized by the Health Department with support from the Education Department and the Municipal Education Network to raise awareness about eliminating Aedes aegypti, the dengue vector, and preventing other mosquito-borne diseases. The Dia D mobilization drew dozens of residents into a city-wide march promoting practical prevention steps and daily actions to curb mosquito breeding sites, following Ministry of Health guidance. Educational posters and lively activities accompanied participation by municipal students, teachers, directors, and Education Secretary Cláudia Vogas, highlighting youth engagement in public health. Health Secretary Ana Paula Gonçalves noted the initiative aligns with the national 10 Minutes Save Lives campaign, emphasizing eliminating potential breeding grounds inside homes. Citizens are urged to maintain daily preventive measures to protect the community.

triage.headline_ja: マクコ市がデング熱予防の「Dia D」を開催
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル内の単一自治体による予防啓発キャンペーン報道。既知の感染症の定期的な公衆衛生対策であり、異常な感染事象ではなく、新規発生や急速な拡大のシグナルに該当しない。
triage.notes: 記事は予防イベントの報道であり、新規患者集積や感染クラスターの報告ではない。ブラジルは周年的にデング熱の季節対策を実施しており、この報道は既知の疾病対策の通常業務範囲内。対象国リストではブラジルのみ該当するが、シグナル基準には合致しない。

article.articleHeadline: Tuberculose desce no Alentejo em 2024 mas Beja mantém incidência acima da média
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Tuberculosis decreases in Alentejo in 2024, but Beja maintains incidence above average.
article.articleSummary: TB incidence in Alentejo fell to 7.8 per 100,000 in 2024, down from 11.4, with 37 cases recorded (2023 had 54). Nationally, Portugal reported 1,536 cases (14.3 per 100,000). Beja district remains above regional average, with a five-year rate of 18.1 per 100,000, and Odemira municipality shows the highest local incidence at 37.6 per 100,000. Despite the overall decrease, risk factors persist—diabetes, alcohol use, and communal housing. In 2024, median time from symptom onset to TB diagnosis in Alentejo was 75 days, shorter than the national median of 81 days. Migrants accounted for 43.2% of Alentejo TB cases, with Nepal and India among the principal origins. The DGS highlights reducing diagnostic delay, strengthening screening in vulnerable groups, and improving health-care access, in line with WHO 2035 targets to cut TB incidence and mortality.

triage.headline_ja: アレンテージョ地域の結核患者が2024年に減少、ただしベージャ地区は平均以上の発生率を維持
triage.triage_reason: ポルトガルの結核発生は減少傾向であり、深刻度は相対的に低いが、移民（ネパール・インド出身者）が43.2%を占める多様な感染源、診断遅延の課題、および脆弱層への対策の必要性が指摘されており、継続監視が適切。
triage.notes: 記事はポルトガルのアレンテージョ地域での結核統計について報告しているが、対象国リストではポルトガルは含まれていない。ただし、サマリーでネパールとインドが移民感染源として明示されており、インド(1269750)は検証対象国として該当。結核は長期曝露・流行性疾患であるため、WPROスクリーニング基準で2つ該当。発生地域フィールドにはネパール(1282988)も含まれているが、インドのみが対象国リストに該当するため verified_locations にはインドのみを列挙。

article.articleHeadline: Brasil prorroga emergência zoossanitária por gripe aviária de forma preventiva | G1
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Brazil Extends Zoosanitary Emergency for Avian Influenza as a Precautionary Measure
article.articleSummary: Brazil extends the nationwide 180-day zoosanitary emergency for avian influenza (bird flu) to enable rapid containment and eradication of outbreaks and to mobilize federal resources, due to ongoing high-pathogenicity virus circulation in wild birds. The extension follows the first wild-bird outbreak on 15 May 2023; a commercial farm outbreak—the first and only in Brazil—was confirmed on 15 May 2025. To date, 188 foci have been reported: 173 in wild birds, 14 in backyard and subsistence birds, and 1 in a commercial farm; the commercial case previously triggered import embargoes, which were suspended over the past year after resolution. The measure aims to support swift response to any new foci nationwide.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジル、高病原性鳥インフルエンザの予防的措置として動物衛生緊急事態を延長
triage.triage_reason: 野生鳥類における高病原性鳥インフルエンザの継続的な流行が確認されており、動物への公衆衛生影響と国境を越えた拡大リスクは存在するが、商業農場での発生は1件に限定され、過去の輸入禁止措置は既に解除されている。情報不足により確定的な判定を保留。
triage.notes: IHR基準は2つ以上該当（serious_impact、international_spread）し、WPRO基準も2つ該当（prolonged_exposure、epidemic_prone）しているが、トリアージ判定はWATCHとした理由：①商業農場での発生が極めて限定的（1件）で管理可能である点、②ブラジル自体が十分な対応能力を有していると判断される点、③人への感染リスクに関する具体的情報が記事に記載されていない点。人間への感染可能性や重症度に関する詳細情報が必要。

diseases.name: Human Infection with Avian Influenza A H5N1

article.articleHeadline: Estado de emergência zoossanitária por gripe aviária é prorrogado no país
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Zoosanitary State of Emergency for Avian Influenza Is Extended Nationwide.
article.articleSummary: Brazil extends its zoosanitary state of emergency for avian influenza (highly pathogenic H5N1) nationwide for 180 days. Portaria No. 896, published March 26, 2026, reinforces preventive measures to preserve rapid containment and eradication of foci, and to mobilize federal resources with coordination among MAPA (Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock), other government levels, and NGOs. First national outbreak occurred May 15, 2023 in wild birds; first commercial poultry case was confirmed May 15, 2025. A total of 188 foci have been reported: 173 in wild birds, 14 in backyard flocks, and 1 in a commercial poultry operation. Ongoing surveillance and control efforts aim to limit further spread of H5N1 across Brazil.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジル全国で鳥インフルエンザによる動物衛生緊急事態が延長される
triage.triage_reason: H5N1の高病原性インフルエンザが確認されており、商業養鶏場での発生、継続的な拡大リスク、および国家レベルの緊急事態延長宣言があり、IHR基準とWPRO基準の複数が該当する。
triage.notes: 高病原性H5N1が商業養鶏場での確認（2025年5月15日初例）、188件の発生報告（野生鳥173件、庭先養鶏14件、商業養鶏1件）、180日間の緊急事態延長宣言により、今後の拡大リスクおよび国際的な家畜貿易への影響が懸念される。

diseases.name: Low Pathogenic Avian Influenza A H9N2
Human Infection with Avian Influenza A H9N2

article.articleHeadline: Pierwszy w Europie taki przypadek u człowieka. Włochy potwierdzają
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: First such case in Europe in a human being. Italy confirms.
article.articleSummary: First human case of H9N2 avian influenza confirmed in Europe, in Italy's Lombardy. The patient, who arrived in Lombardy from outside Europe, was hospitalised with A(H9N2) influenza and has comorbidities; they remain under hospital isolation. All required tests were performed promptly, and contacts of the patient were identified under routine prophylaxis and surveillance. This marks the first recorded human H9N2 infection in Europe. As of end-February 2026, the European Centre for Disease Prevention and Control (ECDC) reports 195 human A(H9N2) infections in Asia and Africa since 1998. Human infections typically occur via direct contact with sick birds or contaminated environments. A joint ECDC/EFSA update notes ten human avian influenza cases from November to February, all in Cambodia and China, with no fatalities.

triage.headline_ja: ヨーロッパで初めて。イタリアが人間の症例を確認
triage.triage_reason: H9N2鳥インフルエンザの人への初のヨーロッパ感染例であり、異常性・予想外性が高く、国際的拡大リスクがある。IHR基準3項目該当、WPRO基準も3項目該当。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はイタリアでの初ヨーロッパ人感染例ですが、イタリアは対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations には含めていません。サマリーで「アジアとアフリカで195例」「11月～2月の10例はカンボジアと中国」と述べられており、中国（対象国）での継続的な感染事例が確認されているため、中国を verified_locations に含めました。患者は院内隔離中で合併症あり。

article.articleHeadline: SUS passa a oferecer teste rápido de dengue
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: SUS begins offering rapid dengue test.
article.articleSummary: Brazil's Ministry of Health has incorporated the Dengue NS1 rapid test into the SUS national procedures, effective as of March 26, 2026. The immunochromatography NS1 assay is widely offered in public clinics and hospitals, with requests by doctors, nurses, biomedical staff, and nursing technicians for patients of all ages. It detects dengue virus NS1 antigen in blood early in infection, enabling diagnosis within the first days of fever, unlike serology that becomes positive after about day six. A positive result allows early warning for signs such as thrombocytopenia and risk of progression to dengue hemorrhagic fever, and enhances epidemiological surveillance. The test uses a finger-prick blood sample, requires no fasting, and yields results in minutes. It does not identify dengue serotypes or past infections. The test is free under SUS; privately purchased tests average around R$40.

triage.headline_ja: SUSがデング熱の迅速検査の提供を開始
triage.triage_reason: 本記事はブラジルの公衆衛生システムにおけるデング熱診断ツールの導入に関する行政決定であり、新規感染症アウトブレイクではなく、検査能力の強化を扱っている。IHR基準、WPROスクリーニング基準いずれも該当しない。
triage.notes: 記事内容は既知のデング熱流行に対する診断能力強化の行政措置であり、新規アウトブレイク、重症例の増加、異常なヒト-ヒト感染パターンなどの証拠がない。公衆衛生の進展として評価できるが、シグナルトリアージの対象外。

diseases.name: Human Infection with Swine Influenza A H1N1
Human Infection with Swine Influenza A H3N2

article.articleHeadline: Furto de vírus: amostras de H1N1 e H3N2 são recuperadas após 40 dias desaparecidas da Unicamp - Metro 1
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Virus theft: H1N1 and H3N2 samples recovered after 40 days missing from UNICAMP - Metro 1
article.articleSummary: Influenza A strains H1N1 and H3N2 samples disappeared from UNICAMP's Virology Laboratory (NB-3) in Campinas, Brazil, on February 13 and were recovered March 25 after 40 days. The materials, stored in a NB-3 facility though H1N1/H3N2 are NB-2 risk, included other human and swine viruses later sent to the Agriculture Ministry; no external contamination reported. Federal Police located the samples in laboratories of the Food Engineering Faculty about 350 meters from the origin; facilities were sealed under warrants. Researcher Soledad Palameta Miller was arrested on March 23 for theft, irregular transport of a genetically modified organism, and endangering public health; her husband is under investigation. Unicamp launched an internal probe; NB-4 Orion laboratory is under construction in Campinas, slated for 2027.

triage.headline_ja: ウイルス盗難：H1N1およびH3N2サンプルがUNICAMPから40日間の行方不明後に回収される
triage.triage_reason: 危険なウイルスサンプル（H1N1/H3N2）の盗難・行方不明事件であり、公衆衛生上の深刻な影響と異常性が認められ、IHR基準を複数満たす。バイオセーフティ違反と研究機関からの病原体流出という重大なインシデントとして分類される。
triage.notes: 本事案は感染症の自然発生ではなく、研究機関からの危険病原体サンプル盗難事件。40日間の行方不明期間、不適切なバイオセーフティレベル保管（NB-3で保管されたNB-2リスク物質）、逮捕者発生など複数の重大要素を含む。バイオセキュリティ・インシデントとして重要視すべき案件。

diseases.name: Highly Pathogenic Avian Influenza A H5N1
Human Infection with Avian Influenza A H5N1

article.articleHeadline: Mapa prorroga por mais 180 dias o estado de emergência zoossanitária por gripe aviária
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: MAPA Extends Zoosanitary State of Emergency for Another 180 Days Due to Avian Influenza.
article.articleSummary: Brazil extends the 180-day zoosanitary state of emergency for high-pathogenicity avian influenza A(H5N1) across the national territory. Portaria No. 896, published 26 March 2026, preserves conditions for rapid containment and eradication of foci and enables mobilization of federal resources and inter-ministerial coordination with states, municipalities, and NGOs. The measure follows ongoing circulation of HPAI A(H5N1) in wild birds in Brazil. First wild-bird outbreak was on 15 May 2023; first outbreak in a commercial flock was on 15 May 2025. To date, Brazil has recorded 188 foci: 173 in wild birds, 14 in backyard/subsistence poultry, and 1 in a commercial poultry operation. The extension reinforces surveillance and control nationwide to manage and curb the outbreak.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジル、鳥インフルエンザによる動物衛生上の緊急事態宣言をさらに180日延長
triage.triage_reason: 高病原性鳥インフルエンザA(H5N1)の継続的な流行が確認されており、スクリーニング基準（異常性、重症度、長期曝露、管理可能性）に複数該当する。ただし、現在の情報では人への感染報告がなく、政府による対応と管理が進行中のため、より詳細な情報が必要。
triage.notes: 現時点で記事に人への感染報告の記載なし（疾患名にはHuman Infectionが含まれるが、サマリーは野生鳥類と家禽における発生に焦点）。ブラジルは対象国リストに含まれているが、南米のため他地域への影響も注視必要。継続的な野生鳥類の感染循環と商業養鶏の1事例が懸念。188フォーカスの追跡と管理状況の更新情報が重要。

diseases.name: Human Infection with Avian Influenza A H9N2
Human Infection with Avian Influenza A H5N8

article.articleHeadline: إيطاليا تسجل أول إصابة بشرية بأنفلونزا الطيور "H9N2" في أوروبا
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Italy records its first human case of avian influenza H9N2 in Europe.
article.articleSummary: Italy reports the first human case of avian influenza A(H9N2) in Europe: a patient arriving in Lombardy from outside Europe, currently hospitalized in isolation with chronic conditions. The patient is under treatment, with routine surveillance and contact tracing underway; laboratory tests have been conducted and contacts identified. This marks Europe’s first reported human case of H9N2. The European Centre for Disease Prevention and Control (ECDC) notes that from 1998 through February 2026, 195 human H9N2 infections have been reported across 10 countries in Asia and Africa, with no clusters or documented human-to-human transmission; infections usually arise from direct contact with infected birds or contaminated environments. The latest EFSA/ECDC report (Nov 2025–Feb 2026) records 10 human avian influenza cases in Cambodia and China, with no deaths. Current EU/EEA risk remains very low. Experts note that sporadic human infections occur where birds shed the virus, underscoring ongoing surveillance.

triage.headline_ja: イタリアがヨーロッパで初となるH9N2鳥インフルエンザの人間感染を確認
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3項目該当（異常性・予想外性・国際的拡大リスク）、WPRO基準2項目以上該当（異常性・重症度・管理可能性の懸念）。H9N2の人間感染がヨーロッパで初めて報告された歴史的なイベントであり、国際的な感染症サーベイランス上の重要な信号である。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーの主題はイタリアでのH9N2初ヒト感染事例だが、イタリアは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めない。サマリーで言及されているカンボジアも対象国外。ただし、最新のEFSA/ECDCレポート（2025年11月～2026年2月）でカンボジアと中国での10例のヒト鳥インフルエンザが報告されており、China(1814991)は対象国として含める。この事例は、アジアで散発的に報告されているH9N2感染が初めてヨーロッパに拡大したことを示す国際的に重要なシグナルである。患者は渡航関連の輸入感染例だが、ヒト-ヒト感染の記録がなく、現在のEU/EEAリスクは非常に低いと評価されている。

article.articleHeadline: SUS passa a oferecer teste rápido para diagnóstico da dengue - News Rondônia
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: SUS begins offering rapid test for dengue diagnosis - News Rondônia.
article.articleSummary: Brazil's Health Ministry formally incorporated the rapid dengue NS1 diagnostic test into the Unified Health System (SUS) nationwide, with the measure published on 26 March 2026 in the Diário Oficial da União. The immunochromatography-based test uses a finger-prick blood sample, provides results within minutes, and is offered free to patients; private-sector tests cost about R$40. It detects dengue virus early but does not identify serotype (1–4) or indicate prior infection. The test can be ordered by doctors, nurses, biomedical scientists, and nursing technicians for patients of any age, aiding early warning signs such as a sharp drop in platelets to help prevent progression to dengue hemorrhagic fever. Medical evaluation remains essential for symptoms like fever, retro-orbital pain, red skin spots, and extreme fatigue. The program enhances epidemiological surveillance, enabling municipalities to identify outbreak foci nationwide.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジルの統一医療制度がデング熱迅速診断検査の提供を開始
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は既存の診断検査ツールの保健システムへの導入という行政措置の報告であり、新規の感染症アウトブレイクや異常事象ではない。IHR基準およびWPRO基準のいずれにも該当しない。
triage.notes: 記事は保健省による診断検査の統一医療制度(SUS)への導入決定という行政ニュースであり、感染症イベント（アウトブレイク、異常な発生、重症化傾向など）を報告するものではない。既存のデング熱対応能力の向上を目的とした定常的な公衆衛生施策。シグナルトリアージ対象外。

article.articleHeadline: Agricultura prorroga estado de emergência por gripe aviária
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Agriculture Extends State of Emergency Due to Avian Influenza.
article.articleSummary: Brazil extends a 180-day nationwide zoosanitary emergency for Avian Influenza (Influenza A virus) due to the circulation of a more aggressive strain among wild birds. Transmission occurs via secretions, feces, or carcasses; the disease is highly contagious and can affect mammals and rarely humans in direct contact with contaminated animals. As of March 2026, 188 occurrences are recorded: 173 in wild birds, 14 in backyard/subsistence farms, and one outbreak in a commercial farm detected May 15, 2025, which caused temporary poultry import restrictions later lifted after resolution. The Federal Laboratory of Agricultural Defense confirmed the virus in analyses in late February 2026. In Rio Grande do Sul, 15 birds died this month, mostly mute swans at Estação Ecológica do Taim, which is temporarily closed. Authorities stress no risk to chicken meat or eggs, and surveillance remains intensified to prevent spread to commercial farms.

triage.headline_ja: 農業省が鳥インフルエンザによる緊急事態の延長を発表
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルで鳥インフルエンザの広範な流行が続いており、野生鳥類および農場での検出が記録されている。人への感染リスクは低く記載されているが、商業農場での過去の発生と広範な疫学的背景から、継続的な監視が必要。
triage.notes: 記事は野生鳥類での広範な流行（173件）と農場での限定的な発生（14件+1件）を報告。人への感染は稀であると明記されており、IHR基準による深刻な公衆衛生への影響は認定されない。ただし、継続的な野生鳥類での循環と商業農場への潜在的リスクにより、WPRO基準の「長期曝露」と「流行しやすさ」に該当。政府による緊急事態延長措置と監視強化が実施されているため、社会的・政治的関心は高い。

article.articleHeadline: SUS vai oferecer teste rápido para diagnóstico da dengue
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: SUS will offer a rapid test for dengue diagnosis.
article.articleSummary: Brazil's Unified Health System (SUS) will begin offering a rapid dengue diagnosis test (NS1) in public health units, via a Health Ministry ordinance published March 26, 2026. The NS1 rapid assay detects the dengue virus protein during the acute phase and is indicated within the first five days of symptom onset; a positive result confirms acute infection, while a negative result does not rule out dengue. Anvisa states NS1 is present across all four dengue serotypes, and availability depends on procurement and distribution by states and municipalities. As of March 10, 2026, Brazil reported 28 dengue deaths this year. Other approved diagnostics include serology (from day 6 of symptoms) to indicate past exposure but limited for serotype differentiation, and RT-PCR, which identifies viral genetic material and can differentiate serotypes with high sensitivity early, though low viral loads may reduce performance.

triage.headline_ja: SUSはデング熱診断のための迅速検査を提供する予定
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルでのデング熱に関する公衆衛生対応（迅速検査導入）の報道であり、異常・予想外性や異常な増加傾向は明確ではないが、既に28人の死亡が報告されており経過観察が必要。
triage.notes: ブラジルのSUS（統一保健制度）がデング熱の迅速診断検査（NS1）を公開保健施設で導入する新しい公衆衛生対策についての記事。2026年3月時点で既に28人の死亡が報告されており、デング熱は流行しやすく継続的な曝露があるが、この記事自体は新規の異常な流行報告ではなく、既存のデング熱対策の強化についての報道である。IHR基準は2つ未満だが、重症度・長期曝露・流行しやすさの複数のスクリーニング基準に該当し、政府の関心も高いため、WATCH判定とする。

article.articleHeadline: HK expert warns of new COVID-19 wave within months
article.articleSummary: As of 26 March 2026, Hong Kong's infectious disease expert Ivan Hung warns of another COVID-19 wave within months as the virus remains a cyclical endemic in the city. Since January 2023, Hong Kong has endured four active cycles, each lasting two to four months. The most recent major peak ran from late March to mid-July last year, producing more than 170 severe cases and over 90 deaths. With eight months elapsed since that cycle ended, Hung cautions a new upswing may be imminent and urges timely uptake of updated vaccines, plus ongoing precautions such as handwashing, ventilation and mask use when symptomatic. A July–August regional online survey of 5,026 people across Hong Kong, Japan, Singapore, South Korea and Taiwan found 46% of Hong Kong respondents infected in the previous 12 months, versus 37% regionally. In Hong Kong, 53% would receive an updated vaccine, 24% would not, 23% undecided; motivators include protecting high-risk family members and avoiding long COVID.

triage.headline_ja: 香港の専門家が数か月以内の新規COVID-19流行を警告
triage.triage_reason: COVID-19の周期的流行警告であり異常性は低い。香港を含む複数地域が対象だが、対象国はChinaのみ該当。情報が予測・警告段階のため、確立した流行事象ではなく経過観察が適切。
triage.notes: 記事は香港の専門家による流行予測警告であり、現在の確立した感染症イベントではなく、将来の周期的流行リスク評価。香港は中国に含められため、対象国リストではChinaのみ該当。社会的・政府的関心は高いが、IHR基準は該当せず、WPROスクリーニング基準は長期曝露と流行しやすさで該当。シグナルとしてのピックアップには至らず、継続監視段階。

article.articleHeadline: 安特羅腸病毒疫苗報捷 | 櫃買動態 | 證券 | 經濟日報
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Antero Enterovirus Vaccine Breakthrough Reported
article.articleSummary: Antero Enterovirus 71 vaccine, from Antero (6564), a subsidiary of Guoguang Biologics, today announced that complete Phase III data from multinational trials have been published by NPJ Vaccines, part of the Nature portfolio. This vaccine, the only EV71 vaccine produced with bioreactor technology, achieved 99.21% efficacy after two doses given 28 days apart in Taiwan and Vietnam. The double-blind, randomized trial enrolled 4,011 children; vaccination reduced EV71-associated hospitalization by 100%. Ongoing follow-up includes a seventh-year Taiwan study to assess durability, and a two-year Vietnam extension showing 100% seroprotection. These results indicate a robust and durable immune response, supporting broad protection against EV71 disease and continued surveillance in both countries.

triage.headline_ja: 安特羅腸病毒71型ワクチンが報捷を報告
triage.triage_reason: 本記事はエンテロウイルス71型ワクチンの臨床試験成功に関するポジティブなニュースであり、感染症の流行・アウトブレイクではなく、医学的な進展報告である。公衆衛生上の緊急事象ではない。
triage.notes: 本イベントは感染症の流行検知ではなく、ワクチン開発の臨床試験成功報告であり、シグナルトリアージの対象外。台湾はBluedotで識別されているが対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。ベトナムはシグナルとしてではなく、試験実施国として列挙。

article.articleHeadline: Surto de doença de Chagas é confirmado em Macapá e mobiliza autoridades de saúde - O Alto Acre
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Chagas disease outbreak confirmed in Macapá and mobilizes health authorities - O Alto Acre
article.articleSummary: As of 26 March 2026, Brazil launches the influenza vaccination campaign (Dia D) across Centro-Oeste, Nordeste, Sudeste and Sul, running to 30 May 2026. Preliminary 2026 data show 14,300 SARI cases and ~840 deaths through March 14, with influenza responsible for about 28.1% of severe cases. The drive prioritizes children 6 months–5 years 11 months 29 days, seniors 60+, and pregnant people. The Ministry distributed 15.7 million doses; states are urged to intensify outreach in first month. The trivalent vaccine protects against A(H1N1) pdm09, A(H3N2), and B/Victoria lineage: A/Missouri/11/2025, A/Singapore/GP20238/2024, and B/Austria/1359417/2021. Dosing for 6 months–8 years depends on vaccination history (one dose if previously vaccinated; two if not, at least four weeks apart). Vaccination may be co-administered with COVID-19 vaccine. Dia D will be observed on Saturday, 28 March 2026, with free vaccination at UBS; DF began 25 March and Rio de Janeiro on 24 March.

triage.headline_ja: シャーガス病の感染拡大がマカパで確認され、保健当局が対応に動く
triage.triage_reason: インフルエンザワクチン接種キャンペーンに関する公式発表が主要内容だが、見出しはシャーガス病の発生を示唆している。記事サマリーの内容と見出しの不一致が存在し、実際の流行リスクイベントの詳細が不明確であるため、継続監視が適切。
triage.notes: 記事見出し（シャーガス病の感染拡大確認）と記事サマリー（インフルエンザワクチン接種キャンペーン）の内容が大きく乖離している。サマリーはブラジル全体でのインフルエンザワクチン接種キャンペーンについて述べており、マカパでのシャーガス病発生は記事本文に詳細が記載されていない可能性が高い。シャーガス病イベント自体の詳細（症例数、死亡者、感染源など）が不明なため、続報による確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: ES entra em alerta para a Síndrome Respiratória Aguda Grave - ES HOJE
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Espírito Santo on high alert for Severe Acute Respiratory Syndrome (SARS) - ES Today
article.articleSummary: Fiocruz warns rising SRAG cases across Brazil as of March 26, 2026, with Espírito Santo among states at alert/high-risk levels; 22 states are in alert/risk in the last two weeks per InfoGripe. Nationally, 24,281 SRAG cases recorded in 2026 to date; 38.9% of tests positive for respiratory viruses, led by rhinovirus (45% of positives), influenza A (27.8%), and RSV (14.6%), with COVID-19 accounting for 9.1% of positives. The surge is driven by influenza A, rhinovirus, and RSV, with the elderly experiencing higher mortality and young children markedly affected by RSV and rhinovirus. In Espírito Santo, hospitalizations have increased due to influenza A and rhinovirus; Vitória, the capital, shows elevated SRAG activity. The trend has persisted for six weeks and spans all regions. Vaccination against influenza is emphasized for vulnerable groups, along with masks, higher-protection respirators (PFF2/N95), and isolation when symptomatic.

triage.headline_ja: エスピリト・サント州、急性呼吸器疾患症候群（SRAG）の警戒を発令
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル全土で複数の呼吸器ウイルス（インフルエンザA、RSV、ライノウイルス）による急性呼吸器疾患症候群（SRAG）の大規模流行が進行中。22州が警戒/リスク状態にあり、高齢者と小児で死亡率が高い。6週間にわたり全地域に拡大している重大な公衆衛生イベント。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはブラジル全土（22州）での急性呼吸器疾患症候群（SRAG）流行を報告している。Fiocruzが警告を発令し、複数の呼吸器ウイルス（特にインフルエンザA、ライノウイルス、RSV）による流行が確認されている。高齢者と小児における重症化・死亡リスクが明記されており、6週間の持続的な増加傾向が見られている。対象国リストに含まれるのはBrazilのみ。

article.articleHeadline: InfoGripe: número de casos de influenza A segue aumentando no Norte, Sudeste e Nordeste | Portal Fiocruz
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: InfoGripe: number of influenza A cases continues to rise in the North, Southeast and Northeast | Portal Fiocruz
article.articleSummary: Fiocruz’s InfoGripe bulletin (published 2026-03-26) reports rising Severe Acute Respiratory Infection (SARI) activity across Brazil through epidemiological week 11 (15–21 March). Influenza A, rhinovirus, and respiratory syncytial virus (RSV) drive the surge. In 2026 to date, 24,281 SARI cases have been reported; 9,443 (38.9%) lab-positive for a respiratory virus, 9,951 (41%) negative, and about 3,085 (12.7%) awaiting results. Twenty-two of 27 state capitals show SARI activity at alert/risk/high risk in the last two weeks, including Rio de Janeiro, Brasília, Belo Horizonte, Fortaleza, Salvador, Recife, Manaus, and Natal. Influenza A growth is ongoing in the Northeast (Maranhão, Piauí, Rio Grande do Norte, Paraíba, Alagoas, Sergipe, Bahia), North (Acre, Rondônia), Southeast (Rio de Janeiro, Espírito Santo), and Mato Grosso, with interruptions in Pará, Ceará, Pernambuco. RSV rises in children under 2 in the North, Northeast, and Central-West; metapneumovirus elevates SARI in DF and Minas Gerais. Rhinovirus dominates in children/adolescents; influenza A in younger adults and older adults. In the last four weeks, positives: 45% rhinovirus, 27.8% influenza A, 14.6% RSV, 9.1% SARS-CoV-2, 1.4% influenza B; deaths: 35.9% influenza A, 29.1% SARS-CoV-2, 27.2% rhinovirus, 5.8% RSV, 2.9% influenza B. Public health guidance emphasizes influenza vaccination for high-risk groups, masking in crowded indoor settings, home isolation when symptomatic, and using PFF2/N95 if leaving the home. The SUS-SARI surveillance informs targeted actions across prioritized regions.

triage.headline_ja: InfoGripe: インフルエンザAの症例数は北部、南東部、北東部で増加し続けている | Fiocruz ポータル
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル全土で複数の呼吸器ウイルス（インフルエンザA、RSV、メタニューモウイルス）による重症急性呼吸器感染症(SARI)の広範な流行が確認されており、IHR基準の「異常・予想外」および「公衆衛生への深刻な影響」に該当。WPROスクリーニング基準でも複数基準該当。
triage.notes: 2026年第11週（3月15-21日）時点での報告。24,281件のSARI症例中、38.9%が呼吸器ウイルス陽性。27州都のうち22州でアラート/リスク/高リスク段階のSARI活動を観察。インフルエンザA、RSV、メタニューモウイルス、ライノウイルスが同時流行。死亡者の35.9%がインフルエンザA関連。Fiocruzの公式surveillance報告であり信頼性が高い。

article.articleHeadline: अमेरिका समेत 20 से ज्यादा देशों में फिर बढ़ रहे कोरोना के केस, क्या है वेरिएंट BA.3.2
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: COVID-19 cases are rising again in more than 20 countries, including the United States; what is the BA.3.2 variant?
article.articleSummary: COVID-19 cases are rising again in more than 20 countries, including the United States, driven by the SARS-CoV-2 BA.3.2 variant now spreading in the U.S. The CDC notes this lineage is gaining footholds, with about 75 mutations on the spike protein, potentially aiding immune evasion and reactivation. BA.3.2 is not new; it was detected in South Africa in 2024 before re-emerging in the United States. In India, current cases are not linked to BA.3.2, and vaccination coverage is high, with symptoms typically mild. There are no mandatory mask guidelines, but health experts advise mask use in crowded places, hospitals, and public transport to reduce transmission and protect against other respiratory illnesses. Regarding vaccines, widespread vaccination persists; boosters may not be urgently required as vaccines help prevent severe disease even if infection occurs. Ongoing outbreaks in other countries remain a concern.

triage.headline_ja: アメリカを含む20以上の国でCOVID-19症例が再び増加、BA.3.2変異株とは何か
triage.triage_reason: COVID-19の既知変異株（BA.3.2）による複数国での症例増加を報告しているが、インドでは現在BA.3.2と関連がなく、予防接種カバレッジが高く症状は軽度であり、新たな公衆衛生危機の兆候は限定的。情報不足により経過観察段階が適切。
triage.notes: 発生地域にはUSAと南アフリカも含まれているが、評価対象国（WPRO対象国リスト）の中でインドのみが該当する。記事サマリーではインドでの現在の症例がBA.3.2と関連がないこと、ワクチン接種カバレッジが高いこと、症状が軽度であることが明記されており、重大なリスクは認識されていない。既知のCOVID-19変異株の報告であり、従来と同様の対応体制の枠内と考えられる。

article.articleHeadline: Macaé aperta o cerco contra a dengue e mobiliza bairros com ações até sexta
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Macaé steps up the fight against dengue and mobilizes neighborhoods with actions until Friday.
article.articleSummary: As of 26 March 2026, Macaé, Brazil, is intensifying dengue vector control with a citywide task force conducting mutirões de limpeza (cleanup sweeps), fumacê (fogging), ovitrampas (ovitrapping), and removal of water-holding materials to curb Aedes aegypti breeding. Targeted neighborhoods include Miramar, Parque Valentina Miranda, Virgem Santa, Imbetiba, Horto, Imboassica, Parque Aeroporto, and Lagomar I, with emphasis on canals for Culex control. Fogging occurs in early mornings; rodent control is pursued in critical points. The plan, coordinated by the Environmental Surveillance Management, also features school activities with puppet-based education to promote household action. Ongoing epidemiological monitoring guides deployments. The actions run through Friday, 27 March 2026. Public participation is essential; residents can report concerns via the municipal channel. No dengue case counts or laboratory confirmations are reported in the article.

triage.headline_ja: マカエが出血熱に対する取り組みを強化し、金曜日までの行動で地区を動員
triage.triage_reason: デング熱の既知流行地における予防的ベクトル対策報道。具体的な症例数や重症度情報がなく、IHR基準・WPRO基準の判定に必要な情報が不足している。
triage.notes: 記事はマカエ市による積極的なデング媒介蚊対策の実施報告であり、既知流行地における通常の公衆衛生対応を述べている。症例数、死亡、重症患者数の報告がないため、イベントの健康インパクト評価ができない。デング流行地における予防活動としては期待される対応であり、国際的拡大やIHR通知基準は該当しない。ただし、マカエがデング流行下にあることが暗示されており、続報で症例増加が報告される可能性があるため、経過観察推奨。

article.articleHeadline: Ho Chi Minh City: This outbreak has caused over 8,000 cases, and 3 children have died.
article.articleSummary: Ho Chi Minh City reports a severe hand, foot, and mouth disease outbreak driven by EV71. By 26 March 2026, total cases reach 8,152 with 3 deaths; week 12 (Mar 16–22) saw 858 new cases, up 66.9% from the four-week average. EV71 accounts for up to 25% of samples, signaling high virulence and risk of severe complications in children under 5. There are 288 outbreaks (162 in schools, 126 in the community), with hot spots in Con Dao, Long Dien, and Long Huong. A citywide red alert is active; HCDC coordinates with ward stations to contain spread, focusing on preschools, daycare centers, and social welfare facilities. Schools are urged to maintain hygiene, ensure handwashing facilities, and promptly report suspicious symptoms. Grade 2b+ cases must be identified and reported via the health management platform. Prevention emphasizes 'three clean' practices: clean food/drink, clean living environment, and clean hands/toys; fever or mouth ulcers require prompt medical care. Major hospitals will train and support neighboring provinces Ba Ria-Vung Tau and Binh Duong.

triage.headline_ja: ホーチミン市：この流行は8,000例以上を引き起こし、3人の子どもが死亡した
triage.triage_reason: EV71による手足口病の大規模流行で8,152例、死亡3例が報告されており、IHR基準（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）を複数満たす。WPROスクリーニング基準でも重症度と流行可能性が高い。
triage.notes: EV71（エンテロウイルス71型）による手足口病の大規模流行。8,152例、死亡3例、週単位での新規患者増加率66.9%、EV71が検査サンプルの25%を占める。288の発生地点（学校162、地域コミュニティ126）。5歳未満の小児における重症合併症のリスクが高い。ホーチミン市全体で赤色警報が発令されており、隣接する州（バリア-ブンタウ、ビンズオン）への拡大支援体制構築中。

article.articleHeadline: SUS passa a oferecer teste rápido para diagnóstico da dengue em todo o país
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: SUS Begins Offering Rapid Diagnostic Test for Dengue Nationwide.
article.articleSummary: Brazil’s Health Ministry expands the SUS to offer rapid dengue diagnosis nationwide. The NS1 antigen rapid test, using immunochromatography, is now available at public clinics and hospitals and is free in SUS facilities; private pharmacies charge around R$40. The test uses a finger-prick blood sample, delivers results in minutes, and detects dengue early (a few days after symptom onset) to aid clinical management and monitor warning signs such as thrombocytopenia and risk of severe disease. It does not identify the virus serotype nor indicate prior dengue infection, and it should not replace medical evaluation. Eligible for patients of all ages; requests can be made by doctors, nurses, biomedical scientists, and nursing technicians. Published March 26, 2026, the measure aims to improve dengue surveillance and monitor viral circulation nationwide.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジルの公衆衛生システムが全国でデング熱の迅速診断検査を提供開始
triage.triage_reason: 本記事はブラジル政府による診断検査の公開施設への展開を報じたもので、新規の感染症アウトブレイクや緊急事態ではなく、既存疾患への対応能力の拡大である。IHR基準およびWPRO基準の該当基準なし。
triage.notes: 記事は診断検査能力の拡大という公衆衛生政策ニュースであり、新規感染症イベント（アウトブレイク）ではない。デング熱はブラジルで既知の風土病であり、本記事に含まれるSFTS Virusはサマリーに全く言及されていないため、関連性が不明。シグナルトリアージの対象外。

article.articleHeadline: TP.HCM: Dịch bệnh này bùng phát gây hơn 8.000 ca mắc, đã có 3 trẻ không qua khỏi
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ho Chi Minh City: This disease outbreak has broken out, causing more than 8,000 cases, and 3 children have died.
article.articleSummary: Hand, Foot and Mouth Disease (HFMD) outbreak in Ho Chi Minh City is accelerating, driven by the highly virulent Enterovirus 71 (EV71). As of 26 March 2026, the city has 8,152 cumulative HFMD cases this year, with 858 new cases in week 12 (16–22 March), up 66.9% from the prior four weeks. EV71 accounts for about 25% of samples, linked to severe disease and deaths; three children have died. Symptoms include fever and mouth ulcers. A total of 288 outbreak clusters have been identified—162 in schools and 126 in the community—triggering a citywide red alert. Authorities tighten control around schools and social-care facilities, enforce hygiene, handwashing, and rapid reporting. Major hospitals (Children’s, Nhi Dong 1 & 2) will coordinate care and support neighboring provinces Ba Ria-Vung Tau and Binh Duong; lab confirmation is required for cases 2b+ with continuous reporting on a health-management platform. Hotspots include Con Dao, Long Dien, and Long Huong.

triage.headline_ja: ホーチミン市：この感染症の大流行により8,000以上の症例が発生し、3人の子どもが死亡
triage.triage_reason: 手足口病（HFMD）の多数の死亡を含む重大な流行が確認され、IHR基準3つ以上に該当。EV71による重症化と死亡、学校を含む288のクラスター、および地域的な急速な増加が認められ、シグナルとしてピックアップが妥当。
triage.notes: ホーチミン市で手足口病（HFMD）の大規模流行が進行中。EV71（エンテロウイルス71）が重症化・死亡に関連。週単位で66.9%の増加率、学校を含む288のクラスター、3人の死亡が報告されており、深刻な公衆衛生上の懸念がある。隣接するバリア-ブンタウ州とビンズオン省への地域的拡大の可能性も示唆されている。

article.articleHeadline: SUS incorpora teste rápido para diagnóstico de dengue - Jornal de Brasília
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: SUS incorporates rapid diagnostic test for dengue - Jornal de Brasília
article.articleSummary: Brazil's Ministry of Health has incorporated the rapid dengue NS1 test into the Unified Health System (SUS) for early diagnosis. Published in the Diário Oficial da União on 26 March 2026, the NS1 test is now widely available in public clinics and hospitals. Doctors, nurses, biomedical scientists, and nursing technicians can request it for patients of all ages. Unlike antibody tests, NS1 detects dengue virus NS1 antigen in the first days after symptom onset, using a finger-prick blood sample with immunochromatography; results are available in minutes. The test is free through SUS; private sector price averages around R$40. It does not identify dengue serotypes or past infections. Early diagnosis enables monitoring warning signs such as thrombocytopenia and risk of progression to dengue hemorrhagic fever, and enhances surveillance. Classic dengue symptoms include abrupt high fever (39-40°C), intense headache behind the eyes, myalgias, arthralgias, prostration, nausea, vomiting, rash, and abdominal pain.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジルSUSがデング熱の迅速診断検査を導入
triage.triage_reason: 本記事はブラジルの公衆衛生システムにデング熱迅速診断検査が導入されたことについての政策ニュースであり、新規感染症の探知やアウトブレイク報告ではない。IHR基準およびスクリーニング基準に該当しない。
triage.notes: 本記事は診断技術の行政導入に関する政策ニュースであり、感染症アウトブレイク、異常な症例増加、または新規感染症の報告ではない。デング熱の流行が起きているという情報は記事サマリーには含まれていない。シグナルトリアージの対象外。

article.articleHeadline: В Италии выявлен первый в Европе случай заражения человека птичьим гриппом
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In Italy, Europe's first case of human infection with avian influenza has been detected.
article.articleSummary: Europe's first human case of avian influenza A(H9N2) has been detected in Lombardy, Italy. The patient, who arrived from a country outside Europe, is hospitalized. Italian Ministry of Health and Euronews report rapid testing and contact tracing under routine surveillance. The ECDC notes that from 1998 through 27 February 2026, 195 human cases of A(H9N2) have been recorded in ten Asian and African countries. No clusters and no evidence of sustained human-to-human transmission have been observed; infections typically result from direct contact with infected poultry or contaminated environments. The latest ECDC/EFSA monitoring (29 November 2025–27 February 2026) recorded 10 human avian influenza cases: Cambodia (one A(H5N1)) and China (eight A(H9N2), one A(H10N3)); none fatal. Ongoing vigilance for zoonotic spillover remains essential.

triage.headline_ja: イタリアでヨーロッパ初のヒト鳥インフルエンザ感染例が検出
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ以上該当（重篤な公衆衛生影響、予想外の初症例、国際的拡大リスク）。ヨーロッパでの初のH9N2ヒト感染例で、医学的・公衆衛生学的に重要なシグナル。
triage.notes: イタリアはEU圏であり直接的な対象国ではないため verified_locations には含めず。記事サマリーに明記されたCambodia（H5N1 1例）とChina（H9N2 8例、H10N3 1例）のみを検証対象として列挙。世界的な鳥インフルエンザ監視の観点からは重要な発展であり、継続的な情報収集が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Teste rápido para dengue entra no SUS e amplia diagnóstico precoce
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Rapid test for dengue enters the SUS and broadens early diagnosis.
article.articleSummary: Dengue rapid test NS1 antigen integrated into Brazil's Unified Health System (SUS) on March 26, 2026, after Diário Oficial da União publication. The immunochromatography-based assay detects dengue NS1 antigen in blood during the first days of illness, enabling rapid confirmation within minutes. The test, available in public health units including basic health clinics, outpatient centers, and hospitals, can be requested by doctors, nurses, or biomedical professionals and is accessible to patients of all ages at no direct cost. Early diagnosis supports patient management and monitoring of viral circulation to inform control measures. Rollout will be gradual, prioritizing periods of higher dengue incidence and depending on local health service organization.

triage.headline_ja: デング熱の迅速検査がブラジルの国民統一保健制度（SUS）に導入され、早期診断が拡大
triage.triage_reason: 本記事はブラジルにおける診断ツール（迅速検査）の保健制度への導入に関する行政ニュースであり、新規の感染症アウトブレイク・緊急事態ではない。IHR基準およびWPRO基準に該当せず、シグナルとしては識別されない。
triage.notes: 記事はブラジルのデング熱診断基盤の強化に関する政策実装である。既存疾患の検査能力向上であり、新規のアウトブレイクやシグナルではない。政府の関心はあるが、公衆衛生危機を示唆する内容ではない。

article.articleHeadline: Chikungunya avança por MS e morte de idoso é confirmada em Bonito
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Chikungunya advances through Mato Grosso do Sul and the death of an elderly man is confirmed in Bonito.
article.articleSummary: Bonito, Mato Grosso do Sul, Brazil, reports 57 confirmed and 74 suspected chikungunya cases. A 72-year-old man died on March 19, the sixth chikungunya death in Mato Grosso do Sul in 2026, per the state health department (SES). Dourados faces elevated transmission in its Indigenous reserves. Bonito will intensify vector control, starting fumacê (fogging) citywide. Since January 2026, six MS deaths are linked to chikungunya, five from Indigenous villages in Dourados: a 69-year-old woman (Jaguapiru Indigenous Village, Feb 26); a 73-year-old man (Jaguapiru, Mar 9); a 3-month-old infant (Bororó Indigenous Village, Mar 10); a 60-year-old woman (Jaguapiru, Mar 12); and a 1-month-old infant (Jaguapiru, Mar 24). Municipal, state, and federal authorities monitor the situation; the state government already calls it an epidemic. Chikungunya is transmitted by Aedes aegypti.

triage.headline_ja: チクングニア熱がマットグロッソドスル州を進む、ボニート市で高齢男性の死亡が確認
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3項目該当（重大な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）、死亡例を含む重症例発生、Indigenous村での死亡集中など管理可能性の懸念があり、フルRRA進行が必要。
triage.notes: ブラジル・マットグロッソドスル州におけるチクングニア熱の活動的な流行。2026年1月以降6死亡例（うち5例がDourados市のIndigenous村）、57確定例、74疑い例。特にIndigenous人口での死亡が集中しており、公衆衛生上の懸念が高い。州政府はすでに流行宣言している。

article.articleHeadline: Gánh nặng bệnh lao cao nhất cả nước, TPHCM siết quản lý, tăng tốc kiểm soát lao
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The country’s highest tuberculosis burden; Ho Chi Minh City tightens management, accelerates tuberculosis control.
article.articleSummary: Ho Chi Minh City remains Vietnam's TB burden leader. In 2025 the city detected and treated 20,522 TB cases, about 17.3% of national total. TB is airborne; without timely detection a patient can infect 10–15 others annually. Vietnam reports about 184,000 new TB cases and 12,000 deaths per year. City treatment success is around 90%, but new case detection is just above 60%, indicating missed transmission sources. Authorities cite uneven primary care, only about 30% of health stations meeting standards, and workforce shortages. To reverse, the city proposes proactive, integrated TB control: reorganize the network with clear roles; scale up active community screening, especially for high-risk groups (HIV, diabetes, elderly, crowded environments); integrate with routine health checks and health insurance; expand private sector participation; apply AI chest X-ray reading and digital data integration; secure MOH guidance and funding; emphasize public awareness. Early detection and treatment can control and end TB.

triage.headline_ja: 全国で最も高い結核負担、ホーチミン市は管理を厳格化し、結核対策の加速化を進める
triage.triage_reason: 結核とHIVの重複感染が地域的課題として述べられており、ベトナムは公衆衛生上の懸念があるが、現在のところ異常事象や国際的拡大の直接的な証拠に欠ける。継続的な対策と検出率改善の動向を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 結核は既知の風土病であり急性の異常事象ではないが、ホーチミン市における疾病負担（全国の17.3%）の高さ、治療成功率90%に対し新規患者検出率が60%強に留まる点、HIV合併症の高リスク集団の存在から、公衆衛生上の重要性は高い。ただしIHR基準の2つ以上該当には至らず、WPROスクリーニング基準は複数該当するもイベント性が限定的であるためWATCHとした。当局による対策強化の成果を継続監視すべき。

article.articleHeadline: Prefeitura inicia aplicação de fumacê nesta quinta-feira (26) para combater o Aedes aegypti em Bonito - Prefeitura Municipal de Bonito
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: City Hall begins fogging application this Thursday (26) to combat Aedes aegypti in Bonito - Bonito Municipal City Hall
article.articleSummary: From Thursday, March 26, 2026, Bonito, Brazil launches insecticide fogging (fumacê) across all neighborhoods to reduce Aedes aegypti adults, the mosquito that transmits dengue, Zika, and chikungunya. The city aims to lower female mosquito populations to cut transmission risk. Residents are advised to keep doors and windows open during fumigation to allow interior reach, though weather can affect performance; rain, strong winds, or mist may delay or suspend spraying. Spraying occurs in early morning and late afternoon. The administration emphasizes that fumigation is a supplementary measure and community participation is essential: eliminate standing water and keep yards clean to enhance control. Awareness of disease symptoms is provided: dengue—high fever, headaches, body and joint pains, skin rash; Zika—lower fever, itchiness, rash, red eyes; chikungunya—severe joint pain, fever, fatigue. Seek health care promptly if symptoms appear.

triage.headline_ja: ボニート市が蚊対策の燻蒸を開始 - ブラジル・ボニート市
triage.triage_reason: 蚊媒介感染症（デング熱、ジカ熱、チクングニア熱）に対する既知の予防的害虫駆除活動であり、新規発生イベントや異常な病原体の出現ではない。死亡や重症化の報告なく、公衆衛生への深刻な影響を示す情報もない。
triage.notes: 記事は定期的な害虫駆除活動の報告であり、感染症の新規発生やアウトブレイク、異常な疾病パターンを示唆していない。ルーチンの公衆衛生対策として分類される。

article.articleHeadline: Sempat Muncul 17 Kasus, Dinkes Kota Malang Pastikan Tren Campak Kini Melandai
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: As Many as 17 Cases Emerged, Malang City Health Office Confirms Measles Trend Is Now Waning.
article.articleSummary: Measles in Malang City, East Java, Indonesia is waning after 17 confirmed cases earlier in 2026. As of 26 March 2026, all 17 patients have recovered; daily reports from puskesmas in five districts show no new cases or hospitalizations due to complications. Outbreak Response Immunization (ORI) mass vaccination and catch-up immunization targeted children missing basic vaccination, aiding control. Health authorities urge maintaining herd immunity above 95% via Measles-Rubella (MR) vaccination to prevent severe outcomes such as pneumonia and encephalitis. National data indicate rising measles in parts of East Java, but Malang City’s strengthened surveillance aims to prevent a secondary outbreak (KLB). Residents are advised to maintain good hygiene and promptly report high fever with a red rash to health facilities.

triage.headline_ja: 17症例が出現したが、マラン市保健局は麻疹トレンドが現在収まっていることを確認
triage.triage_reason: インドネシア（マラン市）での麻疹アウトブレイク（17症例）の報告であり、WPRO基準の「異常/予想外」「重症度」「流行しやすさ」に該当する可能性があるが、患者全員が回復済み、新規症例なし、制御傾向にあるため、現在のリスクは限定的。継続的な監視が必要。
triage.notes: 麻疹（17症例）とともに風疹・不明性脳炎が記載されているが、記事サマリーの主焦点は麻疹である。全患者回復済み、新規症例なし、予防接種キャンペーン進行中と報告されており、現在の流行リスクは低い。ただし東ジャワ全域での麻疹増加傾向が指摘されているため、地域的な監視継続の必要性あり。

article.articleHeadline: Xuất hiện ca viêm màng não do não mô cầu tại TP.HCM
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A case of meningococcal meningitis in Ho Chi Minh City.
article.articleSummary: Ho Chi Minh City reports a case of meningococcal meningitis in a 21-year-old male student who studied online at the University of Transportation. Onset was 9 March; he was admitted 10 March to Gia Dinh Hospital and then transferred on 11 March to the City’s Tropical Diseases Hospital, where he remains in stable condition. One case was recorded in Bình Lợi Trung Ward during 9–15 March. The patient had not been vaccinated against Neisseria meningitidis. Two cohabitants received single-dose Ciprofloxacin prophylaxis; close contacts are monitored for 10 days. Authorities warn that meningococcal meningitis is rapid and potentially fatal without timely treatment. Prophylaxis within 24–48 hours post-exposure is advised for close contacts. Vaccination remains the most effective prevention, with vaccines for serogroups A, C, Y, W and B; MOH calls for enhanced surveillance to prevent spread.

triage.headline_ja: ホーチミン市で髄膜炎菌性髄膜炎の症例が報告
triage.triage_reason: 髄膜炎菌性髄膜炎は重篤な疾患であり、スクリーニング基準で異常性・重症度・流行性が認められるが、現時点では単発例報告であり、公衆衛生への深刻な影響や国際的拡大リスクが明確でない。継続的な情報収集が必要。
triage.notes: 単一症例の報告。患者は予防接種未実施であり、濃厚接触者への予防投与と10日間の監視が実施されている。当局は監視強化を呼び掛けている。国内の疾病監視体制により対応可能と判断される。続報により流行状況の把握が重要。

article.articleHeadline: Bệnh lao chưa hạ nhiệt, TP.HCM là tâm điểm
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Tuberculosis hasn't cooled down yet, Ho Chi Minh City is the focal point.
article.articleSummary: As of 26 March 2026, tuberculosis remains a major burden in Vietnam, with Ho Chi Minh City (HCMC) as the national hotspot. HCMC accounts for about 20% of all TB cases, with the southern region bearing roughly 60% of the national burden. Vietnam remains among the world’s 30 highest TB burden countries, ranking 12th in incidence and 10th in drug-resistant TB. In 2025, the National TB Program detected over 119,000 cases (about 63% of community estimates). HCMC detected and treated 20,522 cases in 2025, equal to 17.3% of national cases and 29% of the southern region. Transmission is airborne; an untreated patient can infect 10–15 people per year. Treatment success at the primary level reached 90.4%, with 78%+ for drug-resistant TB and mortality under 3%. Challenges include screening gaps, coordination inefficiencies, and low frontline capacity, prompting policy and financing improvements and expanded screening.

triage.headline_ja: 結核はまだ収束していない、ホーチミン市が焦点
triage.triage_reason: ベトナムにおける結核の継続的な高負担が報告されているが、新規アウトブレイク、急激な増加、または国際的拡大の具体的な証拠がない。既知の地域的課題の更新報告と評価される。
triage.notes: 結核は既知の風土病であり、記事は継続的な疾病負担と政策対応についての状況報告である。IHR基準では異常性・予想外性に欠けるが、WPROスクリーニング基準では複数項目に該当する。情報不足で国際的拡大リスクの有無が不明であるため、WATCHレベルとした。

article.articleHeadline: Unión Africana: RDC encabeza contagios y muertes por sarampión, mpox y cólera
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: African Union: DRC leads in infections and deaths from measles, mpox, and cholera.
article.articleSummary: DRC leads Africa in infections and deaths from measles, mpox, and cholera. Measles: 364 deaths this year (1% case-fatality); outbreaks across all provinces, greatest in North and South Kivu amid conflict, with overcrowded camps and poor sanitation hindering vaccination. Cholera: 8,170 cases and 72 deaths in the DRC; with Mozambique, they account for about 83% of Africa’s cases and 86% of deaths year-to-date; 21 of 26 provinces affected; CFR 2.79%. Main drivers are lack of safe water and weak WASH in IDP camps and seasonal flooding. Vaccination is being pursued, including preventive and reactive campaigns in Kinshasa, with expansion planned to Kampemba, Kirula, and Manika. Mpox: 37,069 cases and 127 deaths in the DRC since year start; 19 deaths and 1,087 cases this week; CFR 1.7% and 62% test positivity, signaling surveillance gaps. Symptoms include fever, rash, and swollen lymph nodes; high-risk groups include children and immunocompromised.

triage.headline_ja: アフリカ連合：DRC（コンゴ民主共和国）が麻疹、mpox、コレラの感染と死亡数で主導
triage.triage_reason: DRCで3つの重大な感染症（麻疹、mpox、コレラ）が同時に流行。IHR基準4つすべてに該当し、複数の重症例・死亡、国際的な関心、多国間に波及する可能性が確認される。
triage.notes: DRCが記事の中心。Mpox 37,069症例（127死亡）、コレラ8,170症例（72死亡）、麻疹364死亡。DRCとモザンビークで現在のアフリカのコレラ症例の83%を占める。IDP キャンプでの過密、WASH不足、紛争地域での接種困難が主要な推進因子。フィリピンはManika（Western Visayas）がBluedot APIで検出されているが、記事本文ではフィリピンの具体的な事例に言及がないため、DRCが主要な検証対象地域であり、フィリピンはセカンダリーとして扱うが、APIデータに含まれているため記載している。Mozambique（対象国リストにないため除外）もコレラで大きく影響されている。

article.articleHeadline: Chikungunya: Salud insta a reforzar la prevención ante un incremento del 43% de casos
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Chikungunya: Health Ministry urges strengthening of prevention in light of a 43% increase in cases.
article.articleSummary: Chikungunya in Salta Province, Argentina, shows a 43% week-on-week rise to 322 confirmed and 19 probable cases (225 prior week). The north is hit: San Martín 238 cases (Salvador Mazza 211), Orán 55 (Aguas Blancas 36; San Ramón de la Nueva Orán 19); Rosario de Lerma and Rosario de la Frontera 1 each. Local transmission is confirmed; officials say mobility during the holiday drove the increase. All cases have favorable evolution with no severe hospitalizations. Prevention includes binational border operations with Bolivia (Salta–Yacuiba) and Aguas Blancas–Bermejo, fever surveillance, and vector control using biolarvicides. In Anta, notification and training were strengthened. Community measures: eliminate breeding sites, clean patios, use repellents, wear light clothing, and install screens. Nationally: 2,701 suspected; 103 confirmed/probable; imported cases linked to travel to Bolivia, Brazil, Paraguay, Cuba. Local transmission in Yerba Buena, Tucumán, and Santiago del Estero Capital. OPS notes Bolivia and Brazil remain most affected region."}

triage.headline_ja: チクングニア熱：ケース数の43％増加に対し、保健当局が予防強化を促進
triage.triage_reason: アルゼンチン（対象国外）での発生だが、ブラジルとボリビアでの流行が関連し、国際的な地域的拡大リスクが高い。WPROスクリーニング基準の複数項目（異常性、長期曝露リスク、流行可能性）に該当し、段階的に局所伝播が拡大中で、越境対策が実施されている状況から、地域的な関心と支援が必要と判断される。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はアルゼンチンのサルタ州でのチクングニア熱の流行であるが、対象国リストに含まれていない。ただし、ブラジル（3469034）とボリビアへの関連言及があり、記事内でブラジルが最も影響を受けた地域として明記されている（「OPS notes Bolivia and Brazil remain most affected region」）。ボリビアは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。越境対策（ボリビア・アルゼンチン間）が実施されており、地域的な感染症危機として関心が高い。

article.articleHeadline: Ministry Intensifies Border Measures as FMD Risk Remains High - Africa Newswire
article.articleSummary: Foot and Mouth Disease (FMD) risk remains high in the region as Namibia tightens border controls after a 11 March import ban from Botswana. The Ministry of Agriculture, Water and Land Reform has expanded vehicle searches and manpower at border posts, with veterinary officials patrolling to ensure 100% compliance and curb illegal animal movement. The risk to Namibia’s export markets in the European Union and China is described as eminent. Actions follow the Animal Health Act 1 of 2011 and World Organisation for Animal Health standards. The FMD Support Fund has been launched but not yet utilised; planned use targets veterinary fence maintenance/upgrades, disinfection facilities, awareness materials, and other preventive activities. Farmers are urged to adhere to movement restrictions, maintain farm biosecurity, monitor for clinical signs, and report suspicious movements or signs to the nearest veterinary office immediately.

triage.headline_ja: FMDリスク高止まりで農業省が国境措置を強化 - アフリカニューズワイヤー
triage.triage_reason: 口蹄疫は家畜感染症であり、公開されたサマリーではヒト感染事例やヒト-ヒト感染のリスクについて記載されていない。IHR(2005)は動物由来感染症のヒトへの越境リスクを重視するが、本記事は動物貿易制限と国内予防措置に焦点を当てており、公衆衛生上の深刻性が不明である。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はナミビアとボツワナ間の動物由来感染症(FMD)であり、対象国リストではChinaのみが該当する。Chinaについても輸出市場先としての言及であり、実際の発生地ではない。口蹄疫は動物感染症であり、IHR通知基準には一般的に該当しにくい。公衆衛生学的な深刻性の記載がなく、シグナルトリアージの段階では見送りが適切と判断される。

article.articleHeadline: SUS passa a oferecer teste rápido para diagnóstico da dengue em todo o país | O Imparcial
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: SUS Begins Offering Rapid Diagnostic Test for Dengue Nationwide
article.articleSummary: Brazil’s Ministry of Health has integrated the Dengue NS1 rapid diagnostic test into the SUS nationwide, effective from 26 March 2026 (Diário Oficial da União). The assay will be available in SUS clinics, basic health units, and hospitals and can be requested by doctors, nurses, biomedical professionals and nursing technicians for patients of all ages. The NS1 immunochromatography test detects dengue virus antigen in the early days of illness, enabling diagnosis during initial symptoms such as high fever (39–40°C), severe headache and body aches. Early detection supports more efficient patient monitoring, faster recognition of warning signs like thrombocytopenia, and strengthened epidemiological surveillance of dengue circulation, while not identifying the virus serotype or prior infection. Provided free through SUS; private pharmacies report about R$40. The test does not replace clinical assessment.

triage.headline_ja: SUSが全国でデング熱の迅速診断検査の提供を開始
triage.triage_reason: 記事はブラジルの公衆衛生システムにおける診断検査ツールの導入に関する行政通知であり、新規の感染症アウトブレイクや異常事象ではない。疾患の流行自体についての情報がなく、社会的関心も限定的である。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はデング熱の診断検査ツール（NS1迅速検査）の公衆衛生システムへの統合である。これは感染症イベント（アウトブレイク、異常発生、重症化など）ではなく、既知疾患に対する検査インフラの拡充に関する行政措置である。Bluedotが付与した地域情報（Sus、Azerbaijan）はサマリー内容に反映されておらず、実際の発生地域はブラジルのみ。

article.articleSummary: Foot-and-mouth disease outbreak on the Greek island of Lesbos prompts strict containment and international trade restrictions. Greece reported the first infected animal earlier this month; by March 25, 13 cases were confirmed, with about 3,000 animals slated for euthanization. Special zones have been established; veterinary teams are testing 60 farms within a 3-km radius of the initial case, with results expected soon. The outbreak threatens Easter sales of around 70,000 lambs and kids.
