article.articleHeadline: Crecen los casos de fiebre chikungunya en Argentina: hay dos casos sopechosos en San Juan
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Chikungunya Fever Cases on the Rise in Argentina: There Are Two Suspected Cases in San Juan
article.articleSummary: Chikungunya fever cases are rising in Argentina, including two suspected cases in San Juan. In Buenos Aires Province, Lomas de Zamora reports an autochthonous outbreak; the index case was notified March 12 (SE 10) and a woman with symptoms March 5 tested positive by molecular methods in Buenos Aires City. Epidemiological surveys found ten additional symptomatic residents, seven testing positive. National Epidemiological Bulletin reports 3,202 suspected nationwide through March 14, with 199 confirmed or probable. Salta Province lists 225 positives as of March 18. Most imported cases had recent travel to Bolivia, Brazil, Paraguay, and Cuba, noted mainly in Buenos Aires City, Buenos Aires province, Córdoba, and San Luis. Autochthonous transmission is confirmed in Salta, Santiago del Estero, and Tucumán, including two locally confirmed cases in Yerba Buena, Tucumán (SE8/2026). In the past two weeks, cases without travel history have appeared in Jujuy, Catamarca, Santiago del Estero, and Buenos Aires.

triage.headline_ja: チクングニア熱がアルゼンチンで増加：サンファンで2件の疑い症例
triage.triage_reason: チクングニア熱の大規模流行がアルゼンチン全域で報告されており、IHR基準の「公衆衛生への影響は深刻」「異常・予想外」「国際的拡大リスク」の3基準に該当。多数の地域での二次感染確認とその他の基準から、フルRRA進行が必須。
triage.notes: 発生地域にブラジルが含まれ、記事サマリーでもボリビア、ブラジル、パラグアイ、キューバからの輸入事例が報告されている。ただし、対象国リスト内ではブラジルのみ該当。アルゼンチンはWPROスクリーニング基準5項目すべてに該当する重要なシグナルだが、対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations には含まない。記事は西半球での重要な流行を示唆しており、国際的なレベルでの警戒が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Ministério incorpora teste rápido para diagnóstico de dengue ao SUS
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ministry incorporates rapid diagnostic test for dengue into SUS.
article.articleSummary: Dengue rapid diagnostic test incorporated into Brazil's Unified Health System (SUS) and published in the Diário Oficial on 2026-03-26. The rapid test is now widely available in public health ambulatory posts and hospitals; requests can be made by physicians, nurses, biomedical scientists, and nursing technicians for patients of all ages. The test enables rapid dengue identification within the first days of symptom onset (high fever, body aches, malaise), offering earlier diagnosis than serology, which typically becomes positive after about day 6. The rapid test does not detect dengue viral serotypes nor indicate prior infection. A small finger-prick blood sample is required; no fasting or special preparation is needed. This measure improves access to dengue diagnosis across Brazil’s public health network; the article does not report case counts, outbreaks, or infection sources.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジル保健省、デング熱の迅速診断検査をSUS（統一保健制度）に導入
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は新しい診断検査ツールの導入に関する行政措置の報道であり、デング熱の流行・アウトブレイク、または感染症危機を示す情報を含まない。症例数、発生源、異常な疾病パターンなどの公衆衛生上の懸念要素がない。
triage.notes: 本記事はデング熱の診断検査方法改善に関する保健行政のニュースであり、感染症シグナルではない。疾病監視・早期警戒システムの強化という肯定的な公衆衛生活動として理解される。

article.articleHeadline: Com 414 fiscalizações, Adapar finaliza operação contra influenza aviária no Litoral
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: With 414 inspections, Adapar ends operation against avian influenza on the coast.
article.articleSummary: Paraná’s Agencia de Defesa Agropecuária (Adapar) carried out an 11-day operation against Highly Pathogenic Avian Influenza (HPAI) along the state’s coastal area from March 16–26, 2026, with 16 Adapar personnel conducting 414 inspections of backyard poultry and veterinary-product outlets. The action combined enforcement with sanitary education, informing poultry owners about the disease and the economic impacts of potential embargoes, and stressing that HPAI is a zoonosis with public-health implications. Collaboration with Petrobras’ Santos Basin Beach Monitoring Project (PMP-BS), run by UFPR, supported the effort through initial simulations and necropsies to identify signs of disease in birds. Maintaining Paraná as an AI-free area protects public health and the economy, important given the state’s status as Brazil’s leading animal-protein producer and top chicken producer. The operation aligns with ongoing Disav biosafety actions under Portaria Adapar 242/2022 and MAPA IN 56/2007.

triage.headline_ja: 沿岸部での鳥インフルエンザ対策完了　414件の検査実施
triage.triage_reason: 高病原性鳥インフルエンザの継続的な監視・制御活動を報告しているが、新規患者発生や流行の報告がなく、むしろ予防的取り組みの段階。情報不足のため経過観察対象。
triage.notes: 記事は既存患者や新規発生ではなく、当局による予防的監視・検査活動の報告である。高病原性鳥インフルエンザは人獣共通感染症であり流行可能性は認識されているが、現段階では流行事例の報告はなく、制御下にあると思われる。ブラジルは対象国リストに含まれないが、発生地域Brasilとして記録。今後の患者発生や拡大の報告があれば優先度上昇の可能性あり。

article.articleHeadline: Menino de 12 anos morre de dengue no Rio Grande do Norte
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 12-year-old boy dies of dengue fever in Rio Grande do Norte
article.articleSummary: 12-year-old boy from Tibau, Rio Grande do Norte, Brazil, died of severe dengue in Mossoró, the state's first dengue fatality of 2026, confirmed by a regional Mossoró lab on March 24, 2026. He had about 15 days of symptoms (high fever and vomiting), was treated multiple times in Tibau, then transferred to the pediatric unit at Hospital da Mulher in Mossoró and subsequently to the ICU at Hospital Maternidade Almeida Castro, where he died. Sesap reported the death; Tibau’s health secretariat said dengue confirmation had not yet been notified to epidemiology as of the morning of March 25. The article reiterates Aedes aegypti as the vector and lists prevention measures: cover water tanks, remove standing water, store bottles upside down, clean drains and AC trays, and involve health agents to apply larvicides in large water deposits, with periodic checks.

triage.headline_ja: リオ・グランデ・ド・ノルテ州で12歳少年がデング熱で死亡
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル国内の単一症例死亡報告であり、直接的な国際的拡大リスクは限定的。ただし重症度（小児死亡）とデング熱の流行可能性により、経過観察が必要。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはブラジル国内（リオ・グランデ・ド・ノルテ州）でのデング熱による小児死亡事例を報告。2026年州内初の死亡例。IHR基準では「深刻な公衆衛生影響」のみ該当。WPROスクリーニング基準では「重症度」「長期曝露」「流行しやすさ」に該当。ブラジルの保健体制は整備されており国際支援は不要。対象国リストにBrazilが含まれるため verified_locations に記載。

article.articleHeadline: Santo André antecipa campanha de vacinação contra Influenza
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Santo André brings forward its influenza vaccination campaign.
article.articleSummary: Influenza vaccination campaign brought forward in Santo André, Brazil. The city begins immunizing priority groups on Friday, 27 March 2026, with vaccine distribution to 33 Primary Health Units starting on 26 March. The public may receive the influenza vaccine at any of the 33 units; individuals must present an original photo ID and, for children, a vaccination card. Day D vaccination is Saturday, 28 March, at designated locations: Policlínica Parque das Nações; Clínica da Família Jardim Ana Maria; Clínica da Família Vila Linda; Clínica da Família Jardim Carla; Clínica da Família Vila Luzita; Clínica da Família Parque Miami; and Shoppinho Santo André. The campaign targets priority groups defined by the Ministry of Health, including children, the elderly, pregnant women, people with comorbidities, essential service workers, and other vulnerable populations. Aim: reduce severe flu cases, hospitalizations, and deaths in the coming months by expanding vaccination coverage before the period of higher circulation.

triage.headline_ja: サントアンドレがインフルエンザワクチン接種キャンペーンを前倒し
triage.triage_reason: インフルエンザの定期的なワクチン接種キャンペーンの実施予定であり、異常な感染症イベントではない。公衆衛生上の深刻な影響、国際的拡大リスク、異常性は認められない。
triage.notes: 本イベントは定期的な予防接種キャンペーンの前倒し実施に関する行政情報であり、感染症アウトブレイクや異常な疾病発生ではない。シグナルトリアージの対象外と判断される。

article.articleHeadline: Como a Chikungunya se espalha e ameaça crianças e idosos
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: How Chikungunya spreads and threatens children and the elderly.
article.articleSummary: Chikungunya outbreak intensifies in Brazil, with infants and the elderly most at risk. In the Dourados Indigenous Reserve and Jaguapiru Village, a month-old baby died—the second infant fatality this year—prompting government-led epidemic status and a health task force. In 2026, Mato Grosso do Sul, Minas Gerais, and São Paulo report the highest incidence, with cases predominating among women and adults aged 20–29. Globally, by February 2026, the European Centre for Disease Prevention and Control records 2,882 chikungunya cases across continents; Suriname, Bolivia, Mexico, Pakistan, and Seychelles have also reported new cases, underscoring international concern. Symptoms include high fever, severe joint pain, fatigue, and malaise; severe cases can involve neurological complications such as encephalitis, meningitis, and paralysis, with prolonged pain during recovery. Prevention hinges on rapid recognition, health teams’ mobilization, continuous surveillance, and public awareness to protect children, the elderly, and those with comorbidities; ongoing outbreak response is essential.

triage.headline_ja: チクングニアの広がり方と子どもと高齢者への脅威
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルでのチクングニア流行が急速に拡大しており、乳幼児の死亡事例が報告されている。複数の国での新規患者報告と国際的な懸念が高まっており、IHR基準及びスクリーニング基準を複数満たす。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではブラジル（特にMato Grosso do Sul州、Dourados先住民保護区）での急速な流行拡大が主要な焦点。乳幼児死亡、神経合併症（脳炎、髄膜炎、麻痺）の報告あり。Suriname、Bolivia、Mexico、Pakistan、Seychellesでの新規患者報告も記載されているが、これらの国は記事の主題ではなく、欧州疾病予防管理センター（ECDC）の世界的なサーベイランスデータとして引用されている。したがって verified_locations はBrazilのみとした。対象国リストには該当する他国がないため、影響は限定的と評価。

article.articleHeadline: 11 cidades de MS tem epidemia de chikungunya e alta de casos alerta para mais mortes até maio
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 11 cities in Mato Grosso do Sul have a chikungunya epidemic and a surge in cases, warning of more deaths through May.
article.articleSummary: Eleven municipalities in Mato Grosso do Sul are experiencing a chikungunya epidemic, with more than 300 cases per 100,000 inhabitants. The state reports 3,058 probable cases and six deaths, including five residents of the Dourados Indigenous Reserve—among them two infants (3 months and 1 month). The sixth death occurred in Bonito. Overall incidence is 110.9/100,000, over ten times the national average (9.6). High-incidence areas include Fátima do Sul (485 cases; 2,353.3/100k), Jardim (270; 1,125.9), Sete Quedas (117; 1,064.2), Vicentina (43; 678.7), Selvíria (46; 565.0), and Corumbá (399; 414.5). Additional towns with >300/100k include Douradina, Água Clara, Antônio João, and Guia Lopes da Laguna. The seasonal peak ends late April to early May, with 966 probable cases from Mar 1–15 potentially driving more hospitalizations and deaths in April. Dourados reports health system strain (385 of 431 beds occupied; 89% on Mar 26). Campo Grande uses Wolbachia to curb transmission; no widespread state outbreak yet in the Cone-Sul region.

triage.headline_ja: マット・グロッソ・ド・スル州の11都市がチクングニア熱流行、症例増加で5月までの死亡増加に警告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3項目該当（異常性・重症度・国際拡大リスク）。ブラジル国内で複数州にまたがる流行、高い死亡率（6死亡、うち5人が先住民保護区の乳幼児を含む）、医療施設の逼迫（89%の病床占有率）により、フルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: マット・グロッソ・ド・スル州における大規模なチクングニア熱流行。11都市が流行状態、3,058例以上の確定例。特に懸念される点は先住民保護区での5例の死亡（乳幼児2名を含む）。季節ピークが4月〜5月初旬に継続予定で、さらなる死亡例と医療逼迫が予想される。医療システムの脆弱性が明白。

article.articleHeadline: Alerta de dengue: 24 bairros de Campinas têm alto risco de transmissão; veja locais - ACidade ON Campinas
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dengue alert: 24 Campinas neighborhoods have a high risk of transmission; see locations - ACidade ON Campinas.
article.articleSummary: Dengue alert in Campinas identifies 24 neighborhoods as high transmission risk as the 13th Arboviroses Alert of 2026, issued on March 26, signaling intensified efforts against the Aedes aegypti mosquito, vector of dengue, Zika, and chikungunya. Regions of greatest concern span various areas of the city. As part of emergency actions, a coordinated effort with the Municipal Committee for Arboviruses and Zoonoses will occur on March 27, including intensified inspections and community engagement. The plan emphasizes reducing breeding sites inside homes, which account for about 80% of mosquito foci per the State Health Secretariat. Campinas also maintains Aedes traps at strategic points and provides phones to verify health workers’ identity. Public participation remains essential: without eliminating domestic breeding sites, dengue transmission will continue despite public measures.

triage.headline_ja: デング熱警報：カンピーナス市の24地区で高い伝播リスク、場所を確認 - ACidade ON カンピーナス
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルでのデング熱・ジカ熱・チクングニア熱の3つのアルボウイルス同時流行警報。24地区が高リスク指定され、組織的な対応が実施されている。IHR基準（異常性・重症度）およびWPRO基準（流行性・長期曝露・管理上の対策）を複数満たし、公式アラート発出による公的関心あり。
triage.notes: 3つのアルボウイルス（デング熱・ジカ熱・チクングニア熱）の同時流行が確認されており、公式な第13警報が発出されている。2026年の新規警報であり、蚊媒介感染症の典型的なシグナル。カンピーナス市内24地区が高リスク指定されており、自治体による組織的な対応（3月27日の合同行動等）が実施予定。

article.articleHeadline: मवाना नगर पालिका में संचारी रोग नियंत्रण को लेकर विशेष बैठक आयोजित
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Special meeting held regarding the control of communicable diseases in Mawana Municipality
article.articleSummary: Special meeting held in Mawana Municipality, Uttar Pradesh, to plan the April 2026 communicable disease control and 'Dastak' door-to-door campaign, in line with government directives. The session, at 3:00 PM at the Municipal Office, was conducted with the health department and UNICEF, following a directive from the Chief Secretary of Uttar Pradesh. The meeting formulated an action plan to prevent transmissible diseases, with emphasis on brain fever (encephalitis), dengue, malaria, and filaria, along with other communicable diseases. Block coordinators urged active public participation, and ASHA workers were tasked to reach every household under the 'Ghar-ghar Dastak' initiative to raise awareness, identify symptoms, and motivate timely treatment. The strategy prioritizes community engagement and rapid response to outbreaks in the Mawana area during April 2026.

triage.headline_ja: マワナ市民局における感染症対策特別会議の開催
triage.triage_reason: 記事は感染症の予防キャンペーン計画に関する会議報告であり、現在の活発な感染症アウトブレイク、症例数の増加、または緊急の公衆衛生上の危機を示す証拠がない。計画段階の会議報告のため、既発生イベントではなく定期的な予防対策の一環と評価される。
triage.notes: 記事は2026年4月に予定されている感染症対策キャンペーン（'Dastak'ドア・ツー・ドア活動）の計画会議に関するもの。脳熱（脳炎）、デング、マラリア、フィラリアに対する予防活動の初期計画段階であり、現在の流行や症例報告ではない。政府レベルでの対策準備は進行中だが、既発生の感染症危機を示す証拠は記事に含まれていない。

article.articleHeadline: Teresina registra um caso de dengue tipo 3 e intensifica ações de prevenção
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Teresina reports a case of dengue serotype 3 and intensifies preventive measures.
article.articleSummary: Dengue serotype 3 has been detected in Teresina, triggering intensified preventive actions and epidemiological monitoring by the Municipal Health Foundation (FMS). The report notes dengue has circulated in Brazil for the first time since 2008, and in 2024 dengue deaths surpassed COVID-19. Zoonoses teams inspect homes for standing-water sources, with Walfrido Salmito, FMS Health Surveillance Director, urging widespread public cooperation to curb the vector. From Jan 1 to Mar 23, 2026, Teresina recorded 558 dengue cases, down 6.1% from 594 in the same period of 2025 (CIEVS). Amariles Borba emphasizes hydration guidance and the need for prevention. Vaccination is available for children aged 10–14 at Basic Health Units and Teresina Shopping in two-dose schedules; a single-dose vaccine is offered exclusively to healthcare professionals. Immunity after infection with type 1 is subtype-specific; types 2 and 3 carry higher risk of severe disease in subsequent infections, while current treatment remains supportive.

triage.headline_ja: テレシーナがデング型3の1症例を報告し、予防対策を強化
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルではデング熱が地域的に継続流行中であり、複数の基準に該当する可能性があるが、単一地域の個別事例報告であり、国家的または国際的な危機の兆候は限定的。情報不足のため経過観察が適切。
triage.notes: ブラジルのテレシーナで報告されたデング熱型3の単一事例。2024年にはデング熱死亡数がCOVID-19を上回ったが、2026年1月〜3月の558事例は前年同期比で6.1%減少。予防措置と予防接種プログラムは実施中。WHOの通知基準（IHR基準2つ以上）には該当しないが、WPROスクリーニング基準で「長期曝露」と「流行しやすさ」に該当。当該地域での対象国基準に基づく監視継続が推奨される。

article.articleHeadline: Idoso é a 6ª vítima de Chikungunya de 2026 em MS
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Elderly man is the 6th chikungunya victim of 2026 in MS.
article.articleSummary: A 72-year-old man is the sixth confirmed chikungunya death in Mato Grosso do Sul (MS) in 2026, with death on March 19 and confirmation in the SES bulletin dated March 26. The Bonito resident had hypertension and diabetes; initial symptoms began March 13. Bonito reports 56 confirmed and 74 under investigation, placing it in red risk (>300 cases per 100,000). In the first three months of 2026, MS has recorded more than one-third of 2025’s 17 deaths. The other five victims were residents of an Indigenous village in Dourados. State totals: 3,058 probable and 1,452 confirmed chikungunya cases, with 21 confirmed among pregnant women. Dourados declared a public health emergency. The outbreak began in the Reserva Indígena and expanded to Jardim dos Estados, Novo Horizonte, and Jóquei Clube, driven by Aedes aegypti. 2025 had a surge toward ~2,122 probable cases by March.

triage.headline_ja: 高齢者が2026年MSのチクングニア熱第6の犠牲者となる
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル・マトグロッソドスル州でチクングニア熱による死亡が増加し、公衆衛生への深刻な影響、異常性（2025年比で急速な増加）、ベクター媒介感染の継続的なリスク、管理上の課題（先住民コミュニティへの拡大）が認識される。IHR基準2つ以上該当かつWPRO基準複数該当。
triage.notes: マトグロッソドスル州でのチクングニア熱の急速な拡大：2026年1-3月で2025年通年死亡数（17人）の3分の1以上に相当する死亡を記録。先住民コミュニティから複数地域への拡大、妊婦を含む感染者の発生、Aedes aegypti媒介による継続的曝露リスクが特徴。ボニート市が赤色リスク段階（10万人あたり300以上の症例）に分類されている。

locations.name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland

article.articleHeadline: Surto multinacional de mpox mantém uma transmissão continua
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Multinational mpox outbreak maintains ongoing transmission.
article.articleSummary: Monkeypox (mpox) transmission remains ongoing globally. In February 2026, 1,184 laboratory-confirmed mpox cases and 4 deaths were reported across 46 countries, with 58.6% in the WHO African Region. Regions saw decreases in the Americas, Africa, Southeast Asia, and the Western Pacific since January 2026, while Europe recorded an uptick; the Eastern Mediterranean held steady. In Africa, 17 countries reported active mpox transmission in the past six weeks (Feb 1–Mar 15, 2026), with 907 cases and 7 deaths (case fatality 0.8%). Madagascar, the Democratic Republic of the Congo, Kenya, Burundi, and Liberia accounted for the largest shares. First reports outside Africa of clade Ib MPXV occurred in Argentina, Austria, and the Central African Republic. Outside Africa, community transmission of clade Ib persists in Europe, including Austria, Belgium, Portugal, Spain, and the United Kingdom, notably among men who have sex with men networks. On World Health Day, April 7, 2026, France will host a One Health summit.

triage.headline_ja: 多国籍なmpoxアウトブレイクが継続的な感染を維持している
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当。多地域・多国家での継続的mpox伝播、死亡事例、国際的拡大リスク、対象国（DRC）での活動的伝播が確認されている。フルRRA進行を要す。
triage.notes: 記事では46ヶ国での確認が報告されているが、指定対象国のうちDRCのみが明示的にアウトブレイク国として識別される。2026年2月時点で1,184確認症例、4死亡。アフリカ地域で58.6%の症例が集中。Clade IbはアフリカからArgentina、Austria、中央アフリカ共和国での初報告。コミュニティ伝播はEurope（Austria、Belgium、Portugal、Spain、UK）で継続。2026年4月7日World Health Day に仏国がOne Health summitを開催予定。

article.articleHeadline: ഭഷ്യ വിഷബാധ; ലക്ഷണങ്ങള്‍
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Food poisoning; symptoms.
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-03-26, food poisoning (acute gastroenteritis) results from bacteria, viruses, or toxins in contaminated foods. Symptoms begin within hours to days after exposure, reflecting variable incubation periods described in the article. The predominant symptom is diarrhea, which may be watery or bloody, often accompanied by abdominal pain or cramps. Fever develops in a substantial proportion of cases. Patients commonly experience muscle pains and general weakness, with fatigue as a persistent feature. The discussion emphasizes the infectious origin of food poisoning and the broad range of potential causative agents—bacteria, viruses, or toxins—but provides no location-specific data, outbreak details, or named pathogens.

triage.headline_ja: 食中毒；症状
triage.triage_reason: 記事は食中毒の一般的な症状についての教育的コンテンツであり、具体的な発生事例、患者数、死亡者、または地域特定の流行情報を含まない。IHR基準・WPROスクリーニング基準に該当しない。
triage.notes: 記事はインドからの配信だが、サマリーはインド国内の具体的な食中毒アウトブレークを報道していない。むしろ食中毒一般に関する症状説明・健康情報であるため、感染症イベント報道ではなく健康教育コンテンツと判断される。発生地域情報は信頼性が低い。

United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland

article.articleHeadline: Cases of tropical k!ller virus that makes body 'fold in on itself' soar 43% in UK
article.articleSummary: Chikungunya infections linked to travel surged 43% in the UK, with 160 cases in England, Wales and Northern Ireland in 2025, up from 112 in 2024. The majority were travel-related, with most cases among people who had recently visited Sri Lanka, India and Bangladesh. Chikungunya is transmitted by mosquitoes and causes high fever and severe joint pain, often in small joints of hands, wrists and feet; other symptoms include muscle pain, headaches, light sensitivity and rashes. Most recover within 1-2 weeks, but joint pain can persist for months or years in some patients; about 12% report persistent joint symptoms. Serious complications are rare (around 1 in 1,000). The virus originated in Tanzania in 1952 and has since spread to new areas, including Europe via travel.

triage.headline_ja: 熱帯地方のキラーウイルスで体が『自分自身に折り曲がる』症状 英国で43%急増
triage.triage_reason: チクングニア熱は旅行関連の輸入症例であり、英国内での二次伝播を示唆する証拠がない。IHR基準は満たさないが、WPROスクリーニング基準（異常性と重症度）の該当可能性と、対象国（インド）での流行背景があるため、続報を注視する価値がある。
triage.notes: 英国内の症例はすべて旅行関連の輸入症例であり、英国での流行や二次伝播の兆候なし。インド、スリランカ、バングラデシュへの旅行関連感染が主体。公開記事のセンセーショナルなタイトル（『tropical killer virus』『fold in on itself』）とは異なり、サマリーでは大多数が1-2週間で回復し、重度合併症は1/1,000と稀であることが明記されている。対象国リストの制約により、インドのみを verified_locations に含める。

article.articleHeadline: Segundo LIRAa do ano identifica seis municípios sergipanos com alta infestação do Aedes aegypti
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: According to this year's LIRAa, six municipalities in Sergipe have high infestation of Aedes aegypti.
article.articleSummary: Six Sergipe municipalities show high Aedes aegypti infestation in the second LIRAa of 2026 (as of 26 March 2026): Areia Branca 6.2, Japoatã 6.1, Simão Dias 6.1, Tomar do Geru 5.3, Itabaiana 4.8, and Nossa Senhora da Glória 4.8, all classified as high risk (>4.0). The survey totals: six high-risk, 45 medium (1.0–3.9), 24 low (0–0.9). Aedes aegypti transmits dengue, Zika, and chikungunya. Endemias chief Sidney Sá notes that several areas dropped from low to high risk, reflecting intensified vector control and underscoring the need for community engagement to eliminate breeding sites around homes and surroundings. Preventive measures should continue; a fumacê spraying vehicle is used as a supplementary control. Symptoms include fever, headache, and body pains; individuals with specific symptoms should seek a Unidade Básica de Saúde, and avoid NSAIDs/acetylsalicylic acid in possible dengue.

triage.headline_ja: 2026年のLIRAa調査：セルジペ州6市町村でネッタイシマカの高感染率を確認
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル・セルジペ州でネッタイシマカの高感染率が確認され、デング熱・ジカ熱・チクングニアの媒介蚊制御は重要だが、現段階では個別の患者発生の報告がなく、媒介蚊サーベイランス情報のみのため、続報による患者発生・疾病拡大の有無を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 記事はネッタイシマカ（Aedes aegypti）の媒介蚊指数（LIRAa）調査結果であり、確認されたのは媒介蚊の高感染率である。デング熱・ジカ熱・チクングながこれらの蚊で媒介される疾患として言及されているが、人での患者発生数は記事に記載されていない。セルジペ州当局が既にベクター制御と住民教育に取り組んでいることから政府関心あり。WPRO基準で「長期曝露（媒介蚊への継続的曝露）」と「流行しやすさ（ヒト-ヒト感染ではなく蚊媒介であり、対策不十分地域がある）」で該当するが、現在は患者発生の報告がないため、患者動向の続報を注視する段階と判断。

article.articleHeadline: Bệnh tay chân miệng tăng, vi rút độc lực cao tái xuất: Phòng bệnh thế nào?
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Hand, Foot, and Mouth Disease on the Rise as a Highly Virulent Virus Re-emerges: How Can We Prevent It?
article.articleSummary: As of 26 March 2026, Ho Chi Minh City reports a surge of Hand, Foot, and Mouth Disease (HFMD), with EV71 detected in 25% of samples (6/24). Week 12 (16–22 Mar) saw 858 cases, up nearly 70% from prior four weeks. Year-to-date totals: 8,152 cases, 288 outbreaks (162 schools, 126 communities), and 3 deaths (week 11 had 2). Severe cases (2b+) total 98 (1.3%), up 4.6-fold from last year. A severe case: a 24-month-old in Ho Chi Minh City developed HFMD with respiratory failure, metabolic acidosis, and required two dialysis sessions before improvement. Hanoi reported 187 HFMD cases in the same week, with year-to-date 1,090 cases, 3 school outbreaks, 22 outbreaks overall, with 5 ongoing. Vietnam’s Ministry of Health has licensed an EV71 vaccine to reduce severe disease; it protects only EV71. Five prevention actions include handwashing and environmental cleaning; authorities urge vigilance rather than panic.

triage.headline_ja: 手足口病が増加、高い病原性のウイルスが再出現：どのように予防すべきか？
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3つ以上該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常な流行増加、国際拡大リスク）。WPRO基準でも異常性・重症度・流行適性が該当。EV71による死亡例、重症例の4.6倍増加、複数の学校アウトブレイクが確認されており、フルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: EV71は高病原性で重症化リスクが高い。2026年第12週（3月16-22日）で858症例、前4週比70%増加。年累計8,152症例、288アウトブレイク（学校162、地域126）、死亡3例。重症例（2b以上）は98例（1.3%）で前年比4.6倍。ベトナムはEV71ワクチン承認済みだが、供給体制や予防対策の実効性が焦点となる可能性。東南アジア地域での拡大リスクも考慮すべき。

article.articleHeadline: Second death from Ferozepur's outbreak-hit village
article.articleSummary: Second death in Ferozepur's outbreak-hit village from water-borne disease: Arshdeep Singh of Hazara Singh Wala died at PGIMER, Chandigarh, after falling ill during a visit to the RSSB dera in Amritsar district. Doctors said he died due to multiple organ failure, though his family alleges jaundice. The deceased had fever before leaving for Beas and sought tests at the Civil Hospital; the on-duty doctor reportedly refused a blood sample, claiming leptospirosis affects only children. Arshdeep was later treated at Guru Gobind Singh Medical College, Faridkot; AIIMS Bathinda; and finally PGIMER Chandigarh. Jaundice cannot be confirmed until medical records are examined, a senior health official said. In Feb, a 12-year-old girl Sehaj Kaur died from leptospirosis in the same village. Tests and water tankers were provided, but villagers accuse measures of fading, leaving residents to rely on a contaminated water system, fueling ongoing water-borne diseases in the border area.

triage.headline_ja: フェロゼプール州の感染症多発村からの2番目の死亡
triage.triage_reason: レプトスピラ症による死亡事例の増加（2月に続く2例目）、水系感染症の継続的な流行、医療対応の不備が記録されている。IHR基準2つ以上（深刻な公衆衛生影響と予想外の感染症パターン）に該当し、フルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: インド（パンジャブ州およびチャンディガル）で水系病原体によるレプトスピラ症多発。同一村での複数死亡事例、医療システムの対応遅延、水源汚染の継続が指摘されている。死亡診断の検証待ちの点で情報不完全だが、公式発表があれば直ちに報告必要。

article.articleHeadline: UK Records Highest Chikungunya Cases in Over a Decade
article.articleSummary: UK recorded 160 travel-associated chikungunya cases in 2025, the highest annual total since 2014, a 43% rise from 112 in 2024. Most infections occurred in travellers returning from Sri Lanka, India and Bangladesh, where outbreaks persist in the Indian Ocean region. Chikungunya is mosquito-borne (Aedes spp.) with sudden fever, severe joint and muscle pain, headaches, photophobia and skin rashes; most recover in weeks, but joint pain can persist for months or years and fatalities are rare. UKHSA and NaTHNaC urge pre-travel protection and post-travel vigilance: DEET repellents, covering exposed skin, sleeping under treated nets, and consulting travel clinics about available vaccines. Two chikungunya vaccines are approved in the UK and sold privately. The rise coincides with Easter travel. In 2025 imported malaria reached 1,629 cases; dengue declined. Warming temperatures may expand Aedes albopictus into cooler parts of Europe, raising local outbreak risk in France and Italy.

triage.headline_ja: UK、10年以上ぶりに最高のチクングニア熱症例数を記録
triage.triage_reason: チクングニア熱の輸入症例が増加傾向を示しており、ベクター媒介蚊の地理的拡大リスク（ヨーロッパへのAedes albopictus拡大）が指摘されているが、現在のところ英国では輸入症例に限定されており、対象国の中ではインド・バングラデシュでの持続的発生が記事の主題。情報がやや限定的であり、今後の動向確認が必要。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーは英国の輸入症例の増加が主題だが、対象国リストに基づき検証すると、実際の発生地域はインド、バングラデシュ、スリランカであり、このうち対象国はインドのみ。英国、フランス、イタリアは対象国外のため verified_locations から除外。インド洋地域での持続的アウトブレイクとヨーロッパへのベクター拡大リスクは注視の価値あり。

article.articleHeadline: Médica alerta para manutenção de criadouros do mosquito da dengue em Teresina
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Female Doctor Warns About the Maintenance of Aedes aegypti Breeding Grounds in Teresina
article.articleSummary: Dengue serotype DENV-3 is circulating in southern Piauí, Brazil, with Teresina reporting 1,222 suspected dengue cases (699 confirmed; 35 under investigation) in 2026, and no dengue deaths to date. The DENV-3 circulation, not observed in Brazil since 2008, has been traced from São Paulo and Pernambuco to Anísio de Abreu and Jurema in the São Raimundo Nonato region, raising epidemic risk. An emergency response follows in São Raimundo Nonato, including a city-wide cleanup, mass population testing, and expanded vaccination after about 600 suspected cases in 2026 (67 confirmed, 377 discarded, others under analysis). In Teresina, 1,222 cases have been reported with 699 confirmed; 35 under investigation. Prevention targets eliminating Aedes aegypti breeding sites; eggs endure desiccation. Wash water containers at least weekly; CO2 from exercise and dark clothing can attract mosquitoes. Vaccination: two-dose dengue vaccine for 10–14-year-olds at UBS and Teresina Shopping; single-dose vaccine for health professionals.

triage.headline_ja: テレジーナでのデング熱蚊の繁殖地維持に対する医師の警告
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルで2008年以来初のDENV-3血清型の流行が発生しており、複数州での確認例と急速な拡大が報告されている。IHR基準で異常性（予想外の血清型復活）と深刻な公衆衛生影響が認められ、WPROスクリーニング基準でも異常性・重症度・流行しやすさが該当する。
triage.notes: DENV-3は2008年以来ブラジルで確認されていない血清型。テレジーナで699確認例、さらに複数州（ペルナンブーコ、サンパウロ、ピアウイ州）での多発報告あり。緊急対応が実施されており、公式な感染症対応が開始されている。ただし死亡例報告なし。記事は医師の警告と予防対策に焦点。

article.articleHeadline: Chikungunya: como se espalha e afeta crianças e idosos
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Chikungunya: how it spreads and affects children and the elderly.
article.articleSummary: Chikungunya, transmitted by Aedes aegypti, is surging in Mato Grosso do Sul, Brazil, with five deaths in 2026, including a one-month-old baby in the Dourados Jaguapiru Indigenous Reserve. The virus mainly affects babies, the elderly, and those with comorbidities; symptoms include high fever and severe joint pain, with fatigue and potential progression to encephalitis or meningitis and prolonged recovery. Authorities declared an epidemic and mobilized a task force, inspecting over 4,300 properties in Jaguapiru and Bororó; 2,173 potential habitats and 1,004 breeding sites were identified, mainly in water tanks, garbage, and tires. 86 vector-control professionals and 29 community health workers participated; pesticides were applied. Nationally, the highest incidence is in Mato Grosso do Sul, Minas Gerais, and São Paulo; prevention focuses on eliminating standing water, covering tanks, cleaning areas, discarding tires and trash, using repellents, and protective clothing, especially in vulnerable communities.

triage.headline_ja: チクングニア熱：拡がり方と子ども・高齢者への影響
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル・マト・グロッソ・ド・スル州でチクングニア熱の流行が宣言され、2026年に5人の死亡（生後1ヶ月の乳児を含む）が報告されています。IHR基準では「異常/予想外」「重症度」に該当し、国家レベルでの対応（タスクフォース動員、大規模なベクター対策）が実施されており、シグナルとして識別すべき状況です。
triage.notes: 記事はブラジルのマト・グロッソ・ド・スル州（Dourados Jaguapiru先住民保護区を含む）でのチクングニア熱の流行を主題としています。死亡例、脳炎/髄膜炎への進行、乳児や高齢者への重大な影響が明記されており、当局による流行宣言と広範なベクター対策実施が確認されています。複数州（マト・グロッソ・ド・スル、ミナス・ジェライス、サンパウロ）での流行が報告されていますが、発生の主体はブラジルです。

article.articleHeadline: Misiones cierra el verano sin casos confirmados de dengue ni chikungunya, en contraste con el avance de ambas enfermedades en varias zonas del país
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Misiones ends the summer with no confirmed cases of dengue or chikungunya, in contrast with the spread of both diseases in several areas of the country.
article.articleSummary: Misiones, Argentina, closes summer with no confirmed dengue or chikungunya cases, despite nationwide circulation. The National Epidemiological Bulletin covering weeks 31/2025–10/2026 shows intensive surveillance across the country. Misiones logs 443 suspected dengue cases, 441 lab negatives, and no confirmed dengue or chikungunya; two probable dengue cases without travel history remain under investigation, prompting enhanced vector-control. Nationwide dengue since 2025/2026 season: 14,372 suspected; 28 lab-confirmed. Serotypes detected: DENV-1, DENV-2, DENV-3, with 46% of positives lacking travel history, indicating community transmission. The Centro region and Formosa are hotspots; Buenos Aires and Buenos Aires City report 10 and 9 cases, including autochthonous infections in La Matanza, Morón, and San Isidro. Formosa reports autochthonous cases (Pilagás, Patiño); Catamarca autochthonous DENV-2 (Ancasti); several imported cases linked to Paraguay, Brazil, Mexico, Cuba, Indonesia, Sri Lanka across Entre Ríos, Córdoba, Mendoza. Chikungunya: Misiones 0 confirmed or probable; 41 suspected, all negative. Nationally, 3,202 suspected; 199 confirmed/probable; local transmission in NOA (Salta 167) and Yerba Buena, Tucumán, with spread to Jujuy, Catamarca, Santiago del Estero, and Buenos Aires; Centro 12; Cuyo 1 (San Luis).

triage.headline_ja: ミシオネス州、デング熱とチクングニアの確認症例なしで夏を終える。国内の複数地域での両疾患の拡大と対照的
triage.triage_reason: アルゼンチンでデング熱とチクングニアが国内で活発に流行しており、複数州での地域感染（オートクトノス）が報告されている。IHR基準で2項目以上該当し、公衆衛生への深刻な影響と国際的なリスクが認識される。
triage.notes: 記事はアルゼンチン国内でのデング熱とチクングニアの流行を述べているが、対象国リストにアルゼンチン（GeoNames ID 3865483）が含まれていないため、verified_locations には含めない。ただし、ブラジルとインドネシアからの輸入症例が言及されており、これらの対象国が該当する。記事は2026年3月配信と未来日時であるが、シナリオ想定と判断し評価を実施した。

article.articleHeadline: Com hospitais sob pressão, Lia Nogueira pede ampliação do atendimento para casos de Chikungunya - Ponta Porã Informa - Notícias de Ponta Porã - MS e Pedro Juan Caballero - PY
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: With hospitals under pressure, Lia Nogueira calls for expanding care for Chikungunya cases - Ponta Porã Informa - News from Ponta Porã - MS and Pedro Juan Caballero - PY.
article.articleSummary: As of March 26, 2026, Chikungunya fever cases are rising in Dourados, Mato Grosso do Sul, Brazil, with affected Jaguapiru and Bororó Indigenous villages. State deputy Lia Nogueira (PSDB) urged the creation of a dedicated wing or space at the Regional Hospital to treat Chikungunya patients and to reinforce emergency measures. Dourados serves as the regional reference for more than 30 municipalities in the Conesul region, and hospitals are near capacity. The state government announced 15 beds (10 adults, 5 pediatric), but Nogueira warns this may be insufficient given the rising caseload. She calls for a coordinated effort across state, federal, and municipal levels and the health network, while noting longstanding sanitation and treated-water deficiencies that complicate control in Jaguapiru and Bororó and surrounding areas.

triage.headline_ja: 病院が圧力の下で、リア・ノゲイラはチクングニア症例の治療拡大を要請 - ポンタ・ポラン・インフォルマ
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルのマット・グロッソ・ド・スル州ドゥラドスでチクングニア熱の症例が増加し、地域の病院がほぼ満床に達している。州レベルでの政治的関心が高く、インジェナス先住民族コミュニティが影響を受けており、地域的な公衆衛生上の懸念となっている。IHR基準およびWPRO基準複数項目に該当。
triage.notes: チクングニア熱はブラジルでは既知の流行疾患であり、本イベントは予想外ではないが、Dourados地域での急速な症例増加、先住民コミュニティの脆弱性、病院容量逼迫により地域的な管理可能性の懸念が生じている。衛生インフラの不備が長期的な曝露リスクを高めている。WPRO基準に4項目該当することから、フルRRA実施推奨。
